    const STORES = ['Consolidated Recon', 'Diesel', 'Hurley', 'Jeep Apparel', "Levi's South Africa", 'Reebok', 'Superdry', 'Other'];

    // Helper: Derive store from order name
    const getStoreFromName = (name) => {
      if (!name) return 'Other';
      const prefix = name.charAt(0).toUpperCase();
      switch (prefix) {
        case 'D': return 'Diesel';
        case 'H': return 'Hurley';
        case 'J': return 'Jeep Apparel';
        case 'L': return "Levi's South Africa";
        case 'R': return 'Reebok';
        case 'S': return 'Superdry';
        default: return 'Other';
      }
    };

    function App() {
      const [ordersData, setOrdersData] = useState([]);
      const [ordersFileNames, setOrdersFileNames] = useState([]);

      const [shipmentsData, setShipmentsData] = useState([]);
      const [shipmentsFileNames, setShipmentsFileNames] = useState([]);

      const [mergedData, setMergedData] = useState(null);
      const [exclusionList, setExclusionList] = useState(new Set());

      const [isLoaded, setIsLoaded] = useState(false);
      const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
      const [loadTimestamp, setLoadTimestamp] = useState(null);
      const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState('Consolidated Recon');
      const [showOnlyUnfulfilled, setShowOnlyUnfulfilled] = useState(true);
      const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
      const [sortConfig, setSortConfig] = useState({ key: null, direction: 'asc' });
      const [modalSortConfig, setModalSortConfig] = useState({ key: null, direction: 'asc' });

      // Modal states
      const [modalConfig, setModalConfig] = useState({ isOpen: false, title: '', data: [] });
      const [shipmentModal, setShipmentModal] = useState(null);
      const [excludeChecked, setExcludeChecked] = useState(false);

      // Helper to get load message
      const getLoadMessageText = () => {
        if (mergedData) return 'Using Cloud-fetched JSON data.';
        if (ordersData.length && shipmentsData.length) return 'Using both Orders and Shipments data.';
        if (shipmentsData.length) return 'Using Shipments data only (fallback mapping active).';
        return 'Using Orders data only.';
      };

      // Reset checkbox when modal changes
      useEffect(() => {
        if (shipmentModal) setExcludeChecked(false);
      }, [shipmentModal]);

      // Initial load of the Exclusion List directly from your LIVE Google Sheet using Visualization API for CORS bypass
      useEffect(() => {
        const loadExclusions = async () => {
          try {
            // The gviz API returns a CSV perfectly to bypass CORS restrictions
            const liveSheetUrl = 'https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1-hvAFgc345IRIG4PsRYL-7g3sYuEyBXRY0oWsFsfsbU/gviz/tq?tqx=out:csv&sheet=Sheet1';
            const response = await fetch(liveSheetUrl, { cache: 'no-store' });

            if (response.ok) {
              const csvText = await response.text();
              const rows = csvText.split('\n');
              const excluded = new Set();

              rows.forEach(row => {
                const cols = row.split(',');
                if (cols.length > 0) {
                  // Strip out any surrounding quotes and whitespace
                  const val = cols[0].replace(/(^"|"$)/g, '').trim().toUpperCase();
                  if (val && val !== 'ORDER') {
                    excluded.add(val);
                  }
                }
              });

              setExclusionList(excluded);
            }
          } catch (err) {
            console.warn('Could not load live exclusion list. Make sure the Google Sheet is set to "Anyone with the link can view". Dashboard will continue normally.', err);
          }
        };
        loadExclusions();
      }, []);

      // Save exclusion directly to Google Sheets via Web App
      const handleSaveExclusion = async (orderName) => {
        const upperName = String(orderName).trim().toUpperCase();

        if (!window.confirm(`Are you sure you want to exclude ${orderName}? It will be hidden from the dashboard instantly and saved to your live Google Sheet.`)) return;

        // The deployed Web App URL
        const GOOGLE_WEB_APP_URL = "https://script.google.com/a/macros/ecomplete.co.za/s/AKfycbwa2Uo5GCvEyVROCGCnf-DO8syOOm9mcu9YgmHfm_uki7_udDypSXrLOXreeNYluz4Aew/exec";

        // 1. Optimistically Update Local UI immediately
        const newExclusions = new Set(exclusionList);
        newExclusions.add(upperName);
        setExclusionList(newExclusions);

        // Close UI Modals
        setShipmentModal(null);
        setExcludeChecked(false);
        if (modalConfig.isOpen) {
          setModalConfig(prev => ({
            ...prev,
            data: prev.data.filter(r => r.orderName.toUpperCase() !== upperName)
          }));
        }

        // 2. Send data silently to the Google Script using a cache-buster
        try {
          await fetch(`${GOOGLE_WEB_APP_URL}?orderName=${encodeURIComponent(upperName)}&t=${Date.now()}`, {
            method: 'GET',
            mode: 'no-cors', // Prevent browser from blocking the cross-origin request
            cache: 'no-cache'
          });
          console.log(`Successfully requested to save ${upperName} to live sheet.`);
          alert(`Order ${upperName} successfully excluded and saved to the Live Sheet!`);
        } catch (err) {
          console.error("Error saving to live sheet:", err);
          alert(`Excluded locally, but failed to save to Live Sheet. \n\nIMPORTANT: Make sure your Google Apps Script is deployed with "Who has access" set to "Anyone" (not just anyone within ecomplete.co.za), otherwise your browser will block the background execution!`);
        }
      };

      // Render Courier Tracking Links dynamically
      const renderTrackingLink = (trackingNo, trackingCo, isModal = false) => {
        if (!trackingNo || trackingNo === '-' || trackingNo === 'Not Available') {
          return isModal
            ? <span className="text-sm font-mono bg-slate-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-slate-700">{trackingNo || '-'}</span>
            : <span className="text-slate-600 font-mono text-xs">{trackingNo || '-'}</span>;
        }

        const courier = String(trackingCo || '').toLowerCase();
        let url = null;
        if (courier.includes('ram')) url = `https://ram.co.za/Track/${trackingNo}`;
        else if (courier.includes('courierguy') || courier.includes('courier guy')) url = `https://portal.thecourierguy.co.za/track?ref=${trackingNo}`;

        if (url) {
          return isModal ? (
            <a href={url} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" className="text-sm font-mono text-indigo-600 hover:text-indigo-800 underline bg-indigo-50 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded font-semibold">
              {trackingNo}
            </a>
          ) : (
            <a href={url} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()} className="text-indigo-600 hover:text-indigo-800 underline font-mono text-xs font-semibold">
              {trackingNo}
            </a>
          );
        }

        return isModal
          ? <span className="text-sm font-mono bg-slate-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-slate-700">{trackingNo}</span>
          : <span className="text-slate-600 font-mono text-xs">{trackingNo}</span>;
      };

      // Clear App State
      const handleClear = () => {
        setOrdersData([]);
        setOrdersFileNames([]);
        setShipmentsData([]);
        setShipmentsFileNames([]);
        setMergedData(null);
        setIsLoaded(false);
        setLoadTimestamp(null);
      };

      // Trigger Load for manual files
      const handleLoad = () => {
        if (!ordersData.length && !shipmentsData.length && !mergedData) {
          alert("Please upload at least one file to load the dashboard.");
          return;
        }
        setIsLoaded(true);
        setLoadTimestamp(new Date());
        setTimeout(() => alert(`Dashboard Successfully Loaded\n${getLoadMessageText()}`), 100);
      };

      // Fetch JSON natively using relative path (avoids CORS if hosted on same GCP bucket)
      const handleFetchJson = async () => {
        setIsLoading(true);
        try {
          const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
          const defaultFile = 'https://storage.googleapis.com/ecomplete-bounty-recon-data-745137237871/Bounty_Recon_Merged.json';
          const targetFile = urlParams.get('file') ? urlParams.get('file') : defaultFile;

          const cacheBusterUrl = `${targetFile}?t=${new Date().getTime()}`;
          const response = await fetch(cacheBusterUrl, { cache: 'no-store' });

          if (!response.ok) {
            throw new Error(`File ${targetFile} not found natively.`);
          }

          const jsonData = await response.json();

          if (!Array.isArray(jsonData)) {
            throw new Error("Data retrieved is not a valid array of shipments.");
          }

          const mappedData = jsonData.map((row, idx) => ({
            id: `${row.OrderName}-${row.ShipmentID || idx}`,
            store: row.Store || 'Other',
            orderName: row.OrderName || '-',
            shipmentId: row.ShipmentID || '-',
            shopifyStatus: row.ShopifyStatus || 'Unfulfilled',
            sellerPortalStatus: (() => {
              const sps = (row.SellerPortalStatus || 'UNKNOWN').toUpperCase();
              const shopStatus = (row.ShopifyStatus || '').toLowerCase();
              if (sps === 'NO RECORD FOUND' && shopStatus === 'cancelled') return 'CANCELLED';
              if (sps.includes('HOLD')) return 'ON HOLD';
              if (sps.includes('EXCEPTION') || sps.includes('UNABLE') || sps.includes('UNSUCCESSFUL')) return 'EXCEPTION';
              return sps;
            })(),
            shippingStatus: row.ShippingStatus || row.SellerPortalStatus || '-',
            trackingNo: row.TrackingNumber || '-',
            trackingCo: row.TrackingCompany || '-',
            createdAt: row.ShopifyCreatedAt || '-',
            statusDate: row.SellerPortalStatusDate || '-',
            sourceFile: row.SourceFile || 'Bounty_Recon_Merged.json',
            items: row.items || (row.ItemName || row['Item Name'] || row.SKU ? [{
              name: row.ItemName || row['Item Name'] || row.SKU,
              quantity: row.Quantity || row.Qty || '1'
            }] : [])
          }));

          setMergedData(mappedData);
          setOrdersData([]);
          setOrdersFileNames([]);
          setShipmentsData([]);
          setShipmentsFileNames([]);
          setIsLoaded(true);
          setLoadTimestamp(new Date());
          setTimeout(() => alert(`Dashboard Successfully Loaded\nUsing Cloud-fetched JSON data.`), 100);

        } catch (error) {
          console.error("Error fetching JSON from bucket:", error);
          alert("Failed to fetch JSON file.\n\nReason: " + error.message + "\n\nIf you are opening this file locally on your PC, your browser's security will block the fetch. Please upload this HTML file to your Cloud Bucket, or use the manual upload option.");
        } finally {
          setIsLoading(false);
        }
      };

      // Universal File Upload Handler (Uses SheetJS for Excel AND CSV) - Now supports multiple files
      const handleFileUpload = async (e, type) => {
        const files = Array.from(e.target.files);
        if (!files.length) return;

        if (files.length > 6) {
          alert("You can upload a maximum of 6 files at a time.");
          e.target.value = null; // reset input
          return;
        }

        try {
          const fileNames = files.map(f => f.name);

          // Read and parse all uploaded files concurrently
          const readPromises = files.map(file => {
            return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
              const reader = new FileReader();
              reader.onload = (event) => {
                try {
                  const data = new Uint8Array(event.target.result);
                  const workbook = window.XLSX.read(data, { type: 'array' });
                  const firstSheetName = workbook.SheetNames[0];
                  const worksheet = workbook.Sheets[firstSheetName];

                  // Parse to JSON - SheetJS automatically maps data by Header Name, not column position!
                  const jsonData = window.XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(worksheet, { defval: '' });

                  // Normalize keys (trim whitespace) and cast values to strings
                  const normalizedData = jsonData.map(row => {
                    const newRow = {};
                    for (const key in row) {
                      newRow[key.trim()] = String(row[key]).trim();
                    }
                    newRow['_sourceFile'] = file.name;
                    return newRow;
                  });
                  resolve(normalizedData);
                } catch (error) {
                  reject(error);
                }
              };
              reader.onerror = () => reject(new Error("File reading failed"));
              reader.readAsArrayBuffer(file);
            });
          });

          const results = await Promise.all(readPromises);
          const combinedData = results.flat(); // Merge all parsed file arrays into one unified array

          if (type === 'orders') {
            setOrdersData(combinedData);
            setOrdersFileNames(fileNames);
          }
          if (type === 'shipments') {
            setShipmentsData(combinedData);
            setShipmentsFileNames(fileNames);
          }

        } catch (error) {
          console.error("Error reading file:", error);
          alert("Failed to parse one or more files. Ensure they are valid Excel or CSV files.");
        } finally {
          e.target.value = null; // allow re-uploading the same files if needed
        }
      };

      // JSON Upload Handler
      const handleJsonUpload = (e) => {
        const file = e.target.files[0];
        if (!file) return;

        const reader = new FileReader();
        reader.onload = (event) => {
          try {
            const jsonData = JSON.parse(event.target.result);
            const mappedData = jsonData.map((row, idx) => ({
              id: `${row.OrderName}-${row.ShipmentID || idx}`,
              store: row.Store || 'Other',
              orderName: row.OrderName || '-',
              shipmentId: row.ShipmentID || '-',
              shopifyStatus: row.ShopifyStatus || 'Unfulfilled',
              sellerPortalStatus: (() => {
                const sps = (row.SellerPortalStatus || 'UNKNOWN').toUpperCase();
                const shopStatus = (row.ShopifyStatus || '').toLowerCase();
                if (sps === 'NO RECORD FOUND' && shopStatus === 'cancelled') return 'CANCELLED';
                if (sps.includes('HOLD')) return 'ON HOLD';
                if (sps.includes('EXCEPTION') || sps.includes('UNABLE') || sps.includes('UNSUCCESSFUL')) return 'EXCEPTION';
                return sps;
              })(),
              shippingStatus: row.ShippingStatus || row.SellerPortalStatus || '-',
              trackingNo: row.TrackingNumber || '-',
              trackingCo: row.TrackingCompany || '-',
              createdAt: row.ShopifyCreatedAt || '-',
              statusDate: row.SellerPortalStatusDate || '-',
              sourceFile: row.SourceFile || file.name,
              items: row.items || (row.ItemName || row['Item Name'] || row.SKU ? [{
                name: row.ItemName || row['Item Name'] || row.SKU,
                quantity: row.Quantity || row.Qty || '1'
              }] : [])
            }));

            setMergedData(mappedData);
            setOrdersData([]);
            setOrdersFileNames([]);
            setShipmentsData([]);
            setShipmentsFileNames([]);
          } catch (error) {
            console.error("Error parsing JSON:", error);
            alert("Failed to parse JSON file. Ensure it is the correct exported format.");
          } finally {
            e.target.value = null;
          }
        };
        reader.readAsText(file);
      };

      // Core Data Processing, Merging, and Item Aggregation Logic
      const reconData = useMemo(() => {
        if (!isLoaded) return null; // Wait for user to load/fetch
        if (!ordersData.length && !shipmentsData.length && !mergedData) return null;

        let processingData = [];

        if (mergedData) {
          processingData = [...mergedData];
        } else {
          // 1. Group shipments by Order ID AND Shipment ID to bundle line items
          const shipmentsMap = {};
          shipmentsData.forEach(ship => {
            const rawOid = ship['Source Store Order ID'];
            const oid = rawOid ? String(rawOid).trim().toUpperCase() : null;
            if (!oid) return;

            if (!shipmentsMap[oid]) shipmentsMap[oid] = {};

            const sId = ship['Shipment ID'] || 'UNKNOWN_SHIPMENT';

            if (!shipmentsMap[oid][sId]) {
              // First time seeing this shipment, initialize it with an items array
              shipmentsMap[oid][sId] = {
                ...ship,
                bundledItems: []
              };
            }

            // Add the item to this shipment's bundle
            const itemName = ship['Item Name'] || ship['SKU'] || '';
            const itemQty = ship['Quantity'] || ship['Qty'] || '1';
            if (itemName && itemName !== '-' && itemName !== 'undefined') {
              shipmentsMap[oid][sId].bundledItems.push({ name: itemName, quantity: itemQty });
            }
          });

          // 2. Build final dataset based on provided files
          if (ordersData.length > 0) {
            // Scenario A: Orders file provided (standard merge lookup)
            ordersData.forEach((order, idx) => {
              const rawName = order['Name'];
              if (!rawName) return;

              const lookupName = String(rawName).trim().toUpperCase();
              const store = getStoreFromName(rawName);
              const rawStatus = order['Order Fulfillment Status'];
              const shopifyStatus = (!rawStatus || String(rawStatus).trim() === '') ? 'Unfulfilled' : rawStatus;

              const orderShipments = shipmentsMap[lookupName];

              if (!orderShipments) {
                processingData.push({
                  id: `${rawName}-none-${idx}`,
                  store,
                  orderName: rawName,
                  shopifyStatus,
                  sellerPortalStatus: (() => {
                    const shopStatus = shopifyStatus.toLowerCase();
                    if (shopStatus === 'cancelled') return 'CANCELLED';
                    return 'NO RECORD FOUND';
                  })(),
                  shippingStatus: order['Fulfillment: Shipment Status'] || '-',
                  trackingNo: order['Fulfillment: Tracking Number'] || '-',
                  trackingCo: order['Fulfillment: Tracking Company'] || '-',
                  createdAt: order['Created At'] || '-',
                  statusDate: '-',
                  shipmentId: '-',
                  sourceFile: order['_sourceFile'] || '-',
                  items: []
                });
              } else {
                Object.values(orderShipments).forEach(ship => {
                  processingData.push({
                    id: `${rawName}-${ship['Shipment ID']}`,
                    store,
                    orderName: rawName,
                    shopifyStatus,
                    sellerPortalStatus: (() => {
                      const sps = (ship['Status'] || 'UNKNOWN').toUpperCase();
                      if (sps.includes('HOLD')) return 'ON HOLD';
                      if (sps.includes('EXCEPTION') || sps.includes('UNABLE') || sps.includes('UNSUCCESSFUL')) return 'EXCEPTION';
                      return sps;
                    })(),
                    shippingStatus: ship['Status'] || order['Fulfillment: Shipment Status'] || '-',
                    trackingNo: order['Fulfillment: Tracking Number'] || ship['Tracking No'] || '-',
                    trackingCo: order['Fulfillment: Tracking Company'] || ship['Courier'] || '-',
                    createdAt: order['Created At'] || '-',
                    statusDate: ship['Status Date'] || '-',
                    shipmentId: ship['Shipment ID'] || '-',
                    sourceFile: ship['_sourceFile'] || order['_sourceFile'] || '-',
                    items: ship.bundledItems
                  });
                });
              }
            });
          } else if (shipmentsData.length > 0) {
            // Scenario B: ONLY Shipments file provided (extract directly from shipment data)
            Object.keys(shipmentsMap).forEach(oid => {
              const rawName = oid;
              const store = getStoreFromName(rawName);
              const orderShipments = shipmentsMap[oid];

              Object.values(orderShipments).forEach(ship => {
                processingData.push({
                  id: `${rawName}-${ship['Shipment ID']}`,
                  store,
                  orderName: rawName,
                  shopifyStatus: 'Unfulfilled', // Assumed Unfulfilled for recon since Shopify data is missing
                  sellerPortalStatus: (() => {
                    const sps = (ship['Status'] || 'UNKNOWN').toUpperCase();
                    if (sps.includes('HOLD')) return 'ON HOLD';
                    if (sps.includes('EXCEPTION') || sps.includes('UNABLE') || sps.includes('UNSUCCESSFUL')) return 'EXCEPTION';
                    return sps;
                  })(),
                  shippingStatus: ship['Status'] || '-',
                  trackingNo: ship['Tracking No'] || '-',
                  trackingCo: ship['Courier'] || '-',
                  createdAt: ship['Order Date'] || '-', // Fallback to shipment order date
                  statusDate: ship['Status Date'] || '-',
                  shipmentId: ship['Shipment ID'] || '-',
                  sourceFile: ship['_sourceFile'] || '-',
                  items: ship.bundledItems
                });
              });
            });
          }
        }

        // Apply Exclusion List filtering instantly using the Live GCP Data
        return processingData.filter(row => !exclusionList.has(String(row.orderName || '').toUpperCase()));

      }, [ordersData, shipmentsData, mergedData, isLoaded, exclusionList]);

      // Filtering Logic
      const filteredData = useMemo(() => {
        if (!reconData) return [];
        return reconData.filter(row => {
          const matchesTab = activeTab === 'Consolidated Recon' || row.store === activeTab;
          const matchesStatus = showOnlyUnfulfilled ? row.shopifyStatus === 'Unfulfilled' : true;
          const matchesSearch = row.orderName.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||
            row.trackingNo.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||
            row.shipmentId.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase());
          return matchesTab && matchesStatus && matchesSearch;
        });
      }, [reconData, activeTab, showOnlyUnfulfilled, searchQuery]);

      // Sorting Logic and Helpers
      const sortData = (data, config) => {
        if (!config.key) return data;
        
        return [...data].sort((a, b) => {
          let aVal = a[config.key];
          let bVal = b[config.key];

          if (aVal === undefined || aVal === null || aVal === '-') aVal = '';
          if (bVal === undefined || bVal === null || bVal === '-') bVal = '';

          const isDateKey = ['createdAt', 'statusDate'].includes(config.key);
          if (isDateKey) {
            const dateA = new Date(aVal);
            const dateB = new Date(bVal);
            const timeA = isNaN(dateA.getTime()) ? 0 : dateA.getTime();
            const timeB = isNaN(dateB.getTime()) ? 0 : dateB.getTime();
            if (timeA < timeB) return config.direction === 'asc' ? -1 : 1;
            if (timeA > timeB) return config.direction === 'asc' ? 1 : -1;
            return 0;
          }

          const numA = Number(aVal);
          const numB = Number(bVal);
          if (!isNaN(numA) && !isNaN(numB) && aVal !== '' && bVal !== '') {
            return config.direction === 'asc' ? numA - numB : numB - numA;
          }

          const strA = String(aVal);
          const strB = String(bVal);
          return config.direction === 'asc' 
            ? strA.localeCompare(strB, undefined, { numeric: true, sensitivity: 'base' })
            : strB.localeCompare(strA, undefined, { numeric: true, sensitivity: 'base' });
        });
      };

      const sortedFilteredData = useMemo(() => {
        return sortData(filteredData, sortConfig);
      }, [filteredData, sortConfig]);

      const sortedModalData = useMemo(() => {
        return sortData(modalConfig.data || [], modalSortConfig);
      }, [modalConfig.data, modalSortConfig]);

      const requestSort = (key, isModal = false) => {
        const currentConfig = isModal ? modalSortConfig : sortConfig;
        const setConfig = isModal ? setModalSortConfig : setSortConfig;
        
        let direction = 'asc';
        if (currentConfig.key === key && currentConfig.direction === 'asc') {
          direction = 'desc';
        }
        setConfig({ key, direction });
      };

      const renderSortableHeader = (label, key, isModal = false) => {
        const config = isModal ? modalSortConfig : sortConfig;
        const isSorted = config.key === key;
        return (
          <th 
            onClick={() => requestSort(key, isModal)}
            className="px-6 py-4 cursor-pointer select-none hover:bg-slate-200/60 hover:text-slate-900 transition-colors group/header"
          >
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <span>{label}</span>
              <span className={`inline-block ml-1 transition-transform duration-200 text-xs ${
                isSorted 
                  ? 'text-indigo-600 font-bold scale-110' 
                  : 'text-slate-300 group-hover/header:text-slate-400 opacity-60 group-hover/header:opacity-100'
              }`}>
                {isSorted ? (config.direction === 'asc' ? '▲' : '▼') : '↕'}
              </span>
            </div>
          </th>
        );
      };

      // Statistics Calculation
      const stats = useMemo(() => {
        if (!reconData) return null;

        let totalOrders = 0;
        if (mergedData) {
          totalOrders = mergedData.length;
        } else if (ordersData.length > 0) {
          totalOrders = ordersData.length;
        } else {
          totalOrders = new Set(reconData.map(r => r.orderName)).size;
        }

        const totalReconIssues = reconData.filter(r => r.shopifyStatus === 'Unfulfilled').length;
        const unfulfilledData = reconData.filter(r => r.shopifyStatus === 'Unfulfilled');

        const sellerPortalStatusBreakdown = unfulfilledData.reduce((acc, curr) => {
          acc[curr.sellerPortalStatus] = (acc[curr.sellerPortalStatus] || 0) + 1;
          return acc;
        }, {});

        const storeStats = {};
        const allStatuses = new Set();

        unfulfilledData.forEach(row => {
          if (!storeStats[row.store]) storeStats[row.store] = {};
          storeStats[row.store][row.sellerPortalStatus] = (storeStats[row.store][row.sellerPortalStatus] || 0) + 1;
          allStatuses.add(row.sellerPortalStatus);
        });

        return {
          totalOrders,
          totalReconIssues,
          sellerPortalStatusBreakdown,
          storeStats,
          allStatuses: Array.from(allStatuses)
        };
      }, [ordersData, reconData, mergedData]);

      // Calculate Min/Max Dates per store for summary
      const storeDateRanges = useMemo(() => {
        if (!reconData || !isLoaded) return [];
        const ranges = {};

        reconData.forEach(row => {
          if (row.store === 'Other' || row.store === 'Consolidated Recon') return;
          const dateStr = row.createdAt;
          if (!dateStr || dateStr === '-' || dateStr === 'N/A') return;

          const d = new Date(dateStr);
          if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return;

          if (!ranges[row.store]) {
            ranges[row.store] = { min: d, max: d, minOrder: row.orderName, maxOrder: row.orderName };
          } else {
            if (d < ranges[row.store].min) { ranges[row.store].min = d; ranges[row.store].minOrder = row.orderName; }
            if (d > ranges[row.store].max) { ranges[row.store].max = d; ranges[row.store].maxOrder = row.orderName; }
          }
        });

        return Object.entries(ranges).map(([store, data]) => ({
          store,
          minDate: data.min.toLocaleString('en-ZA', { dateStyle: 'short', timeStyle: 'short' }),
          minOrder: data.minOrder,
          maxDate: data.max.toLocaleString('en-ZA', { dateStyle: 'short', timeStyle: 'short' }),
          maxOrder: data.maxOrder
        })).sort((a, b) => a.store.localeCompare(b.store));
      }, [reconData, isLoaded]);

      const reconFileStatuses = useMemo(() => {
        if (!reconData) return [];
        const counts = {};
        reconData.forEach(row => {
          if (row.sourceFile && row.sourceFile.toUpperCase().includes('RECON')) {
            const s = row.shippingStatus;
            if (s && s !== '-') {
              counts[s] = (counts[s] || 0) + 1;
            }
          }
        });
        return Object.entries(counts).map(([status, count]) => ({ status, count })).sort((a, b) => b.count - a.count);
      }, [reconData]);

      const handleOpenReconStatusModal = (status) => {
        const filtered = reconData.filter(r => 
          r.sourceFile && r.sourceFile.toUpperCase().includes('RECON') && r.shippingStatus === status
        );
        
        setModalSortConfig({ key: null, direction: 'asc' });
        setModalConfig({
          isOpen: true,
          title: `RECON File Status: ${status}`,
          data: filtered
        });
      };

      const handleOpenModal = (status, store = null) => {
        const unfulfilledData = reconData.filter(r => r.shopifyStatus === 'Unfulfilled');
        let filtered = unfulfilledData.filter(r => r.sellerPortalStatus === status);

        if (store) {
          filtered = filtered.filter(r => r.store === store);
        }

        filtered = filtered.filter(r => STORES.includes(r.store) && r.store !== 'Consolidated Recon' && r.store !== 'Other');

        setModalSortConfig({ key: null, direction: 'asc' });
        setModalConfig({
          isOpen: true,
          title: store ? `${store} Orders - ${status}` : `All Store Orders - ${status}`,
          data: filtered
        });
      };

      const handleExportCloudJson = () => {
        if (!reconData) return;

        // Format back to the exact JSON structure expected by the fetch logic
        const exportData = reconData.map(row => ({
          OrderName: row.orderName,
          Store: row.store,
          ShopifyStatus: row.shopifyStatus,
          SellerPortalStatus: row.sellerPortalStatus,
          ShippingStatus: row.shippingStatus,
          TrackingNumber: row.trackingNo,
          TrackingCompany: row.trackingCo,
          ShopifyCreatedAt: row.createdAt,
          SellerPortalStatusDate: row.statusDate,
          ShipmentID: row.shipmentId,
          SourceFile: row.sourceFile,
          items: row.items
        }));

        const dataStr = "data:text/json;charset=utf-8," + encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(exportData, null, 2));
        const downloadAnchorNode = document.createElement('a');
        downloadAnchorNode.setAttribute("href", dataStr);
        downloadAnchorNode.setAttribute("download", "Bounty_Recon_Merged.json");
        document.body.appendChild(downloadAnchorNode);
        downloadAnchorNode.click();
        downloadAnchorNode.remove();

        alert("JSON Generated Successfully!\n\nPlease open your Google Cloud Console tab and drag this downloaded 'Bounty_Recon_Merged.json' file into your Bucket. This will instantly update the data for all users fetching from the cloud.");
      };

      const StatusBadge = ({ status, type }) => {
        let colorClasses = "bg-gray-100 text-gray-800";

        if (type === 'shopify') {
          if (status === 'Unfulfilled') colorClasses = "bg-red-100 text-red-800 font-bold border border-red-200";
          else if (status.toLowerCase() === 'fulfilled') colorClasses = "bg-green-100 text-green-800";
        } else if (type === 'sellerPortal') {
          if (status === 'SHIPPED') colorClasses = "bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800";
          else if (status === 'CANCELLED') colorClasses = "bg-orange-100 text-orange-800 border border-orange-200";
          else if (status === 'ON HOLD') colorClasses = "bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 border border-amber-300 font-bold animate-pulse";
          else if (status === 'EXCEPTION') colorClasses = "bg-red-100 text-red-800 border border-red-300 font-bold";
          else if (status === 'NO RECORD FOUND') colorClasses = "bg-gray-200 text-gray-500 italic";
          else colorClasses = "bg-blue-100 text-blue-800";
        }

        return (
          <span className={`px-2 py-1 text-xs rounded-full ${colorClasses}`}>
            {status}
          </span>
        );
      };

      const isAnyFileUploaded = ordersData.length > 0 || shipmentsData.length > 0 || mergedData !== null;

      return (
        <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-50 font-sans text-slate-800">
          <header className="bg-slate-900 text-white p-6 shadow-md">
            <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto flex flex-col md:flex-row justify-between items-center">
              <div>
                <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Package className="w-6 h-6 text-blue-400" />
                  Order-Shipment Recon Dashboard
                </h1>
                <p className="text-slate-400 text-sm mt-1">Shopify Orders vs Seller Portal Dashboard</p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </header>

          <main className="max-w-7xl mx-auto p-6 space-y-6">

            {/* Upload Section */}
            <section className="bg-white p-6 rounded-xl shadow-sm border border-slate-200">
              <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-4">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                  <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-800">Data Import</h2>
                  {exclusionList.size > 0 && (
                    <span className="bg-orange-100 text-orange-800 border border-orange-200 text-xs px-2 py-1 rounded-md font-semibold">
                      {exclusionList.size} Excluded Records Synced from Live Sheet
                    </span>
                  )}
                </div>
                {isAnyFileUploaded && (
                  <button
                    onClick={handleClear}
                    className="text-sm text-red-600 hover:text-red-800 hover:underline font-medium"
                  >
                    Clear Data & Start Over
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>

              {/* Hide upload boxes once loaded to save space, show a clean summary instead */}
              {!isLoaded ? (
                <div>
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
                    <div className={`border-2 border-dashed border-slate-300 rounded-lg p-6 text-center hover:border-blue-500 transition-colors relative flex flex-col items-center justify-center ${ordersData.length ? 'bg-blue-50 border-blue-300' : 'bg-slate-50'}`}>
                      {/* Updated to allow multiple file selection */}
                      <input type="file" multiple accept=".csv, .xls, .xlsx" onChange={(e) => handleFileUpload(e, 'orders')} className="absolute inset-0 w-full h-full opacity-0 cursor-pointer z-10" />
                      <FileSpreadsheet className="w-8 h-8 text-blue-500 mx-auto mb-2" />
                      <h3 className="font-bold text-slate-700 text-base">1. Upload Orders</h3>
                      <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-1">Up to 6 Excel/CSV files</p>
                      {ordersData.length > 0 && (
                        <div className="mt-3 w-full relative z-20">
                          <span className="inline-flex items-center text-xs font-medium text-green-700 bg-green-100 border border-green-200 px-2 py-1 rounded-full mb-2"><CheckCircle2 className="w-3 h-3 mr-1" /> {ordersData.length} records loaded</span>
                          <div className="text-xs text-left w-full bg-white p-2 rounded border border-slate-200 max-h-24 overflow-y-auto mt-1">
                            <p className="font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">Loaded files:</p>
                            <ul className="list-disc pl-4 text-slate-600">
                              {ordersFileNames.map((name, i) => <li key={i} className="truncate" title={name}>{name}</li>)}
                            </ul>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>

                    <div className={`border-2 border-dashed border-slate-300 rounded-lg p-6 text-center hover:border-emerald-500 transition-colors relative flex flex-col items-center justify-center ${shipmentsData.length ? 'bg-emerald-50 border-emerald-300' : 'bg-slate-50'}`}>
                      {/* Updated to allow multiple file selection */}
                      <input type="file" multiple accept=".csv, .xls, .xlsx" onChange={(e) => handleFileUpload(e, 'shipments')} className="absolute inset-0 w-full h-full opacity-0 cursor-pointer z-10" />
                      <FileSpreadsheet className="w-8 h-8 text-emerald-500 mx-auto mb-2" />
                      <h3 className="font-bold text-slate-700 text-base">2. Upload Shipments</h3>
                      <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-1">Up to 6 Excel/CSV files</p>
                      {shipmentsData.length > 0 && (
                        <div className="mt-3 w-full relative z-20">
                          <span className="inline-flex items-center text-xs font-medium text-green-700 bg-green-100 border border-green-200 px-2 py-1 rounded-full mb-2"><CheckCircle2 className="w-3 h-3 mr-1" /> {shipmentsData.length} records loaded</span>
                          <div className="text-xs text-left w-full bg-white p-2 rounded border border-slate-200 max-h-24 overflow-y-auto mt-1">
                            <p className="font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1">Loaded files:</p>
                            <ul className="list-disc pl-4 text-slate-600">
                              {shipmentsFileNames.map((name, i) => <li key={i} className="truncate" title={name}>{name}</li>)}
                            </ul>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>

                    <div onClick={handleFetchJson} className={`border-2 border-dashed border-slate-300 rounded-lg p-6 text-center hover:border-indigo-500 transition-colors relative cursor-pointer group flex flex-col items-center justify-center ${mergedData ? 'bg-indigo-50 border-indigo-300' : 'bg-slate-50'}`}>
                      <CloudDownload className={`w-8 h-8 text-indigo-500 mx-auto mb-2 transition-transform ${isLoading ? 'animate-bounce' : 'group-hover:scale-110'}`} />
                      <h3 className="font-bold text-slate-700 text-base">3. Fetch from Cloud</h3>
                      <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-1">{isLoading ? 'Fetching JSON...' : 'Load Bounty_Recon_Merged.json'}</p>
                      {mergedData && <span className="mt-2 inline-flex items-center text-xs text-indigo-700 bg-indigo-100 border border-indigo-200 px-2 py-1 rounded-full"><CheckCircle2 className="w-3 h-3 mr-1" /> {mergedData.length} loaded</span>}
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {!isAnyFileUploaded ? (
                    <div className="mt-4 text-center text-sm text-slate-500 bg-slate-50 py-3 rounded-md border border-slate-100">
                      You can upload multiple files at once. You can select all 6 store exports together by highlighting them in the upload window.
                    </div>
                  ) : (
                    <div className="mt-6 flex justify-center border-t border-slate-100 pt-6 animate-in fade-in zoom-in duration-300">
                      <button
                        onClick={handleLoad}
                        className="px-8 py-3 bg-indigo-600 text-white text-lg font-bold rounded-lg shadow-md hover:bg-indigo-700 hover:shadow-lg hover:scale-105 transition-all flex items-center gap-2"
                      >
                        <PlayCircle className="w-5 h-5" />
                        Load Data
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 bg-slate-50 p-4 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 animate-in fade-in duration-300">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
                    <CheckCircle2 className="w-8 h-8 text-green-600" />
                    <div className="flex-1">
                      <h3 className="font-bold text-slate-800 text-base">Dashboard Successfully Loaded</h3>
                      <p className="text-sm text-slate-600">
                        {getLoadMessageText()}
                      </p>
                      {loadTimestamp && (
                        <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-1 flex items-center gap-1 font-medium">
                          <Clock className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Data processed on: {loadTimestamp.toLocaleString()}
                        </p>
                      )}
                    </div>
                    {!mergedData && reconData && (
                      <button
                        onClick={handleExportCloudJson}
                        className="px-4 py-2 bg-emerald-600 text-white rounded-md text-sm font-bold hover:bg-emerald-700 transition-colors shadow-sm flex items-center gap-2 animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-right-4"
                      >
                        <CloudDownload className="w-4 h-4" />
                        Export JSON for Cloud
                      </button>
                    )}
                  </div>

                  {storeDateRanges.length > 0 && (
                    <div className="mt-2 border-t border-slate-200 pt-4">
                      <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-700 mb-3 flex items-center gap-2">
                        <Calendar className="w-4 h-4 text-indigo-500" />
                        Order Date Range Summary
                      </h4>
                      <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                        <table className="w-full text-left text-xs bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-md shadow-sm">
                          <thead className="bg-slate-100 border-b border-slate-200">
                            <tr>
                              <th className="px-4 py-2.5 font-semibold text-slate-600 border-r border-slate-200">Store</th>
                              <th className="px-4 py-2.5 font-semibold text-slate-600 border-r border-slate-200">Oldest Order</th>
                              <th className="px-4 py-2.5 font-semibold text-slate-600 border-r border-slate-200">Oldest Created At</th>
                              <th className="px-4 py-2.5 font-semibold text-slate-600 border-r border-slate-200">Most Recent Order</th>
                              <th className="px-4 py-2.5 font-semibold text-slate-600">Most Recent Created At</th>
                            </tr>
                          </thead>
                          <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100">
                            {storeDateRanges.map(range => (
                              <tr key={range.store} className="hover:bg-slate-50">
                                <td className="px-4 py-2 font-bold text-slate-800 border-r border-slate-100">{range.store}</td>
                                <td className="px-4 py-2 text-slate-600 border-r border-slate-100">{range.minOrder}</td>
                                <td className="px-4 py-2 text-slate-600 border-r border-slate-100 font-mono">{range.minDate}</td>
                                <td className="px-4 py-2 text-slate-600 border-r border-slate-100">{range.maxOrder}</td>
                                <td className="px-4 py-2 text-slate-600 font-mono">{range.maxDate}</td>
                              </tr>
                            ))}
                          </tbody>
                        </table>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              )}
            </section>

            {isLoaded && reconData && stats && (
              <div className="space-y-6 animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-bottom-4 duration-500">
                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
                  <div className="bg-white p-5 rounded-xl shadow-sm border border-slate-200 flex items-center justify-between">
                    <div>
                      <p className="text-sm text-slate-500 font-medium">Total Orders Analyzed</p>
                      <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-slate-800">{stats.totalOrders}</p>
                    </div>
                    <div className="p-3 bg-blue-50 rounded-lg text-blue-600"><BarChart3 className="w-6 h-6" /></div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="bg-white p-5 rounded-xl shadow-sm border border-red-100 flex items-center justify-between">
                    <div>
                      <p className="text-sm text-slate-500 font-medium">Shopify Unfulfilled</p>
                      <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-slate-800">{stats.totalReconIssues}</p>
                    </div>
                    <div className="p-3 bg-red-50 rounded-lg text-red-600"><AlertTriangle className="w-6 h-6" /></div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="bg-white p-5 rounded-xl shadow-sm border border-slate-200 flex items-center justify-between">
                    <div className="w-full">
                      <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-2 w-full">
                        <p className="text-sm text-slate-500 font-medium">Data Status</p>
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-xs text-green-600 flex items-center"><CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 mr-1" /> Fully reconciled & aggregated</div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm border border-slate-200 overflow-hidden">
                  <div className="border-b border-slate-200 p-4 bg-slate-50/50 flex flex-col gap-4">
                    <div className="flex flex-col lg:flex-row justify-between items-center gap-4">
                      <div className="flex bg-slate-200/50 p-1 rounded-lg w-full lg:w-auto overflow-x-auto">
                        {STORES.map(store => (
                          <button
                            key={store}
                            onClick={() => setActiveTab(store)}
                            className={`px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium rounded-md whitespace-nowrap transition-colors ${activeTab === store ? (store === 'Consolidated Recon' ? 'bg-indigo-600 shadow-sm text-white' : 'bg-white shadow-sm text-blue-700') : 'text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-200'}`}
                          >
                            {store}
                          </button>
                        ))}
                      </div>

                      {activeTab !== 'Consolidated Recon' && (
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 w-full lg:w-auto flex-wrap lg:flex-nowrap">
                          <div className="relative flex-1 lg:w-64">
                            <Search className="w-4 h-4 absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400" />
                            <input
                              type="text"
                              placeholder="Search Name or Shipment..."
                              value={searchQuery}
                              onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
                              className="w-full pl-9 pr-4 py-2 text-sm border border-slate-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500"
                            />
                          </div>
                          <button
                            onClick={() => setShowOnlyUnfulfilled(!showOnlyUnfulfilled)}
                            className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium rounded-lg border transition-colors ${showOnlyUnfulfilled ? 'bg-blue-50 border-blue-200 text-blue-700' : 'bg-white border-slate-300 text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50'}`}
                          >
                            <Filter className="w-4 h-4" />
                            {showOnlyUnfulfilled ? 'Showing: Unfulfilled Only' : 'Showing: All Orders'}
                          </button>
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                    
                    {/* RECON Status Tabs */}
                    {reconFileStatuses.length > 0 && (
                      <div className="pt-3 border-t border-slate-200 w-full animate-in fade-in">
                        <h4 className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">Recon File Shipping Statuses</h4>
                        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                          {reconFileStatuses.map(status => (
                            <button
                              key={status.status}
                              onClick={() => handleOpenReconStatusModal(status.status)}
                              className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-md text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 hover:bg-indigo-50 hover:text-indigo-700 hover:border-indigo-300 transition-colors shadow-sm flex items-center gap-2"
                            >
                              {status.status}
                              <span className="bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-bold">{status.count}</span>
                            </button>
                          ))}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>

                  {activeTab === 'Consolidated Recon' ? (
                    <div className="p-6 bg-slate-50">
                      <div className="mb-6">
                        <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-800 mb-2">Seller Portal Status Breakdown (Unfulfilled Shopify Orders)</h2>
                        <p className="text-sm text-slate-500">This view aggregates all Shopify orders currently sitting in an <strong>Unfulfilled</strong> state and cross-references them against their current status in the Seller Portal.</p>
                      </div>

                      <div className="bg-white rounded-lg border border-slate-200 overflow-hidden mb-8 shadow-sm">
                        <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                          <table className="w-full text-left text-sm whitespace-nowrap">
                            <thead className="bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-900 uppercase text-xs font-bold border-b border-indigo-100">
                              <tr>
                                <th className="px-6 py-4">Store</th>
                                {stats.allStatuses.map(status => (
                                  <th key={status} className="px-6 py-4 text-center">{status}</th>
                                ))}
                                <th className="px-6 py-4 text-center bg-indigo-100/50">Total</th>
                              </tr>
                            </thead>
                            <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100">
                              {STORES.filter(s => s !== 'Consolidated Recon' && s !== 'Other').map(store => {
                                const storeTotal = stats.allStatuses.reduce((sum, status) => sum + (stats.storeStats[store]?.[status] || 0), 0);
                                return (
                                  <tr key={store} className="hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors">
                                    <td className="px-6 py-4 font-semibold text-slate-800">{store}</td>
                                    {stats.allStatuses.map(status => {
                                      const count = stats.storeStats[store]?.[status] || 0;
                                      return (
                                        <td key={status} className="px-6 py-4 text-center">
                                          {count > 0 ? (
                                            <button
                                              onClick={() => handleOpenModal(status, store)}
                                              className="inline-flex items-center justify-center bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 hover:bg-indigo-600 hover:text-white hover:scale-105 hover:shadow-md transition-all px-2.5 py-1 rounded font-bold border border-indigo-200 cursor-pointer"
                                              title={`View ${count} records for ${store} - ${status}`}
                                            >
                                              {count}
                                            </button>
                                          ) : (
                                            <span className="text-slate-300">-</span>
                                          )}
                                        </td>
                                      );
                                    })}
                                    <td className="px-6 py-4 text-center font-bold text-indigo-700 bg-indigo-50/30">
                                      {storeTotal}
                                    </td>
                                  </tr>
                                );
                              })}
                              <tr className="bg-slate-100 font-bold border-t-2 border-slate-200">
                                <td className="px-6 py-4 text-slate-900">GRAND TOTAL</td>
                                {stats.allStatuses.map(status => {
                                  const statusTotal = STORES.filter(s => s !== 'Consolidated Recon' && s !== 'Other').reduce((sum, store) => sum + (stats.storeStats[store]?.[status] || 0), 0);
                                  return (
                                    <td key={status} className="px-6 py-4 text-center text-slate-800">
                                      {statusTotal}
                                    </td>
                                  );
                                })}
                                <td className="px-6 py-4 text-center text-indigo-900 bg-indigo-100/50">
                                  {stats.totalReconIssues}
                                </td>
                              </tr>
                            </tbody>
                          </table>
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
                        {stats.allStatuses.map(status => {
                          const totalForStatus = STORES.filter(s => s !== 'Consolidated Recon' && s !== 'Other').reduce((sum, store) => sum + (stats.storeStats[store]?.[status] || 0), 0);
                          if (totalForStatus === 0) return null;

                          return (
                            <div key={status} className="bg-white p-5 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 shadow-sm">
                              <h3 className="font-bold text-slate-700 mb-4 flex justify-between items-center">
                                <span>Status: {status}</span>
                                <button
                                  onClick={() => handleOpenModal(status)}
                                  className="text-sm bg-indigo-50 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-md text-indigo-700 font-bold border border-indigo-200 hover:bg-indigo-600 hover:text-white hover:scale-105 hover:shadow-md transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-2"
                                  title="Click to view all records"
                                >
                                  Total: {totalForStatus}
                                  <Search className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                                </button>
                              </h3>
                              <div className="space-y-1">
                                {STORES.filter(s => s !== 'Consolidated Recon' && s !== 'Other').map(store => {
                                  const count = stats.storeStats[store]?.[status] || 0;
                                  const percentage = totalForStatus > 0 ? (count / totalForStatus) * 100 : 0;

                                  if (count === 0) return null;

                                  return (
                                    <div
                                      key={store}
                                      onClick={() => handleOpenModal(status, store)}
                                      className="relative pt-2 pb-1 px-2 cursor-pointer group rounded-md hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors"
                                      title={`Click to view ${store} records`}
                                    >
                                      <div className="flex mb-1 items-center justify-between">
                                        <div>
                                          <span className="text-xs font-semibold inline-block text-slate-600 group-hover:text-indigo-700 transition-colors">
                                            {store}
                                          </span>
                                        </div>
                                        <div className="text-right">
                                          <span className="text-xs font-semibold inline-block text-slate-600 group-hover:text-indigo-700 transition-colors">
                                            {count}
                                          </span>
                                        </div>
                                      </div>
                                      <div className="overflow-hidden h-2 mb-1 text-xs flex rounded bg-slate-100">
                                        <div style={{ width: `${percentage}%` }} className="shadow-none flex flex-col text-center whitespace-nowrap text-white justify-center bg-indigo-500 group-hover:bg-indigo-600 rounded transition-all duration-500"></div>
                                      </div>
                                    </div>
                                  );
                                })}
                              </div>
                            </div>
                          );
                        })}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  ) : (
                    <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                      <table className="w-full text-left text-sm whitespace-nowrap">
                        <thead className="bg-slate-50 text-slate-600 uppercase text-xs font-semibold border-b border-slate-200">
                          <tr>
                            {renderSortableHeader("Order Name", "orderName", false)}
                            {renderSortableHeader("Shipment ID", "shipmentId", false)}
                            {renderSortableHeader("Shopify Fulfillment Status", "shopifyStatus", false)}
                            {renderSortableHeader("Seller Portal Status", "sellerPortalStatus", false)}
                            {renderSortableHeader("Tracking Number", "trackingNo", false)}
                            {renderSortableHeader("Tracking Company", "trackingCo", false)}
                            {renderSortableHeader("Order Created at", "createdAt", false)}
                            {renderSortableHeader("Shipment Status Date", "statusDate", false)}
                          </tr>
                        </thead>
                        <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100">
                          {sortedFilteredData.length > 0 ? (
                            sortedFilteredData.map((row) => (
                              <tr
                                key={row.id}
                                onClick={() => setShipmentModal(row)}
                                className="hover:bg-indigo-50/50 transition-colors cursor-pointer group"
                                title="Click to view shipment details"
                              >
                                <td className="px-6 py-3 font-medium text-slate-900 group-hover:text-indigo-700">{row.orderName}</td>
                                <td className="px-6 py-3 text-slate-600 font-mono text-xs font-bold">{row.shipmentId}</td>
                                <td className="px-6 py-3"><StatusBadge status={row.shopifyStatus} type="shopify" /></td>
                                <td className="px-6 py-3"><StatusBadge status={row.sellerPortalStatus} type="sellerPortal" /></td>
                                <td className="px-6 py-3">{renderTrackingLink(row.trackingNo, row.trackingCo, false)}</td>
                                <td className="px-6 py-3 text-slate-600">{row.trackingCo}</td>
                                <td className="px-6 py-3 text-slate-500 text-xs">{row.createdAt}</td>
                                <td className="px-6 py-3 text-slate-500 text-xs">{row.statusDate}</td>
                              </tr>
                            ))
                          ) : (
                            <tr>
                              <td colSpan="8" className="px-6 py-12 text-center text-slate-500">
                                <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center">
                                  <Package className="w-12 h-12 text-slate-300 mb-3" />
                                  <p className="text-lg font-medium text-slate-700">No matching records found.</p>
                                  <p className="text-sm mt-1">Try adjusting your filters or search terms for {activeTab}.</p>
                                </div>
                              </td>
                            </tr>
                          )}
                        </tbody>
                      </table>
                    </div>
                  )}

                  {activeTab !== 'Consolidated Recon' && (
                    <div className="bg-slate-50 p-4 border-t border-slate-200 text-xs text-slate-500 flex justify-between items-center">
                      <span>Showing {sortedFilteredData.length} records for {activeTab}</span>
                      <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-indigo-600"><Info className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Click any row to view shipment details & items</span>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
          </main>

          {modalConfig.isOpen && (
            <div className="fixed inset-0 z-40 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-slate-900/60 backdrop-blur-sm animate-in fade-in duration-200">
              <div className="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-2xl w-full max-w-6xl max-h-[90vh] flex flex-col animate-in zoom-in-95 duration-200 overflow-hidden">
                <div className="flex justify-between items-center p-5 border-b border-slate-200 bg-slate-50">
                  <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-slate-800 flex items-center gap-2">
                    <Search className="w-5 h-5 text-indigo-500" />
                    Records: {modalConfig.title}
                  </h2>
                  <button
                    onClick={() => setModalConfig({ ...modalConfig, isOpen: false })}
                    className="text-slate-400 hover:text-red-600 bg-white hover:bg-red-50 border border-slate-200 hover:border-red-200 p-2 rounded-full transition-colors"
                  >
                    <X className="w-5 h-5" />
                  </button>
                </div>

                <div className="overflow-auto p-0 flex-1 bg-white">
                  <table className="w-full text-left text-sm whitespace-nowrap">
                    <thead className="bg-slate-50 text-slate-600 uppercase text-xs font-semibold border-b border-slate-200 sticky top-0 z-10 shadow-sm">
                      <tr>
                        {renderSortableHeader("Order Name", "orderName", true)}
                        {renderSortableHeader("Shipment ID", "shipmentId", true)}
                        {renderSortableHeader("Shopify Status", "shopifyStatus", true)}
                        {renderSortableHeader("Seller Portal Status", "sellerPortalStatus", true)}
                        {renderSortableHeader("Tracking Number", "trackingNo", true)}
                        {renderSortableHeader("Tracking Company", "trackingCo", true)}
                        {renderSortableHeader("Order Created At", "createdAt", true)}
                        {renderSortableHeader("Shipment Status Date", "statusDate", true)}
                      </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100">
                      {sortedModalData.map((row) => (
                        <tr
                          key={row.id}
                          onClick={() => setShipmentModal(row)}
                          className="hover:bg-indigo-50/50 transition-colors cursor-pointer group"
                          title="Click to view shipment details"
                        >
                          <td className="px-6 py-3 font-bold text-slate-900 group-hover:text-indigo-700">{row.orderName}</td>
                          <td className="px-6 py-3 text-slate-600 font-mono text-xs font-bold">{row.shipmentId}</td>
                          <td className="px-6 py-3"><StatusBadge status={row.shopifyStatus} type="shopify" /></td>
                          <td className="px-6 py-3"><StatusBadge status={row.sellerPortalStatus} type="sellerPortal" /></td>
                          <td className="px-6 py-3">{renderTrackingLink(row.trackingNo, row.trackingCo, false)}</td>
                          <td className="px-6 py-3 text-slate-600">{row.trackingCo}</td>
                          <td className="px-6 py-3 text-slate-500 text-xs">{row.createdAt}</td>
                          <td className="px-6 py-3 text-slate-500 text-xs">{row.statusDate}</td>
                        </tr>
                      ))}
                    </tbody>
                  </table>
                </div>

                <div className="p-4 border-t border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 text-sm text-slate-500 rounded-b-xl flex justify-between items-center">
                  <span>Showing <strong>{modalConfig.data.length}</strong> records. Click a row to see line items.</span>
                  <button
                    onClick={() => setModalConfig({ ...modalConfig, isOpen: false })}
                    className="px-4 py-2 bg-slate-800 text-white rounded-lg text-sm font-medium hover:bg-slate-900 transition-colors"
                  >
                    Close View
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {shipmentModal && (
            <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-slate-900/70 backdrop-blur-sm animate-in fade-in duration-200">
              <div className="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-2xl w-full max-w-2xl max-h-[90vh] flex flex-col animate-in zoom-in-95 duration-200 overflow-hidden">

                <div className="flex justify-between items-start p-6 border-b border-slate-200 bg-slate-50">
                  <div>
                    <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-slate-800 flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
                      <Package className="w-6 h-6 text-indigo-500" />
                      Shipment & Item Details
                    </h2>
                    <div className="text-slate-500 font-mono text-sm">{shipmentModal.shipmentId}</div>
                  </div>
                  <button
                    onClick={() => setShipmentModal(null)}
                    className="text-slate-400 hover:text-red-600 bg-white hover:bg-red-50 border border-slate-200 hover:border-red-200 p-2 rounded-full transition-colors"
                  >
                    <X className="w-5 h-5" />
                  </button>
                </div>

                <div className="overflow-y-auto p-6 space-y-6 flex-1">
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                    <div className="bg-slate-50 p-4 rounded-lg border border-slate-100">
                      <div className="text-xs text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider font-semibold mb-1">Order Name</div>
                      <div className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-800">{shipmentModal.orderName}</div>
                      <div className="text-xs text-slate-400 mt-1">Store: {shipmentModal.store}</div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="bg-slate-50 p-4 rounded-lg border border-slate-100">
                      <div className="text-xs text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider font-semibold mb-2">Current Statuses</div>
                      <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 items-start">
                        <StatusBadge status={shipmentModal.shopifyStatus} type="shopify" />
                        <StatusBadge status={shipmentModal.sellerPortalStatus} type="sellerPortal" />
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6 bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-lg p-5">
                    <div>
                      <h4 className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-3 border-b border-slate-100 pb-2">Tracking Information</h4>
                      <div className="space-y-2">
                        <div>
                          <span className="text-xs text-slate-500 block">Courier Company</span>
                          <span className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-800">{shipmentModal.trackingCo}</span>
                        </div>
                        <div>
                          <span className="text-xs text-slate-500 block mb-1">Tracking Number</span>
                          {renderTrackingLink(shipmentModal.trackingNo, shipmentModal.trackingCo, true)}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <h4 className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-3 border-b border-slate-100 pb-2">Timeline</h4>
                      <div className="space-y-2">
                        <div>
                          <span className="text-xs text-slate-500 block">Order Created At</span>
                          <span className="text-sm text-slate-800">{shipmentModal.createdAt}</span>
                        </div>
                        <div>
                          <span className="text-xs text-slate-500 block">Shipment Status Date</span>
                          <span className="text-sm text-slate-800">{shipmentModal.statusDate}</span>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div>
                    <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-800 mb-3">Line Items in Shipment</h3>
                    <div className="border border-slate-200 rounded-lg overflow-hidden">
                      <table className="w-full text-left text-sm">
                        <thead className="bg-slate-50 text-slate-600 text-xs font-semibold border-b border-slate-200">
                          <tr>
                            <th className="px-4 py-3">SKU / Item Name</th>
                            <th className="px-4 py-3 text-right">Quantity</th>
                          </tr>
                        </thead>
                        <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100">
                          {shipmentModal.items && shipmentModal.items.length > 0 ? (
                            shipmentModal.items.map((item, idx) => (
                              <tr key={idx} className="bg-white">
                                <td className="px-4 py-3 font-medium text-slate-800">{item.name || 'Unknown Item'}</td>
                                <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right font-bold text-slate-600 bg-slate-50/50 w-24">{item.quantity || '1'}</td>
                              </tr>
                            ))
                          ) : (
                            <tr className="bg-white">
                              <td colSpan="2" className="px-4 py-6 text-center text-slate-500 italic text-xs">
                                No item-level data found for this shipment.
                              </td>
                            </tr>
                          )}
                        </tbody>
                      </table>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="p-4 border-t border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 flex justify-between items-center">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                    <label className="flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 bg-white border border-slate-200 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-md hover:bg-slate-100 transition-colors">
                      <input
                        type="checkbox"
                        checked={excludeChecked}
                        onChange={e => setExcludeChecked(e.target.checked)}
                        className="w-4 h-4 text-red-600 rounded border-slate-300 focus:ring-red-500"
                      />
                      Exclude this Order
                    </label>
                    {excludeChecked && (
                      <button
                        onClick={() => handleSaveExclusion(shipmentModal.orderName)}
                        className="px-4 py-1.5 bg-red-600 text-white rounded-md text-xs font-bold hover:bg-red-700 transition-colors shadow-sm animate-in fade-in"
                      >
                        Save to Live Sheet
                      </button>
                    )}
                  </div>
                  <button
                    onClick={() => setShipmentModal(null)}
                    className="px-5 py-2 bg-indigo-600 text-white rounded-lg text-sm font-medium hover:bg-indigo-700 transition-colors shadow-sm"
                  >
                    Close
                  </button>
                </div>

              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      );
    }

    const root = ReactDOM.createRoot(document.getElementById('root'));
    root.render(<App />);
  </script>

import csv, collections

# Check reference file
ref_path = r'C:\Users\Taswell\Downloads\Reebok_SHIPMENT_RECON_2026-08-01_to_2026-08-02.csv'
with open(ref_path, encoding='utf-8-sig') as f:
    rows = list(csv.DictReader(f, delimiter=';'))

qtys = set(r.get('Quantity','') for r in rows)
print('Quantity values in reference:', qtys)
print('Total rows:', len(rows))
print()
print('Sample rows (Shipment ID | Item Name | Quantity):')
for r in rows[:5]:
    shp = r.get('Shipment ID', '')
    item = r.get('Item Name', '')
    qty = r.get('Quantity', '')
    print(f'  {shp} | {item} | Qty: {qty}')

print()
# Check if any item appears multiple times in same shipment (would confirm qty-expansion)
per_shp = collections.defaultdict(list)
for r in rows:
    per_shp[r.get('Shipment ID','')].append(r.get('Item Name',''))

dupes = {k: v for k, v in per_shp.items() if len(v) != len(set(v))}
print(f'Shipments with duplicate item names: {len(dupes)}')
if dupes:
    for k, v in list(dupes.items())[:3]:
        print(f'  {k}: {v}')

print()
# Check our export for same
ours_path = 'Exports/Reebok_SHIPMENT_RECON_2026-08-01_to_2026-08-23.csv'
with open(ours_path, encoding='utf-8-sig') as f:
    our_rows = list(csv.DictReader(f, delimiter=';'))
print('Our export total rows:', len(our_rows))
our_qtys = set(r.get('Quantity','') for r in our_rows)
print('Quantity values in ours:', our_qtys)
print()
# Total sum of qtys in our export
total_qty_ours = sum(int(r.get('Quantity','0') or '0') for r in our_rows)
print('Sum of all quantities in our export:', total_qty_ours)
