"""
Parcelninja Desktop Exporter Core Module
Handles store configurations, retry sessions, concurrent fetching across stores, and writing exports.
"""

from __future__ import annotations
import concurrent.futures
from dataclasses import dataclass
import datetime
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import threading
import time
from typing import Any, Callable

import requests
from requests.adapters import HTTPAdapter
from urllib3.util.retry import Retry

import pnj_report_fetch
import shipment_report

DEFAULT_EXPORT_DIR = Path.cwd() / "Exports"
DEFAULT_SECRETS_PATH = Path.cwd() / "storesenv2.txt"
BASE_URL = "https://storeapi.parcelninja.com/api/v1"
MAX_STORE_WORKERS = 4
REQUEST_TIMEOUT = 30
RETRY_BACKOFF = [1, 2, 4]

# Canonical display names mapping
NAME_NORMALIZATION = {
    "reebok": "Reebok",
    "diesel": "Diesel",
    "hurley": "Hurley",
    "jeep": "Jeep",
    "jeep_apparel": "Jeep Apparel",
    "superdry": "Superdry",
    "levis": "Levis",
    "levi": "Levis",
    "vans": "Vans",
    "cl": "CL",
    "bounty_brands": "Bounty Brands",
    "bounty": "Bounty Brands",
    "skechers": "Skechers",
}

DEFAULT_STORE_NAMES = [
    "Reebok",
    "Diesel",
    "Hurley",
    "Jeep Apparel",
    "Superdry",
    "Levis",
    "CL",
    "Bounty Brands",
    "Vans",
    "Skechers",
]


@dataclass
class StoreConfig:
    name: str
    key: str
    password: str
    display_name: str
    base_url: str = BASE_URL


@dataclass
class ApiResult:
    ok: bool
    data: Any = None
    error: str | None = None
    status_code: int | None = None


# Create global session with connection pooling
global_session = requests.Session()
retry_strategy = Retry(
    total=3,
    backoff_factor=1,
    status_forcelist=[429, 500, 502, 503, 504],
    respect_retry_after_header=True,
)
adapter = HTTPAdapter(max_retries=retry_strategy, pool_connections=20, pool_maxsize=20)
global_session.mount("https://", adapter)
global_session.mount("http://", adapter)


def _canonical_name(name: str) -> str:
    cleaned = name.strip().lower().replace(" ", "_").replace("-", "_")
    return NAME_NORMALIZATION.get(cleaned, name.strip().title())


def load_stores_config(config_path: Path | str | None = None) -> dict[str, StoreConfig]:
    """
    Loads store credentials from storesenv2.txt, PNJ- Store Con.txt, or environment.
    Normalizes names so casing matches across TOML sections and environment variables.
    """
    candidates = [
        Path(config_path) if config_path else None,
        Path.cwd() / "storesenv2.txt",
        Path.cwd() / ".streamlit" / "secrets.toml",
        Path.cwd() / "PNJ- Store Con.txt",
        Path.cwd() / "Shipment Control Centre - Store Con.txt",
        Path(__file__).parent / "storesenv2.txt" if "__file__" in globals() else None,
    ]

    stores: dict[str, StoreConfig] = {}

    for cand in candidates:
        if cand and cand.is_file():
            try:
                text = cand.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")
                lines = text.strip().splitlines()
                current_section = None
                
                for line in lines:
                    line = line.strip()
                    if not line or line.startswith("#"):
                        continue
                    
                    if line.startswith("[") and line.endswith("]"):
                        raw_sec = line[1:-1].strip()
                        current_section = _canonical_name(raw_sec)
                        stores.setdefault(current_section, StoreConfig(name=current_section, key="", password="", display_name=current_section))
                        continue

                    if "=" in line:
                        k, _, v = line.partition("=")
                        k = k.strip()
                        v = v.strip().strip('"').strip("'")
                        k_upper = k.upper()

                        if current_section:
                            if k.lower() in ["username", "user", "key", "api_username", "api_user", "api_key"]:
                                stores[current_section].key = v
                                continue
                            elif k.lower() in ["password", "secret", "pwd", "pass", "api_password", "api_secret"]:
                                stores[current_section].password = v
                                continue

                        matched = False
                        for raw_key, canon in NAME_NORMALIZATION.items():
                            prefix = raw_key.upper()
                            if k_upper.startswith(prefix):
                                rest = k_upper[len(prefix):].lstrip("_")
                                stores.setdefault(canon, StoreConfig(name=canon, key="", password="", display_name=canon))
                                if any(x in rest for x in ["USER", "KEY", "USERNAME"]):
                                    stores[canon].key = v
                                    matched = True
                                elif any(x in rest for x in ["PASS", "PWD", "SECRET"]):
                                    stores[canon].password = v
                                    matched = True
                                break

                        if not matched:
                            if k_upper in ["STORE", "STORE_NAME", "NAME"]:
                                current_section = _canonical_name(v)
                                stores.setdefault(current_section, StoreConfig(name=current_section, key="", password="", display_name=current_section))
                            elif k_upper in ["KEY", "USERNAME", "USER"] and current_section:
                                stores[current_section].key = v
                            elif k_upper in ["PASSWORD", "SECRET", "PWD", "PASS"] and current_section:
                                stores[current_section].password = v
            except Exception:
                pass

    # Ensure known default stores are available in map
    for d in DEFAULT_STORE_NAMES:
        if d not in stores:
            stores[d] = StoreConfig(name=d, key="", password="", display_name=d)

    return stores


def get_with_retry(
    url: str,
    store: StoreConfig,
    params: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    timeout: int = REQUEST_TIMEOUT,
) -> ApiResult:
    """
    Executes a GET request against Parcelninja API using Basic Auth with retry backoff.
    """
    if not store.key or not store.password:
        return ApiResult(
            ok=False,
            error=f"No API credentials configured for store '{store.name}'. Please check storesenv2.txt.",
        )

    auth = (store.key, store.password)
    headers = {
        "Accept": "application/json",
        "User-Agent": "ParcelNinjaReconExporter/2.0",
    }

    last_error = None
    for attempt, delay in enumerate(RETRY_BACKOFF, start=1):
        try:
            resp = global_session.get(url, auth=auth, params=params, headers=headers, timeout=timeout)
            if resp.status_code == 200:
                try:
                    data = resp.json()
                    return ApiResult(ok=True, data=data, status_code=200)
                except Exception as je:
                    return ApiResult(ok=False, error=f"Invalid JSON response: {je}", status_code=200)
            elif resp.status_code == 429:
                retry_after = int(resp.headers.get("Retry-After", delay))
                time.sleep(retry_after)
                continue
            elif resp.status_code in [400, 401, 403, 404]:
                return ApiResult(ok=False, error=f"HTTP {resp.status_code}: {resp.text[:200]}", status_code=resp.status_code)
            else:
                last_error = f"HTTP {resp.status_code}: {resp.text[:200]}"
        except requests.exceptions.RequestException as re:
            last_error = str(re)

        time.sleep(delay)

    return ApiResult(ok=False, error=last_error or "Unknown API error")


def run_export(
    start_date: datetime.date,
    end_date: datetime.date,
    selected_store_names: list[str],
    output_dir: Path | str = DEFAULT_EXPORT_DIR,
    stores_config: dict[str, StoreConfig] | None = None,
    progress: Callable[[str], None] | None = None,
    stop_event: threading.Event | None = None,
) -> tuple[Path | None, Path | None, list[str]]:
    """
    Executes the full export workflow:
    1. Fetches outbound shipments for selected stores
    2. Flattens into reporting rows
    3. Writes XLSX and CSV reports to output_dir
    """
    def log(msg: str):
        if progress:
            progress(msg)

    if not selected_store_names:
        raise ValueError("Select at least one store.")

    out_path = Path(output_dir)
    out_path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    if stores_config is None:
        stores_config = load_stores_config()

    all_outbounds: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    all_errors: list[str] = []

    log(f"Starting export for {len(selected_store_names)} store(s): {', '.join(selected_store_names)} from {start_date} to {end_date} (inclusive)...")

    def fetch_store(s_name: str) -> tuple[str, pnj_report_fetch.ReportOutcome]:
        st = stores_config.get(s_name, StoreConfig(name=s_name, key="", password="", display_name=s_name))
        if not st.key or not st.password:
            log(f"⚠️ [{s_name}] No API credentials found in storesenv2.txt.")
        log(f"[{s_name}] Fetching outbounds...")
        outcome = pnj_report_fetch.fetch_outbound_report_for_store(
            get_with_retry=get_with_retry,
            base_url=st.base_url,
            store=st,
            store_name=s_name,
            start_date=start_date,
            end_date=end_date,
            stop_event=stop_event,
        )
        return s_name, outcome

    max_w = min(MAX_STORE_WORKERS, len(selected_store_names))
    with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=max_w) as executor:
        futures = [executor.submit(fetch_store, s) for s in selected_store_names]
        for f in concurrent.futures.as_completed(futures):
            if stop_event and stop_event.is_set():
                log("Export stopped by user.")
                break
            try:
                s_name, outcome = f.result()
                all_outbounds.extend(outcome.records)
                all_errors.extend(outcome.errors)
                log(f"[{s_name}] Completed: {outcome.shipment_count} shipment(s), {len(outcome.errors)} error(s)")
            except Exception as ex:
                all_errors.append(f"Store execution exception: {ex}")

    if stop_event and stop_event.is_set():
        return None, None, all_errors

    log(f"Total shipments collected: {len(all_outbounds)}. Converting to report rows...")
    rows = shipment_report.flatten_outbounds_to_report_rows(all_outbounds)
    log(f"Generated {len(rows)} report item row(s).")

    # Filename format
    s_label = start_date.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
    e_label = end_date.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
    store_prefix = f"{selected_store_names[0]}_" if len(selected_store_names) == 1 else ""
    base_name = f"{store_prefix}SHIPMENT_RECON_{s_label}_to_{e_label}"

    xlsx_file = out_path / f"{base_name}.xlsx"
    csv_file = out_path / f"{base_name}.csv"
    json_file = out_path / f"{base_name}.json"

    # Write XLSX
    log(f"Saving Excel report: {xlsx_file.name}...")
    xlsx_bytes = shipment_report.report_rows_to_xlsx(rows)
    xlsx_file.write_bytes(xlsx_bytes)
    log(f"Saved Excel report: {xlsx_file.name}")

    # Write CSV
    log(f"Saving CSV report: {csv_file.name}...")
    csv_bytes = shipment_report.report_rows_to_csv(rows)
    csv_file.write_bytes(csv_bytes)
    log(f"Saved CSV report: {csv_file.name}")

    log(f"Saving JSON report: {json_file.name}...")
    json_file.write_bytes(shipment_report.report_rows_to_json(rows))
    log(f"Saved JSON report: {json_file.name}")

    return xlsx_file, csv_file, all_errors

from __future__ import annotations

import concurrent.futures
import json
import sys
import time
import tomllib
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Callable

import requests
from requests.adapters import HTTPAdapter
from requests.auth import HTTPBasicAuth
from requests.exceptions import ConnectionError, ReadTimeout, RequestException
from urllib3.util.retry import Retry

from pnj_report_fetch import ReportOutcome, fetch_outbound_report_for_store
from shipment_report import flatten_outbounds_to_report_rows, report_rows_to_xlsx


BASE_URL = "https://storeapi.parcelninja.com/api/v1"
PAGE_SIZE = 100
MAX_PAGES = 40
MAX_STORE_WORKERS = 4
REPORT_DETAIL_WORKERS = 4
REQUEST_TIMEOUT = 15
RETRY_BACKOFF = [1, 2, 4, 8]
def _get_default_export_dir() -> Path:
    onedrive_docs = Path.home() / "OneDrive" / "Documents"
    if onedrive_docs.exists():
        return onedrive_docs / "Seller Portal" / "Shipment exports"
    local_docs = Path.home() / "Documents"
    if local_docs.exists():
        return local_docs / "Seller Portal" / "Shipment exports"
    return Path.home() / "Seller Portal" / "Shipment exports"

DEFAULT_EXPORT_DIR = _get_default_export_dir()
DEFAULT_SECRETS_PATH = Path(".streamlit") / "secrets.toml"

STORE_KEYS = {
    "Diesel": "diesel",
    "Jeep Apparel": "jeep_apparel",
    "Reebok": "reebok",
    "Levi's": "levis",
}


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class StoreConfig:
    name: str
    username: str
    password: str
    store_id: str

    def auth(self) -> HTTPBasicAuth:
        return HTTPBasicAuth(self.username, self.password)

    def headers(self) -> dict[str, str]:
        return {"Accept": "application/json", "X-Store-Id": self.store_id}


@dataclass
class ApiResult:
    data: dict[str, Any] | None
    ok: bool
    status_code: int
    error: str | None = None


@dataclass
class ExportResult:
    xlsx_path: Path
    json_path: Path
    shipment_count: int
    row_count: int
    errors: list[str]
    capped: bool


def bundled_path(relative_path: Path) -> Path:
    bundle_root = getattr(sys, "_MEIPASS", None)
    if bundle_root:
        return Path(bundle_root) / relative_path
    return relative_path


def load_stores_from_toml(path: Path = DEFAULT_SECRETS_PATH) -> dict[str, StoreConfig]:
    # 1. Try Streamlit Secrets (for Cloud Deployment)
    try:
        import streamlit as st
        if hasattr(st, "secrets") and st.secrets:
            stores: dict[str, StoreConfig] = {}
            missing: list[str] = []
            for display_name, key in STORE_KEYS.items():
                if key in st.secrets:
                    section = st.secrets[key]
                    stores[display_name] = StoreConfig(
                        name=display_name,
                        username=section["username"],
                        password=section["password"],
                        store_id=section["store_id"],
                    )
                else:
                    missing.append(key)
            
            if not missing:
                return stores
            # If some are missing from st.secrets, fall back to TOML file
    except Exception:
        pass

    # 2. Fall back to local TOML file
    if not path.exists():
        bundled = bundled_path(path)
        if bundled.exists():
            path = bundled
    if not path.exists():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"Store config not found: {path}")

    data = tomllib.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    stores: dict[str, StoreConfig] = {}
    missing: list[str] = []

    for display_name, key in STORE_KEYS.items():
        section = data.get(key)
        if not section:
            missing.append(key)
            continue
        stores[display_name] = StoreConfig(
            name=display_name,
            username=section["username"],
            password=section["password"],
            store_id=section["store_id"],
        )

    if missing:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Missing store config section(s): {', '.join(missing)}")
    return stores


# Initialize a global thread-safe session with robust connection pooling and automatic 429 handling
global_session = requests.Session()
retry_strategy = Retry(
    total=6,
    backoff_factor=1,
    status_forcelist=[429, 500, 502, 503, 504],
    respect_retry_after_header=True
)
adapter = HTTPAdapter(max_retries=retry_strategy, pool_connections=20, pool_maxsize=40)
global_session.mount("https://", adapter)
global_session.mount("http://", adapter)

def get_with_retry(url: str, store: StoreConfig, params: dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> ApiResult:
    last_error: str | None = None
    for attempt, delay in enumerate(RETRY_BACKOFF):
        try:
            response = global_session.get(
                url,
                auth=store.auth(),
                headers=store.headers(),
                params=params,
                timeout=REQUEST_TIMEOUT,
            )

            if response.status_code == 200:
                return ApiResult(data=response.json(), ok=True, status_code=200)

            last_error = f"HTTP {response.status_code}: {response.text[:300]}"
            if response.status_code in (429, 503) and attempt < len(RETRY_BACKOFF) - 1:
                time.sleep(int(response.headers.get("Retry-After", delay)))
                continue
            return ApiResult(data=None, ok=False, status_code=response.status_code, error=last_error)

        except (ReadTimeout, ConnectionError) as exc:
            last_error = f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"
            if attempt < len(RETRY_BACKOFF) - 1:
                time.sleep(delay)
        except RequestException as exc:
            last_error = f"Request failed: {exc}"
            break

    return ApiResult(data=None, ok=False, status_code=0, error=last_error or "Unknown API error")


def fetch_outbound_report(
    store_name: str,
    store: StoreConfig,
    start_date: datetime,
    end_date: datetime,
    api_getter: Callable[[str, StoreConfig, dict[str, Any] | None], ApiResult] = get_with_retry,
    stop_event: threading.Event | None = None,
) -> ReportOutcome:
    return fetch_outbound_report_for_store(
        get_with_retry=api_getter,
        base_url=BASE_URL,
        store=store,
        store_name=store_name,
        start_date=start_date,
        end_date=end_date,
        page_size=PAGE_SIZE,
        max_pages=MAX_PAGES,
        detail_workers=REPORT_DETAIL_WORKERS,
        stop_event=stop_event,
    )


def run_export(
    selected_store_names: list[str],
    start_date: datetime,
    end_date: datetime,
    output_dir: Path = DEFAULT_EXPORT_DIR,
    stores: dict[str, StoreConfig] | None = None,
    progress: Callable[[str], None] | None = None,
    api_getter: Callable[[str, StoreConfig, dict[str, Any] | None], ApiResult] = get_with_retry,
    stop_event: threading.Event | None = None,
) -> ExportResult:
    stores = stores or load_stores_from_toml()
    selected = {name: stores[name] for name in selected_store_names}
    if not selected:
        raise ValueError("Select at least one store.")

    output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    all_outbounds: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    all_errors: list[str] = []
    shipment_count = 0
    capped = False

    if progress:
        progress(f"Fetching {len(selected)} store(s)...")

    with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=min(MAX_STORE_WORKERS, len(selected))) as executor:
        futures = {
            executor.submit(fetch_outbound_report, name, store, start_date, end_date, api_getter, stop_event): name
            for name, store in selected.items()
        }

        for future in concurrent.futures.as_completed(futures):
            if stop_event and stop_event.is_set():
                continue
            store_name = futures[future]
            outcome = future.result()
            all_outbounds.extend(outcome.records)
            all_errors.extend(outcome.errors)
            shipment_count += outcome.shipment_count
            capped = capped or outcome.capped
            if progress:
                progress(f"{store_name}: {outcome.shipment_count} shipment(s), {len(outcome.errors)} error(s)")

    if stop_event and stop_event.is_set():
        raise InterruptedError("Export stopped by user.")

    rows = flatten_outbounds_to_report_rows(all_outbounds)
    start_label = start_date.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
    end_label = end_date.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
    base_name = f"SHIPMENT_RECON_{start_label}_to_{end_label}"
    json_path = output_dir / f"{base_name}.json"

    if progress:
        progress(f"Writing {len(rows)} item row(s)...")

    xlsx_path = output_dir / f"{base_name}.xlsx"
    xlsx_path.write_bytes(report_rows_to_xlsx(rows))
    json_payload = build_json_payload(
        start_date=start_date,
        end_date=end_date,
        selected_stores=list(selected.keys()),
        shipment_count=shipment_count,
        rows=rows,
        errors=all_errors,
        capped=capped,
    )
    json_path.write_text(json.dumps(json_payload, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")

    if progress:
        progress(f"Saved XLSX: {xlsx_path}")
        progress(f"Saved JSON: {json_path}")

    return ExportResult(
        xlsx_path=xlsx_path,
        json_path=json_path,
        shipment_count=shipment_count,
        row_count=len(rows),
        errors=all_errors,
        capped=capped,
    )


def build_json_payload(
    start_date: datetime,
    end_date: datetime,
    selected_stores: list[str],
    shipment_count: int,
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    errors: list[str],
    capped: bool,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "metadata": {
            "dateRange": {
                "from": start_date.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"),
                "to": end_date.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"),
            },
            "selectedStores": selected_stores,
            "generatedAt": datetime.now().isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
            "shipmentCount": shipment_count,
            "itemRowCount": len(rows),
            "apiErrorCount": len(errors),
            "capped": capped,
        },
        "rows": rows,
        "errors": errors,
    }


--- ParcelNinja/pnj_inbound_fetch.py ---

from __future__ import annotations

import concurrent.futures
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime
from typing import Any, Callable


@dataclass
class InboundReportOutcome:
    records: list[dict[str, Any]]
    return_count: int = 0
    capped: bool = False
    errors: list[str] = None

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        if self.errors is None:
            self.errors = []


def fetch_inbound_return_report_for_store(
    get_with_retry: Callable[[str, Any, dict[str, Any] | None], Any],
    base_url: str,
    store: Any,
    store_name: str,
    start_date: datetime,
    end_date: datetime,
    page_size: int,
    max_pages: int,
    detail_workers: int,
) -> InboundReportOutcome:
    sd = start_date.strftime("%Y%m%d")
    ed = end_date.strftime("%Y%m%d")
    errors: list[str] = []
    capped = False
    summaries: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    active_page_size = page_size

    for page in range(1, max_pages + 1):
        params = {
            "pageSize": active_page_size,
            "page": page,
            "startDate": sd,
            "endDate": ed,
            "orderTypeId": 3,
            "orderBy": "createDate",
            "orderDirection": "desc",
        }
        result = get_with_retry(f"{base_url}/inbounds", store, params)

        if not result.ok and page == 1 and active_page_size > 50:
            active_page_size = 50
            params["pageSize"] = active_page_size
            result = get_with_retry(f"{base_url}/inbounds", store, params)
            if result.ok:
                errors.append(f"{store_name}/inbounds p1: pageSize {page_size} rejected; retried with 50")

        if not result.ok:
            errors.append(f"{store_name}/inbounds p{page}: {result.error}")
            break

        page_summaries = result.data.get("inbounds", [])
        if not page_summaries:
            break

        summaries.extend(page_summaries)

        if len(page_summaries) < active_page_size:
            break

        if page == max_pages:
            capped = True

    records, detail_errors = fetch_inbound_details_parallel(
        get_with_retry=get_with_retry,
        base_url=base_url,
        store=store,
        store_name=store_name,
        summaries=summaries,
        detail_workers=detail_workers,
    )
    errors.extend(detail_errors)

    return InboundReportOutcome(
        records=records,
        return_count=len(records),
        capped=capped,
        errors=errors,
    )


def fetch_inbound_details_parallel(
    get_with_retry: Callable[[str, Any, dict[str, Any] | None], Any],
    base_url: str,
    store: Any,
    store_name: str,
    summaries: list[dict[str, Any]],
    detail_workers: int,
) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], list[str]]:
    inbound_ids = [
        summary.get("id")
        for summary in summaries
        if summary.get("id") not in (None, "")
    ]
    if not inbound_ids:
        return [], []

    records_by_id: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
    errors: list[str] = []

    def fetch_detail(inbound_id: Any) -> tuple[Any, Any]:
        result = get_with_retry(f"{base_url}/inbounds/{inbound_id}/events", store, None)
        return inbound_id, result

    with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=max(1, detail_workers)) as executor:
        futures = {executor.submit(fetch_detail, inbound_id): inbound_id for inbound_id in inbound_ids}
        for future in concurrent.futures.as_completed(futures):
            inbound_id, result = future.result()
            if result.ok and result.data:
                result.data["_store"] = store_name
                result.data["_type"] = "inbound_return_report"
                records_by_id[str(inbound_id)] = result.data
            else:
                errors.append(f"{store_name}/inbounds/{inbound_id}/events: {result.error}")

    ordered_records = [
        records_by_id[str(inbound_id)]
        for inbound_id in inbound_ids
        if str(inbound_id) in records_by_id
    ]
    return ordered_records, errors

"""
Parcelninja Recon Exporter - Desktop Application (Tkinter GUI)
Provides a graphical user interface for selecting stores, date ranges, and exporting recon reports to Excel/CSV.
"""

from __future__ import annotations
import datetime
import os
from pathlib import Path
import threading
import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import filedialog, messagebox, ttk
from tkinter.scrolledtext import ScrolledText

import pnj_desktop_exporter_core


class ReconExporterApp(tk.Tk):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.title("Parcelninja Recon Exporter")
        self.geometry("820x680")
        self.minsize(740, 580)

        # Style configuration
        self.style = ttk.Style(self)

            self.style.theme_use("clam")

            pass

        # 1. Date Range Section

            date_frame,

        stores_grid_frame.pack(fill=tk.X, pady=(4, 0))

        row = 0

        for s_name in store_names:
            var = tk.BooleanVar(value=(s_name == "Reebok"))
            self.store_vars[s_name] = var
            chk = ttk.Checkbutton(stores_grid_frame, text=s_name, variable=var)
            chk.grid(row=row, column=col, sticky="w", padx=12, pady=3)
            col += 1
            if col > 3:
                col = 0
                row += 1

        out_frame = ttk.LabelFrame(main_frame, text=" 3. Output Directory ", padding="10")

        self.out_dir_var = tk.StringVar(value=str(default_dir))

        ttk.Button(out_frame, text="Browse...", command=self._browse_output_dir).pack(side=tk.RIGHT)

        action_frame = ttk.Frame(main_frame, padding="5")
        action_frame.pack(fill=tk.X, pady=(0, 8))

        self.export_btn = ttk.Button(
            action_frame,
            text="🚀 Export Recon Report",
            command=self._start_export_thread,
        )
        self.export_btn.pack(side=tk.LEFT, padx=(0, 10), ipady=4)

        self.stop_btn = ttk.Button(
            action_frame,
            text="⏹ Stop",
            command=self._stop_export,
            state=tk.DISABLED,
        )
        self.stop_btn.pack(side=tk.LEFT, ipady=4)

        self.progress_bar = ttk.Progressbar(action_frame, mode="indeterminate")
        self.progress_bar.pack(side=tk.RIGHT, fill=tk.X, expand=True, padx=(10, 0))

        # 5. Activity Log
        log_frame = ttk.LabelFrame(main_frame, text=" Activity Log ", padding="5")
        log_frame.pack(fill=tk.BOTH, expand=True)

        self.log_text = ScrolledText(log_frame, height=6, wrap=tk.WORD, font=("Consolas", 9))
        self.log_text.pack(fill=tk.BOTH, expand=True)

    def _select_all_stores(self):
        for v in self.store_vars.values():
            v.set(True)

    def _deselect_all_stores(self):
        for v in self.store_vars.values():
            v.set(False)

    def _browse_output_dir(self):
        selected = filedialog.askdirectory(initialdir=self.out_dir_var.get())
        if selected:
            self.out_dir_var.set(selected)

    def _log(self, message: str):
        now_str = datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%H:%M:%S")
        self.log_text.insert(tk.END, f"[{now_str}] {message}\n")
        self.log_text.see(tk.END)

    def _parse_date(self, s: str) -> datetime.date:
        s = s.strip()
        for fmt in ("%Y-%m-%d", "%d-%m-%Y", "%d/%m/%Y", "%Y/%m/%d"):
            try:
                return datetime.datetime.strptime(s, fmt).date()
            except ValueError:
                pass
        raise ValueError(f"Invalid date format: '{s}'. Expected YYYY-MM-DD or DD-MM-YYYY.")

    def _start_export_thread(self):
        if self.is_exporting:
            return

        try:
            start_date = self._parse_date(self.start_date_ent.get())
            end_date = self._parse_date(self.end_date_ent.get())
        except Exception as e:
            messagebox.showerror("Date Error", str(e))
            return

        if start_date > end_date:
            messagebox.showerror("Date Error", "Start Date cannot be after End Date.")
            return

        selected_stores = [name for name, var in self.store_vars.items() if var.get()]
        if not selected_stores:
            messagebox.showerror("Store Selection", "Please select at least one store.")
            return

        out_dir = Path(self.out_dir_var.get())
        self.is_exporting = True
        self.stop_event = threading.Event()

        self.export_btn.config(state=tk.DISABLED)
        self.stop_btn.config(state=tk.NORMAL)
        self.progress_bar.start(10)

        threading.Thread(
            target=self._run_export_worker,
            args=(start_date, end_date, selected_stores, out_dir),
            daemon=True,
        ).start()

    def _stop_export(self):
        if self.stop_event:
            self.stop_event.set()
            self._log("Stopping export requested...")

    def _run_export_worker(
        self,
        start_date: datetime.date,
        end_date: datetime.date,
        selected_stores: list[str],
        out_dir: Path,
    ):
        try:
            xlsx_path, csv_path, errors = pnj_desktop_exporter_core.run_export(
                start_date=start_date,
                end_date=end_date,
                selected_store_names=selected_stores,
                output_dir=out_dir,
                stores_config=self.stores_config,
                progress=lambda msg: self.after(0, self._log, msg),
                stop_event=self.stop_event,
            )

            if xlsx_path and xlsx_path.exists():
                self.after(0, self._on_export_success, xlsx_path, csv_path, errors)
            else:
                self.after(0, self._on_export_cancelled)
        except Exception as e:
            self.after(0, self._on_export_error, str(e))

    def _on_export_success(self, xlsx_path: Path, csv_path: Path | None, errors: list[str]):
        self._reset_ui_state()
        self._log("✅ Export completed successfully!")
        err_msg = f"\n\nWarnings/Errors: {len(errors)}" if errors else ""
        messagebox.showinfo(
            "Export Complete",
            f"Reconciliation reports generated successfully:\n\nExcel: {xlsx_path.name}\n\nFolder: {xlsx_path.parent}{err_msg}",
        )

    def _on_export_cancelled(self):
        self._reset_ui_state()
        self._log("Export stopped/cancelled.")

    def _on_export_error(self, err_msg: str):
        self._reset_ui_state()
        self._log(f"❌ Error: {err_msg}")
        messagebox.showerror("Export Error", f"An error occurred during export:\n\n{err_msg}")

    def _reset_ui_state(self):
        self.is_exporting = False
        self.progress_bar.stop()
        self.export_btn.config(state=tk.NORMAL)
        self.stop_btn.config(state=tk.DISABLED)


def main():
    app = ReconExporterApp()
    app.mainloop()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
