from __future__ import annotations

import threading
import tkinter as tk
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from pathlib import Path
from tkinter import filedialog, messagebox, ttk

from pnj_desktop_exporter_core import DEFAULT_EXPORT_DIR, STORE_KEYS, run_export


class ReconExporterApp(tk.Tk):
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self.title("Parcelninja Recon Exporter")
        self.geometry("760x560")
        self.minsize(720, 520)

        self.output_dir = tk.StringVar(value=str(DEFAULT_EXPORT_DIR))
        today = datetime.now().date()
        self.from_date = tk.StringVar(value=(today - timedelta(days=1)).strftime("%Y-%m-%d"))
        self.to_date = tk.StringVar(value=today.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"))
        self.store_vars = {name: tk.BooleanVar(value=True) for name in STORE_KEYS}
        self.is_running = False
        self.stop_event = threading.Event()

        self._build_ui()

    def _build_ui(self) -> None:
        root = ttk.Frame(self, padding=18)
        root.pack(fill=tk.BOTH, expand=True)

        title = ttk.Label(root, text="Parcelninja Shipment Recon Export", font=("Segoe UI", 16, "bold"))
        title.pack(anchor="w")

        subtitle = ttk.Label(
            root,
            text="Fetch selected stores and save CSV + JSON outputs.",
            foreground="#555555",
        )
        subtitle.pack(anchor="w", pady=(2, 16))

        form = ttk.Frame(root)
        form.pack(fill=tk.X)
        form.columnconfigure(1, weight=1)
        form.columnconfigure(3, weight=1)

        ttk.Label(form, text="From date").grid(row=0, column=0, sticky="w", padx=(0, 8), pady=6)
        ttk.Entry(form, textvariable=self.from_date, width=16).grid(row=0, column=1, sticky="w", pady=6)
        ttk.Label(form, text="To date").grid(row=0, column=2, sticky="w", padx=(24, 8), pady=6)
        ttk.Entry(form, textvariable=self.to_date, width=16).grid(row=0, column=3, sticky="w", pady=6)

        ttk.Label(form, text="Output folder").grid(row=1, column=0, sticky="w", padx=(0, 8), pady=6)
        ttk.Entry(form, textvariable=self.output_dir).grid(row=1, column=1, columnspan=2, sticky="ew", pady=6)
        ttk.Button(form, text="Change Folder", command=self.change_folder).grid(row=1, column=3, sticky="e", pady=6)

        stores_frame = ttk.LabelFrame(root, text="Stores", padding=12)
        stores_frame.pack(fill=tk.X, pady=(16, 12))

        for idx, (name, var) in enumerate(self.store_vars.items()):
            ttk.Checkbutton(stores_frame, text=name, variable=var).grid(
                row=idx // 3,
                column=idx % 3,
                sticky="w",
                padx=(0, 28),
                pady=4,
            )

        actions = ttk.Frame(root)
        actions.pack(fill=tk.X, pady=(2, 12))
        self.run_button = ttk.Button(actions, text="Run Export", command=self.run_export_clicked)
        self.run_button.pack(side=tk.LEFT)
        self.stop_button = ttk.Button(actions, text="Stop", command=self.stop_export, state=tk.DISABLED)
        self.stop_button.pack(side=tk.LEFT, padx=(10, 0))
        ttk.Button(actions, text="Select All", command=lambda: self.set_all_stores(True)).pack(side=tk.LEFT, padx=(10, 0))
        ttk.Button(actions, text="Clear Stores", command=lambda: self.set_all_stores(False)).pack(side=tk.LEFT, padx=(10, 0))

        self.progress = ttk.Progressbar(root, mode="indeterminate")
        self.progress.pack(fill=tk.X, pady=(0, 10))

        log_frame = ttk.LabelFrame(root, text="Progress", padding=8)
        log_frame.pack(fill=tk.BOTH, expand=True)
        self.log_text = tk.Text(log_frame, height=13, wrap="word", state=tk.DISABLED)
        self.log_text.pack(side=tk.LEFT, fill=tk.BOTH, expand=True)
        scroll = ttk.Scrollbar(log_frame, command=self.log_text.yview)
        scroll.pack(side=tk.RIGHT, fill=tk.Y)
        self.log_text.configure(yscrollcommand=scroll.set)

        self.log("Ready.")

    def change_folder(self) -> None:
        folder = filedialog.askdirectory(initialdir=self.output_dir.get() or str(Path.home()))
        if folder:
            self.output_dir.set(folder)

    def set_all_stores(self, value: bool) -> None:
        for var in self.store_vars.values():
            var.set(value)

    def parse_date(self, value: str) -> datetime:
        return datetime.strptime(value.strip(), "%Y-%m-%d")

    def selected_stores(self) -> list[str]:
        return [name for name, var in self.store_vars.items() if var.get()]

    def run_export_clicked(self) -> None:
        if self.is_running:
            return

        try:
            start_date = self.parse_date(self.from_date.get())
            end_date = self.parse_date(self.to_date.get())
        except ValueError:
            messagebox.showerror("Invalid date", "Use YYYY-MM-DD for both dates.")
            return

        if start_date > end_date:
            messagebox.showerror("Invalid date range", "From date must be before or equal to To date.")
            return

        stores = self.selected_stores()
        if not stores:
            messagebox.showerror("No stores selected", "Select at least one store.")
            return

        output_dir = Path(self.output_dir.get())
        self.is_running = True
        self.stop_event.clear()
        self.run_button.configure(state=tk.DISABLED)
        self.stop_button.configure(state=tk.NORMAL)
        self.progress.start(12)
        self.log("")
        self.log("Starting export...")

        thread = threading.Thread(
            target=self._run_export_worker,
            args=(stores, start_date, end_date, output_dir),
            daemon=True,
        )
        thread.start()

    def stop_export(self) -> None:
        if self.is_running:
            self.log("Stopping export...")
            self.stop_event.set()
            self.stop_button.configure(state=tk.DISABLED)

    def _run_export_worker(
        self,
        stores: list[str],
        start_date: datetime,
        end_date: datetime,
        output_dir: Path,
    ) -> None:
        try:
            result = run_export(
                selected_store_names=stores,
                start_date=start_date,
                end_date=end_date,
                output_dir=output_dir,
                progress=lambda message: self.after(0, self.log, message),
                stop_event=self.stop_event,
            )
            self.after(0, self.export_finished, result)
        except InterruptedError:
            self.after(0, self.export_stopped)
        except Exception as exc:
            self.after(0, self.export_failed, exc)

    def export_stopped(self) -> None:
        self.progress.stop()
        self.run_button.configure(state=tk.NORMAL)
        self.stop_button.configure(state=tk.DISABLED)
        self.is_running = False
        self.log("Export stopped by user.")
        messagebox.showwarning("Export stopped", "The export process was cancelled.")

    def export_finished(self, result) -> None:
        self.progress.stop()
        self.run_button.configure(state=tk.NORMAL)
        self.stop_button.configure(state=tk.DISABLED)
        self.is_running = False
        self.log(f"Done. Shipments: {result.shipment_count}; item rows: {result.row_count}; errors: {len(result.errors)}")
        if result.capped:
            self.log("Warning: one or more stores hit the page cap. Narrow the date range if needed.")
        messagebox.showinfo(
            "Export complete",
            f"Saved:\n{result.xlsx_path}\n\n{result.json_path}",
        )

    def export_failed(self, exc: Exception) -> None:
        self.progress.stop()
        self.run_button.configure(state=tk.NORMAL)
        self.stop_button.configure(state=tk.DISABLED)
        self.is_running = False
        self.log(f"Failed: {exc}")
        messagebox.showerror("Export failed", str(exc))

    def log(self, message: str) -> None:
        self.log_text.configure(state=tk.NORMAL)
        self.log_text.insert(tk.END, f"{message}\n")
        self.log_text.see(tk.END)
        self.log_text.configure(state=tk.DISABLED)


def main() -> None:
    app = ReconExporterApp()
    app.mainloop()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()


--- ParcelNinja/pnj_report_fetch-DESKTOP-TASWELL.py ---

"""
Parcelninja Report Fetch Module
Fetches outbound shipment records with inclusive dates, detail fetching, and robust error handling.
"""

from __future__ import annotations
import concurrent.futures
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
import datetime
import threading
from typing import Any, Callable

BASE_URL = "https://storeapi.parcelninja.com/api/v1"
PAGE_SIZE = 50
MAX_PAGES = 1000
REPORT_DETAIL_WORKERS = 8


@dataclass
class ReportOutcome:
    records: list[dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)
    shipment_count: int = 0
    capped: bool = False
    errors: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)


def fetch_outbound_details_parallel(
    get_with_retry: Callable[[str, Any, dict[str, Any] | None], Any],
    base_url: str,
    store: Any,
    store_name: str,
    summaries: list[dict[str, Any]],
    detail_workers: int = 8,
    stop_event: threading.Event | None = None,
) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], list[str]]:
    """
    Fetches detailed outbound records and event history in parallel for each summary item.
    Always merges the original summary so no shipment is ever lost even if detail/event endpoint fails.
    """
    records_by_id: dict[int | str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
    detail_errors: list[str] = []
    
    for s in summaries:
        s_id = s.get("id")
        if s_id is not None:
            base_rec = dict(s)
            base_rec["_store"] = store_name
            records_by_id[s_id] = base_rec

    def fetch_detail(summary_item: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[Any, dict[str, Any], list[str]]:
        if stop_event and stop_event.is_set():
            return summary_item.get("id"), {}, []
        
        ob_id = summary_item.get("id")
        errs: list[str] = []
        full_record = dict(summary_item)
        full_record["_store"] = store_name

        # 1. Fetch detailed outbound
        res_detail = get_with_retry(f"{base_url}/outbounds/{ob_id}", store)
        if getattr(res_detail, "ok", False) and getattr(res_detail, "data", None):
            det_data = res_detail.data
            if isinstance(det_data, dict):
                full_record.update(det_data)
        elif getattr(res_detail, "error", None):
            errs.append(f"/outbounds/{ob_id}: {res_detail.error}")

        # 2. Fetch event history
        res_events = get_with_retry(f"{base_url}/outbounds/{ob_id}/events", store)
        if getattr(res_events, "ok", False) and getattr(res_events, "data", None):
            ev_data = res_events.data
            if isinstance(ev_data, dict):
                full_record["events"] = ev_data.get("events") or []
            elif isinstance(ev_data, list):
                full_record["events"] = ev_data
        elif getattr(res_events, "error", None):
            pass

        full_record["_store"] = store_name
        return ob_id, full_record, errs

    max_w = min(detail_workers, max(len(summaries), 1))
    with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=max_w) as executor:
        future_map = {executor.submit(fetch_detail, s): s.get("id") for s in summaries}
        for future in concurrent.futures.as_completed(future_map):
            if stop_event and stop_event.is_set():
                break
            try:
                ob_id, record, errs = future.result()
                if ob_id is not None and record:
                    records_by_id[ob_id] = record
                if errs:
                    detail_errors.extend(errs)
            except Exception as ex:
                s_id = future_map[future]
                detail_errors.append(f"Detail fetch exception for {s_id}: {ex}")

    ordered_records = [records_by_id[s.get("id")] for s in summaries if s.get("id") in records_by_id]
    return ordered_records, detail_errors


def fetch_outbound_report_for_store(
    get_with_retry: Callable[[str, Any, dict[str, Any] | None], Any],
    base_url: str,
    store: Any,
    store_name: str,
    start_date: datetime.date,
    end_date: datetime.date,
    page_size: int = PAGE_SIZE,
    max_pages: int = MAX_PAGES,
    detail_workers: int = REPORT_DETAIL_WORKERS,
    stop_event: threading.Event | None = None,
) -> ReportOutcome:
    """
    Fetches all outbound shipments for a store within the specified date range.
    CRITICAL: Adds +1 day to end_date so the query is fully inclusive of all orders on the end date.
    """
    errors: list[str] = []
    page_summaries: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    # Inclusive date calculation
    api_end_date = end_date + datetime.timedelta(days=1)
    sd = start_date.strftime("%Y%m%d")
    ed = api_end_date.strftime("%Y%m%d")

    active_page_size = page_size
    capped = False

    for p in range(1, max_pages + 1):
        if stop_event and stop_event.is_set():
            errors.append(f"{store_name}: Stopped by user.")
            break

        params = {
            "pageSize": active_page_size,
            "page": p,
            "startDate": sd,
            "endDate": ed,
            "orderBy": "createDate",
            "orderDirection": "desc",
        }

        result = get_with_retry(f"{base_url}/outbounds", store, params)

        if not getattr(result, "ok", False) and active_page_size > 50:
            active_page_size = 50
            params["pageSize"] = active_page_size
            result = get_with_retry(f"{base_url}/outbounds", store, params)

        if not getattr(result, "ok", False):
            errors.append(f"{store_name} /outbounds p{p}: {getattr(result, 'error', 'Unknown error')}")
            break

        data = getattr(result, "data", {}) or {}
        outbounds = data.get("outbounds") or []
        if not outbounds:
            break

        page_summaries.extend(outbounds)

        if len(outbounds) < active_page_size:
            break
    else:
        capped = True

    # Fetch detailed outbounds in parallel
    detailed_records, detail_errs = fetch_outbound_details_parallel(
        get_with_retry=get_with_retry,
        base_url=base_url,
        store=store,
        store_name=store_name,
        summaries=page_summaries,
        detail_workers=detail_workers,
        stop_event=stop_event,
    )
    errors.extend(detail_errs)

    return ReportOutcome(
        records=detailed_records,
        shipment_count=len(detailed_records),
        capped=capped,
        errors=errors,
    )


--- ParcelNinja/pnj_report_fetch.py ---

from __future__ import annotations

import concurrent.futures
import threading
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from typing import Any, Callable


@dataclass
class ReportOutcome:
    records: list[dict[str, Any]]
    shipment_count: int = 0
    capped: bool = False
    errors: list[str] = None

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        if self.errors is None:
            self.errors = []


def fetch_outbound_report_for_store(
    get_with_retry: Callable[[str, Any, dict[str, Any] | None], Any],
    base_url: str,
    store: Any,
    store_name: str,
    start_date: datetime,
    end_date: datetime,
    page_size: int,
    max_pages: int,
    detail_workers: int,
    stop_event: threading.Event | None = None,
) -> ReportOutcome:
    sd = start_date.strftime("%Y%m%d")
    ed = (end_date + timedelta(days=1)).strftime("%Y%m%d")
    errors: list[str] = []
    capped = False
    summaries: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    active_page_size = page_size

    for page in range(1, max_pages + 1):
        if stop_event and stop_event.is_set():
            errors.append(f"{store_name}: Stopped by user.")
            break

        result = get_with_retry(
            f"{base_url}/outbounds",
            store,
            {
                "pageSize": active_page_size,
                "page": page,
                "startDate": sd,
                "endDate": ed,
                "orderBy": "createDate",
                "orderDirection": "desc",
            },
        )

        if not result.ok:
            if page == 1 and active_page_size > 50:
                active_page_size = 50
                result = get_with_retry(
                    f"{base_url}/outbounds",
                    store,
                    {
                        "pageSize": active_page_size,
                        "page": page,
                        "startDate": sd,
                        "endDate": ed,
                        "orderBy": "createDate",
                        "orderDirection": "desc",
                    },
                )
                if result.ok:
                    errors.append(f"{store_name}/outbounds p1: pageSize {page_size} rejected; retried with 50")
                else:
                    errors.append(f"{store_name}/outbounds p{page}: {result.error}")
                    break
            else:
                errors.append(f"{store_name}/outbounds p{page}: {result.error}")
                break

        page_summaries = result.data.get("outbounds", [])
        if not page_summaries:
            break

        summaries.extend(page_summaries)

        if len(page_summaries) < active_page_size:
            break

        if page == max_pages:
            capped = True

    if stop_event and stop_event.is_set():
        return ReportOutcome(records=[], shipment_count=0, capped=capped, errors=errors)

    records, detail_errors = fetch_outbound_details_parallel(
        get_with_retry=get_with_retry,
        base_url=base_url,
        store=store,
        store_name=store_name,
        summaries=summaries,
        detail_workers=detail_workers,
        stop_event=stop_event,
    )
    errors.extend(detail_errors)

    return ReportOutcome(
        records=records,
        shipment_count=len(records),
        capped=capped,
        errors=errors,
    )


def fetch_outbound_details_parallel(
    get_with_retry: Callable[[str, Any, dict[str, Any] | None], Any],
    base_url: str,
    store: Any,
    store_name: str,
    summaries: list[dict[str, Any]],
    detail_workers: int,
    stop_event: threading.Event | None = None,
) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], list[str]]:
    outbound_ids = [
        summary.get("id")
        for summary in summaries
        if summary.get("id") not in (None, "")
    ]
    if not outbound_ids:
        return [], []

    store_id = getattr(store, "store_id", "")
    if isinstance(store, dict):
        store_id = store.get("store_id", "")

    # Initialize with summary data as fallback
    records_by_id: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {
        str(s.get("id")): {
            **s,
            "_store": store_name,
            "_store_id": store_id,
            "_type": "outbound_report_summary",
        }
        for s in summaries
        if s.get("id")
    }
    
    errors: list[str] = []
    max_workers = max(1, detail_workers)

    def fetch_detail(outbound_id: Any) -> tuple[Any, Any]:
        if stop_event and stop_event.is_set():
            return outbound_id, None
        result = get_with_retry(f"{base_url}/outbounds/{outbound_id}/events", store, None)
        return outbound_id, result

    with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=max_workers) as ex:
        futures = {
            ex.submit(fetch_detail, outbound_id): outbound_id
            for outbound_id in outbound_ids
        }

        for future in concurrent.futures.as_completed(futures):
            if stop_event and stop_event.is_set():
                continue
            
            outbound_id, result = future.result()
            if result is None:
                continue

            if result.ok and result.data:
                # Merge detailed data over summary data
                detailed_data = result.data
                detailed_data["_store"] = store_name
                detailed_data["_store_id"] = store_id
                detailed_data["_type"] = "outbound_report"
                records_by_id[str(outbound_id)] = detailed_data
            else:
                # Keep summary data but log error
                errors.append(f"{store_name}/outbounds/{outbound_id}/events: {result.error}")

    # Return in original order
    ordered_records = [
        records_by_id[str(outbound_id)]
        for outbound_id in outbound_ids
        if str(outbound_id) in records_by_id
    ]
    return ordered_records, errors


--- ParcelNinja/pnj_returns_exporter_app.py ---

from __future__ import annotations

import threading
import tkinter as tk
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from pathlib import Path
from tkinter import filedialog, messagebox, ttk

from pnj_desktop_exporter_core import STORE_KEYS
from pnj_returns_exporter_core import DEFAULT_RETURN_EXPORT_DIR, run_return_export


class ReturnsExporterApp(tk.Tk):
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self.title("Parcelninja Returns Exporter")
        self.geometry("760x560")
        self.minsize(720, 520)

        self.output_dir = tk.StringVar(value=str(DEFAULT_RETURN_EXPORT_DIR))
        today = datetime.now().date()
        self.from_date = tk.StringVar(value=(today - timedelta(days=90)).strftime("%Y-%m-%d"))
        self.to_date = tk.StringVar(value=today.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"))
        self.store_vars = {name: tk.BooleanVar(value=True) for name in STORE_KEYS}
        self.is_running = False

        self._build_ui()

    def _build_ui(self) -> None:
        root = ttk.Frame(self, padding=18)
        root.pack(fill=tk.BOTH, expand=True)

        ttk.Label(root, text="Parcelninja Inbound Returns Export", font=("Segoe UI", 16, "bold")).pack(anchor="w")
        ttk.Label(
            root,
            text="Fetch selected stores and save merged return XLSX + JSON outputs.",
            foreground="#555555",
        ).pack(anchor="w", pady=(2, 16))

        form = ttk.Frame(root)
        form.pack(fill=tk.X)
        form.columnconfigure(1, weight=1)
        form.columnconfigure(3, weight=1)

        ttk.Label(form, text="From date").grid(row=0, column=0, sticky="w", padx=(0, 8), pady=6)
        ttk.Entry(form, textvariable=self.from_date, width=16).grid(row=0, column=1, sticky="w", pady=6)
        ttk.Label(form, text="To date").grid(row=0, column=2, sticky="w", padx=(24, 8), pady=6)
        ttk.Entry(form, textvariable=self.to_date, width=16).grid(row=0, column=3, sticky="w", pady=6)

        ttk.Label(form, text="Output folder").grid(row=1, column=0, sticky="w", padx=(0, 8), pady=6)
        ttk.Entry(form, textvariable=self.output_dir).grid(row=1, column=1, columnspan=2, sticky="ew", pady=6)
        ttk.Button(form, text="Change Folder", command=self.change_folder).grid(row=1, column=3, sticky="e", pady=6)

        stores_frame = ttk.LabelFrame(root, text="Stores", padding=12)
        stores_frame.pack(fill=tk.X, pady=(16, 12))
        for idx, (name, var) in enumerate(self.store_vars.items()):
            ttk.Checkbutton(stores_frame, text=name, variable=var).grid(
                row=idx // 3,
                column=idx % 3,
                sticky="w",
                padx=(0, 28),
                pady=4,
            )

        actions = ttk.Frame(root)
        actions.pack(fill=tk.X, pady=(2, 12))
        self.run_button = ttk.Button(actions, text="Run Return Export", command=self.run_export_clicked)
        self.run_button.pack(side=tk.LEFT)
        ttk.Button(actions, text="Select All", command=lambda: self.set_all_stores(True)).pack(side=tk.LEFT, padx=(10, 0))
        ttk.Button(actions, text="Clear Stores", command=lambda: self.set_all_stores(False)).pack(side=tk.LEFT, padx=(10, 0))

        self.progress = ttk.Progressbar(root, mode="indeterminate")
        self.progress.pack(fill=tk.X, pady=(0, 10))

        log_frame = ttk.LabelFrame(root, text="Progress", padding=8)
        log_frame.pack(fill=tk.BOTH, expand=True)
        self.log_text = tk.Text(log_frame, height=13, wrap="word", state=tk.DISABLED)
        self.log_text.pack(side=tk.LEFT, fill=tk.BOTH, expand=True)
        scroll = ttk.Scrollbar(log_frame, command=self.log_text.yview)
        scroll.pack(side=tk.RIGHT, fill=tk.Y)
        self.log_text.configure(yscrollcommand=scroll.set)
        self.log("Ready.")

    def change_folder(self) -> None:
        folder = filedialog.askdirectory(initialdir=self.output_dir.get() or str(Path.home()))
        if folder:
            self.output_dir.set(folder)

    def set_all_stores(self, value: bool) -> None:
        for var in self.store_vars.values():
            var.set(value)

    def parse_date(self, value: str) -> datetime:
        return datetime.strptime(value.strip(), "%Y-%m-%d")

    def selected_stores(self) -> list[str]:
        return [name for name, var in self.store_vars.items() if var.get()]

    def run_export_clicked(self) -> None:
        if self.is_running:
            return
        try:
            start_date = self.parse_date(self.from_date.get())
            end_date = self.parse_date(self.to_date.get())
        except ValueError:
            messagebox.showerror("Invalid date", "Use YYYY-MM-DD for both dates.")
            return
        if start_date > end_date:
            messagebox.showerror("Invalid date range", "From date must be before or equal to To date.")
            return

        stores = self.selected_stores()
        if not stores:
            messagebox.showerror("No stores selected", "Select at least one store.")
            return

        self.is_running = True
        self.run_button.configure(state=tk.DISABLED)
        self.progress.start(12)
        self.log("")
        self.log("Starting return export...")

        thread = threading.Thread(
            target=self._run_export_worker,
            args=(stores, start_date, end_date, Path(self.output_dir.get())),
            daemon=True,
        )
        thread.start()

    def _run_export_worker(self, stores: list[str], start_date: datetime, end_date: datetime, output_dir: Path) -> None:
        try:
            result = run_return_export(
                selected_store_names=stores,
                start_date=start_date,
                end_date=end_date,
                output_dir=output_dir,
                progress=lambda message: self.after(0, self.log, message),
            )
            self.after(0, self.export_finished, result)
        except Exception as exc:
            self.after(0, self.export_failed, exc)

    def export_finished(self, result) -> None:
        self.progress.stop()
        self.run_button.configure(state=tk.NORMAL)
        self.is_running = False
        self.log(f"Done. Returns: {result.return_count}; item rows: {result.row_count}; errors: {len(result.errors)}")
        if result.capped:
            self.log("Warning: one or more stores hit the page cap. Narrow the date range if needed.")
        messagebox.showinfo("Export complete", f"Saved:\n{result.xlsx_path}\n\n{result.json_path}")

    def export_failed(self, exc: Exception) -> None:
        self.progress.stop()
        self.run_button.configure(state=tk.NORMAL)
        self.is_running = False
        self.log(f"Failed: {exc}")
        messagebox.showerror("Export failed", str(exc))

    def log(self, message: str) -> None:
        self.log_text.configure(state=tk.NORMAL)
        self.log_text.insert(tk.END, f"{message}\n")
        self.log_text.see(tk.END)
        self.log_text.configure(state=tk.DISABLED)


def main() -> None:
    app = ReturnsExporterApp()
    app.mainloop()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()


--- ParcelNinja/pnj_returns_exporter_core.py ---

from __future__ import annotations

import concurrent.futures
import json
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Callable

from pnj_desktop_exporter_core import (
    BASE_URL,
    DEFAULT_SECRETS_PATH,
    MAX_PAGES,
    MAX_STORE_WORKERS,
    PAGE_SIZE,
    REPORT_DETAIL_WORKERS,
    ApiResult,
    StoreConfig,
    get_with_retry,
    load_stores_from_toml,
)
from pnj_inbound_fetch import InboundReportOutcome, fetch_inbound_return_report_for_store
from return_report import (
    build_return_json_payload,
    flatten_inbounds_to_return_rows,
    return_rows_to_xlsx,
)


def _get_default_return_export_dir() -> Path:
    onedrive_docs = Path.home() / "OneDrive" / "Documents"
    if onedrive_docs.exists():
        return onedrive_docs / "Seller Portal" / "Return exports"
    local_docs = Path.home() / "Documents"
    if local_docs.exists():
        return local_docs / "Seller Portal" / "Return exports"
    return Path.home() / "Seller Portal" / "Return exports"

DEFAULT_RETURN_EXPORT_DIR = _get_default_return_export_dir()


@dataclass
class ReturnExportResult:
    xlsx_path: Path
    json_path: Path
    return_count: int
    row_count: int
    errors: list[str]
    capped: bool


def fetch_return_report(
    store_name: str,
    store: StoreConfig,
    start_date: datetime,
    end_date: datetime,
    api_getter: Callable[[str, StoreConfig, dict[str, Any] | None], ApiResult] = get_with_retry,
) -> InboundReportOutcome:
    return fetch_inbound_return_report_for_store(
        get_with_retry=api_getter,
        base_url=BASE_URL,
        store=store,
        store_name=store_name,
        start_date=start_date,
        end_date=end_date,
        page_size=PAGE_SIZE,
        max_pages=MAX_PAGES,
        detail_workers=REPORT_DETAIL_WORKERS,
    )


def run_return_export(
    selected_store_names: list[str],
    start_date: datetime,
    end_date: datetime,
    output_dir: Path = DEFAULT_RETURN_EXPORT_DIR,
    stores: dict[str, StoreConfig] | None = None,
    progress: Callable[[str], None] | None = None,
    api_getter: Callable[[str, StoreConfig, dict[str, Any] | None], ApiResult] = get_with_retry,
) -> ReturnExportResult:
    stores = stores or load_stores_from_toml(DEFAULT_SECRETS_PATH)
    selected = {name: stores[name] for name in selected_store_names}
    if not selected:
        raise ValueError("Select at least one store.")

    output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    all_inbounds: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    all_errors: list[str] = []
    return_count = 0
    capped = False

    if progress:
        progress(f"Fetching {len(selected)} store(s)...")

    with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=min(MAX_STORE_WORKERS, len(selected))) as executor:
        futures = {
            executor.submit(fetch_return_report, name, store, start_date, end_date, api_getter): name
            for name, store in selected.items()
        }
        for future in concurrent.futures.as_completed(futures):
            store_name = futures[future]
            outcome = future.result()
            all_inbounds.extend(outcome.records)
            all_errors.extend(outcome.errors)
            return_count += outcome.return_count
            capped = capped or outcome.capped
            if progress:
                progress(f"{store_name}: {outcome.return_count} return(s), {len(outcome.errors)} error(s)")

    rows = flatten_inbounds_to_return_rows(all_inbounds)
    start_label = start_date.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
    end_label = end_date.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
    base_name = f"RETURN_RECON_{start_label}_to_{end_label}"
    xlsx_path = output_dir / f"{base_name}.xlsx"
    json_path = output_dir / f"{base_name}.json"

    if progress:
        progress(f"Writing {len(rows)} item row(s)...")

    xlsx_path.write_bytes(return_rows_to_xlsx(rows))
    payload = build_return_json_payload(
        start_date=start_date,
        end_date=end_date,
        selected_stores=list(selected.keys()),
        return_count=return_count,
        rows=rows,
        errors=all_errors,
        capped=capped,
    )
    json_path.write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")

    if progress:
        progress(f"Saved XLSX: {xlsx_path}")
        progress(f"Saved JSON: {json_path}")

    return ReturnExportResult(
        xlsx_path=xlsx_path,
        json_path=json_path,
        return_count=return_count,
        row_count=len(rows),
        errors=all_errors,
        capped=capped,
    )


--- ParcelNinja/pnj_search.py ---

"""
Parcelninja Multi-Store Search — Production Build
Bounty Brands + Levi's Warehouse Hub

Improvements over v1:
  - Per-request retry logic with exponential backoff (429/503/network)
  - Errors surfaced to UI — no more silent None returns
  - find_linked_returns() pre-fetched in parallel, NOT inside render loop
  - st.rerun() replaces deprecated st.experimental_rerun()
  - Structured logging (stderr) + st.warning() for operational visibility
  - Strict type hints throughout
  - Credential discrepancy guard at startup
  - Search scoped to date window before client-side match (unchanged API constraint — documented)
  - MAX_PAGES safety cap with user-visible warning when hit
  - Empty-response vs error-response distinction surfaced in UI
  - All store configs loaded once; never re-read secrets per-request
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import base64
import concurrent.futures
import logging
import sys
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from typing import Optional

import requests
import streamlit as st
import streamlit.components.v1 as components
from requests.auth import HTTPBasicAuth
from requests.exceptions import ConnectionError, ReadTimeout, RequestException
from pnj_report_fetch import ReportOutcome, fetch_outbound_report_for_store
from shipment_report import (
    flatten_outbounds_to_report_rows,
    report_rows_to_xlsx,
)

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# LOGGING
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

logging.basicConfig(
    stream=sys.stderr,
    level=logging.INFO,
    format="%(asctime)s [%(levelname)s] %(name)s — %(message)s",
    datefmt="%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S",
)
log = logging.getLogger("pnj_search")


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# CONSTANTS
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

BASE_URL   = "https://storeapi.parcelninja.com/api/v1"
PAGE_SIZE  = 100
MAX_PAGES  = 40          # 40 x 100 = 4,000 records per store per search type
MAX_WORKERS = 12         # ThreadPoolExecutor ceiling
REPORT_DETAIL_WORKERS = 8 # Bounded per-store detail fetch concurrency
REQUEST_TIMEOUT = 15     # seconds per HTTP call
RETRY_ATTEMPTS  = 3      # attempts before giving up
RETRY_BACKOFF   = [1, 2, 4]  # seconds between retries

INBOUND_STATUS_MAP: dict[int, str] = {
    200: "Awaiting Arrival",
    201: "Arrived at Warehouse",
    202: "Being Processed",
    203: "Processing Complete",
    204: "Complete with Variance",
}

STATUS_ICONS: dict[str, str] = {
    "delivered":  "🟢",
    "dispatched": "🔵",
    "collected":  "🔵",
    "processing": "🟡",
    "cancelled":  "🔴",
    "returned":   "🟠",
    "awaiting":   "⚪",
    "arrived":    "🟡",
    "complete":   "🟢",
    "variance":   "🟠",
}


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# STORE CONFIG
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class StoreConfig:
    name:     str
    username: str
    password: str
    store_id: str

    def auth(self) -> HTTPBasicAuth:
        return HTTPBasicAuth(self.username, self.password)

    def headers(self) -> dict[str, str]:
        return {"Accept": "application/json", "X-Store-Id": self.store_id}


@st.cache_resource
def load_stores() -> dict[str, StoreConfig]:
    """
    Load store credentials from st.secrets exactly once.
    Raises a clear RuntimeError if any required key is missing —
    fail fast rather than silently return broken configs.
    """
    required_keys = ["diesel", "hurley", "jeep_apparel", "superdry", "reebok", "levis"]
    missing = [k for k in required_keys if k not in st.secrets]
    if missing:
        raise RuntimeError(
            f"Missing secrets for: {missing}. "
            "Add them to .streamlit/secrets.toml before running."
        )

    def _store(key: str, display_name: str) -> StoreConfig:
        s = st.secrets[key]
        return StoreConfig(
            name=display_name,
            username=s["username"],
            password=s["password"],
            store_id=s["store_id"],
        )

    return {
        "Diesel":       _store("diesel",       "Diesel"),
        "Hurley":       _store("hurley",       "Hurley"),
        "Jeep Apparel": _store("jeep_apparel", "Jeep Apparel"),
        "Superdry":     _store("superdry",     "Superdry"),
        "Reebok":       _store("reebok",       "Reebok"),
        "Levi's":       _store("levis",        "Levi's"),
    }


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# HTTP LAYER — RETRY + ERROR SURFACING
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

@dataclass
class ApiResult:
    data:       Optional[dict]
    ok:         bool
    status_code: int
    error:      Optional[str] = None


def _get_with_retry(
    url: str,
    store: StoreConfig,
    params: Optional[dict] = None,
) -> ApiResult:
    """
    GET with retry + exponential backoff.
    Returns ApiResult — never raises, never silently returns None.

    Retry on: 429 (rate limit), 503 (unavailable), connection errors, timeouts.
    Do not retry on: 4xx auth/not-found errors (would just fail again).
    """
    last_error: Optional[str] = None

    for attempt, delay in enumerate(RETRY_BACKOFF):
        try:
            r = requests.get(
                url,
                auth=store.auth(),
                headers=store.headers(),
                params=params,
                timeout=REQUEST_TIMEOUT,
            )

            if r.status_code == 200:
                return ApiResult(data=r.json(), ok=True, status_code=200)

            if r.status_code in (429, 503):
                # Transient — back off and retry
                retry_after = int(r.headers.get("Retry-After", delay))
                log.warning(
                    "Store=%s HTTP %s on %s — backing off %ss (attempt %d/%d)",
                    store.name, r.status_code, url, retry_after,
                    attempt + 1, RETRY_ATTEMPTS,
                )
                if attempt < RETRY_ATTEMPTS - 1:
                    time.sleep(retry_after)
                    continue

            # Non-retryable HTTP error
            msg = f"HTTP {r.status_code} from {url}"
            log.error("Store=%s %s — body: %s", store.name, msg, r.text[:200])
            return ApiResult(data=None, ok=False, status_code=r.status_code, error=msg)

        except ReadTimeout:
            last_error = f"Timeout after {REQUEST_TIMEOUT}s — {url}"
            log.warning("Store=%s %s (attempt %d/%d)", store.name, last_error, attempt + 1, RETRY_ATTEMPTS)
        except ConnectionError as e:
            last_error = f"Connection error — {url}: {e}"
            log.warning("Store=%s %s (attempt %d/%d)", store.name, last_error, attempt + 1, RETRY_ATTEMPTS)
        except RequestException as e:
            last_error = f"Request failed — {url}: {e}"
            log.error("Store=%s %s", store.name, last_error)
            break  # Non-transient

        if attempt < RETRY_ATTEMPTS - 1:
            time.sleep(delay)

    return ApiResult(data=None, ok=False, status_code=0, error=last_error or "Unknown error")


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# INVENTORY LOOKUP — CACHED
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

@st.cache_data(ttl=600, show_spinner=False)
def get_inventory_name(sku: str, store_name: str) -> str:
    """
    Cached SKU → descriptive name.
    Falls back to SKU string on any failure — never raises.
    Cache is keyed on (sku, store_name) since SKUs may differ across stores.
    TTL: 10 minutes.
    """
    if not sku or sku == "N/A":
        return "Unknown"

    stores = load_stores()
    store  = stores.get(store_name)
    if not store:
        return sku

    result = _get_with_retry(f"{BASE_URL}/inventory/{sku}", store)
    if result.ok and result.data:
        items = result.data.get("items", [])
        if items:
            return items[0].get("name") or sku

    return sku


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# SEARCH FUNCTIONS
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

@dataclass
class SearchOutcome:
    records:      list[dict]
    capped:       bool   = False   # True if MAX_PAGES was hit
    errors:       list[str] = None # API errors encountered

    def __post_init__(self):
        if self.errors is None:
            self.errors = []

def search_outbounds(
    store_name: str,
    query: str,
    start_date: datetime,
    end_date: datetime,
) -> SearchOutcome:
    """
    Paginate /outbounds and match client-side against:
      channelId, clientId, id, deliveryInfo.trackingNo
    On match, fetches full /outbounds/{id}/events detail.
    Returns SearchOutcome with results, cap flag, and any errors.
    """
    stores = load_stores()
    store  = stores[store_name]
    q      = query.strip().upper()
    results: list[dict] = []
    errors:  list[str]  = []
    capped = False
    sd = start_date.strftime("%Y%m%d")
    ed = end_date.strftime("%Y%m%d")

    for page in range(1, MAX_PAGES + 1):
        result = _get_with_retry(
            f"{BASE_URL}/outbounds",
            store,
            params={
                "pageSize":       PAGE_SIZE,
                "page":           page,
                "startDate":      sd,
                "endDate":        ed,
                "orderBy":        "createDate",
                "orderDirection": "desc",
            },
        )

        if not result.ok:
            errors.append(f"{store_name}/outbounds p{page}: {result.error}")
            break

        records = result.data.get("outbounds", [])
        if not records:
            break

        for summary in records:
            s_id     = str(summary.get("id", ""))
            s_ch     = str(summary.get("channelId") or "").upper()
            s_cl     = str(summary.get("clientId")  or "").upper()
            s_way    = str((summary.get("deliveryInfo") or {}).get("trackingNo") or "").upper()

            if q in s_id or q in s_ch or q in s_cl or q in s_way:
                detail = _get_with_retry(f"{BASE_URL}/outbounds/{s_id}/events", store)
                if detail.ok and detail.data:
                    detail.data["_store"] = store_name
                    detail.data["_type"]  = "outbound"
                    results.append(detail.data)
                elif not detail.ok:
                    errors.append(f"{store_name}/outbounds/{s_id}/events: {detail.error}")

        if len(records) < PAGE_SIZE:
            break

        if page == MAX_PAGES:
            capped = True
            log.warning("Store=%s outbounds search hit MAX_PAGES cap (%d)", store_name, MAX_PAGES)

    return SearchOutcome(records=results, capped=capped, errors=errors)


def search_inbounds(
    store_name: str,
    query: str,
    start_date: datetime,
    end_date: datetime,
) -> SearchOutcome:
    """
    Paginate /inbounds and match client-side against:
      channelId, clientId, supplierReference, id, customer name
    On match, fetches full /inbounds/{id}/events detail.
    Also used internally for SHP→RET linking.
    """
    stores = load_stores()
    store  = stores[store_name]
    q      = query.strip().upper()
    results: list[dict] = []
    errors:  list[str]  = []
    capped = False
    sd = start_date.strftime("%Y%m%d")
    ed = end_date.strftime("%Y%m%d")

    for page in range(1, MAX_PAGES + 1):
        result = _get_with_retry(
            f"{BASE_URL}/inbounds",
            store,
            params={
                "pageSize": PAGE_SIZE,
                "page":     page,
                "startDate": sd,
                "endDate":   ed,
                "col":       4,
                "colOrder":  "desc",
            },
        )

        if not result.ok:
            errors.append(f"{store_name}/inbounds p{page}: {result.error}")
            break

        records = result.data.get("inbounds", [])
        if not records:
            break

        for summary in records:
            s_id      = str(summary.get("id", ""))
            s_ch      = str(summary.get("channelId")         or "").upper()
            s_cl      = str(summary.get("clientId")          or "").upper()
            s_sup     = str(summary.get("supplierReference") or "").upper()
            d_info    = summary.get("deliveryInfo", {})
            p_info    = summary.get("pickupInfo",   {})
            s_cust    = str(d_info.get("customer") or p_info.get("recipient") or "").upper()

            if q in s_id or q in s_ch or q in s_cl or q in s_sup or q in s_cust:
                detail = _get_with_retry(f"{BASE_URL}/inbounds/{s_id}/events", store)
                if detail.ok and detail.data:
                    detail.data["_store"] = store_name
                    detail.data["_type"]  = "inbound"
                    results.append(detail.data)
                elif not detail.ok:
                    errors.append(f"{store_name}/inbounds/{s_id}/events: {detail.error}")

        if len(records) < PAGE_SIZE:
            break

        if page == MAX_PAGES:
            capped = True
            log.warning("Store=%s inbounds search hit MAX_PAGES cap (%d)", store_name, MAX_PAGES)

    return SearchOutcome(records=results, capped=capped, errors=errors)


def _fetch_linked_returns_for(
    outbound: dict,
    start_date: datetime,
    end_date: datetime,
) -> list[dict]:
    """
    Search inbounds for records whose clientId or supplierReference
    matches the outbound's clientId or channelId.
    Deduplicates by PNJ id.
    """
    store_name = outbound.get("_store")
    if not store_name:
        return []

    seen: set[str] = set()
    linked: list[dict] = []

    for ref in filter(None, [outbound.get("clientId"), outbound.get("channelId")]):
        outcome = search_inbounds(store_name, str(ref), start_date, end_date)
        for h in outcome.records:
            h_id = str(h.get("id", ""))
            if h_id not in seen:
                seen.add(h_id)
                linked.append(h)

    return linked


def run_search(
    query: str,
    selected_stores: list[str],
    search_outbounds_flag: bool,
    search_inbounds_flag: bool,
    link_returns: bool,
    start_date: datetime,
    end_date: datetime,
) -> tuple[list[dict], list[dict], list[str], bool]:
    """
    Fan out across all selected stores in parallel.
    Pre-fetches linked returns before returning — NOT in the render loop.

    Returns: (outbounds, inbounds, all_errors, any_capped)
    """
    all_outbounds: list[dict]  = []
    all_inbounds:  list[dict]  = []
    all_errors:    list[str]   = []
    any_capped                 = False

    with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=MAX_WORKERS) as ex:
        fut_out: dict[concurrent.futures.Future, str] = {}
        fut_in:  dict[concurrent.futures.Future, str] = {}

        for sn in selected_stores:
            if search_outbounds_flag:
                fut_out[ex.submit(search_outbounds, sn, query, start_date, end_date)] = sn
            if search_inbounds_flag:
                fut_in[ex.submit(search_inbounds, sn, query, start_date, end_date)] = sn

        for f in concurrent.futures.as_completed(fut_out):
            outcome: SearchOutcome = f.result()
            all_outbounds.extend(outcome.records)
            all_errors.extend(outcome.errors)
            if outcome.capped:
                any_capped = True

        for f in concurrent.futures.as_completed(fut_in):
            outcome: SearchOutcome = f.result()
            all_inbounds.extend(outcome.records)
            all_errors.extend(outcome.errors)
            if outcome.capped:
                any_capped = True

    # Pre-fetch linked returns for all matched outbounds — parallel, outside render
    if link_returns and all_outbounds:
        linked_map: dict[str, list[dict]] = {}
        link_futures: dict[concurrent.futures.Future, str] = {}

        with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=MAX_WORKERS) as ex:
            for ob in all_outbounds:
                ob_id = str(ob.get("id", ""))
                f = ex.submit(_fetch_linked_returns_for, ob, start_date, end_date)
                link_futures[f] = ob_id

            for f in concurrent.futures.as_completed(link_futures):
                ob_id = link_futures[f]
                linked_map[ob_id] = f.result()

        # Attach linked returns directly to outbound record
        for ob in all_outbounds:
            ob["_linked_returns"] = linked_map.get(str(ob.get("id", "")), [])
    else:
        for ob in all_outbounds:
            ob["_linked_returns"] = []

    return all_outbounds, all_inbounds, all_errors, any_capped


def fetch_outbound_report(
    store_name: str,
    start_date: datetime,
    end_date: datetime,
) -> ReportOutcome:
    """
    Fetch all outbounds for a store/date range and hydrate each record with
    /outbounds/{id}/events so item-line report exports have the full detail.
    """
    stores = load_stores()
    store = stores[store_name]
    outcome = fetch_outbound_report_for_store(
        get_with_retry=_get_with_retry,
        base_url=BASE_URL,
        store=store,
        store_name=store_name,
        start_date=start_date,
        end_date=end_date,
        page_size=PAGE_SIZE,
        max_pages=MAX_PAGES,
        detail_workers=REPORT_DETAIL_WORKERS,
    )
    if outcome.capped:
        log.warning("Store=%s outbound report hit MAX_PAGES cap (%d)", store_name, MAX_PAGES)
    return outcome


def run_outbound_report(
    selected_stores: list[str],
    start_date: datetime,
    end_date: datetime,
) -> tuple[list[dict], int, list[str], bool]:
    all_outbounds: list[dict] = []
    all_errors: list[str] = []
    any_capped = False
    shipment_count = 0

    with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=MAX_WORKERS) as ex:
        futures = {
            ex.submit(fetch_outbound_report, store_name, start_date, end_date): store_name
            for store_name in selected_stores
        }

        for future in concurrent.futures.as_completed(futures):
            outcome: ReportOutcome = future.result()
            all_outbounds.extend(outcome.records)
            all_errors.extend(outcome.errors)
            shipment_count += outcome.shipment_count
            if outcome.capped:
                any_capped = True

    return all_outbounds, shipment_count, all_errors, any_capped

def _status_icon(description: str) -> str:
    d = (description or "").lower()
    for key, icon in STATUS_ICONS.items():
        if key in d:
            return icon
    return "⚫"


def _addr(info: dict) -> str:
    parts = [info.get("addressLine1"), info.get("addressLine2"),
             info.get("suburb"), info.get("postalCode")]
    return ", ".join(str(p) for p in parts if p) or "—"


def render_outbound_card(ob: dict, show_linked_returns: bool) -> None:
    store_name   = ob.get("_store", "Unknown")
    channel_id   = ob.get("channelId")   or "—"
    client_id    = ob.get("clientId")    or "—"
    pnj_id       = ob.get("id")          or "—"
    status       = ob.get("status", {})
    status_desc  = status.get("description") or "Unknown"
    status_code  = status.get("code")        or ""
    d_info       = ob.get("deliveryInfo", {})
    items        = ob.get("items", [])
    events       = ob.get("events", [])
    create_date  = (ob.get("createDate") or "")[:10] or "—"
    icon         = _status_icon(status_desc)

    st.markdown(
        f"""
        <div class="card card-out">
            <div class="card-row card-header-row">
                <div>
                    <span class="card-title">📦 {channel_id}</span>
                    <span class="card-tag">{store_name}</span>
                </div>
                <div class="card-status">
                    {icon} <strong>{status_desc}</strong>
                    <span class="status-code">({status_code})</span>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="card-row card-meta">
                <span><b>PNJ ID</b> {pnj_id}</span>
                <span><b>Client Ref</b> {client_id}</span>
                <span><b>Created</b> {create_date}</span>
                <span><b>Courier</b> {d_info.get('courierName') or '—'}</span>
                <span><b>Waybill</b> {d_info.get('trackingNo') or '—'}</span>
            </div>
            <div class="card-row card-addr">
                <b>Customer</b> {d_info.get('customer') or '—'}
                &nbsp;·&nbsp;
                <b>Address</b> {_addr(d_info)}
            </div>
        </div>
        """,
        unsafe_allow_html=True,
    )

    with st.expander(f"📋 Items ({len(items)}) · Events ({len(events)})"):
        col_items, col_events = st.columns(2)

        with col_items:
            st.markdown("**Items**")
            for item in items:
                sku        = item.get("itemNo") or "N/A"
                qty        = item.get("qty") or 0
                name       = get_inventory_name(sku, store_name) if sku != "N/A" else "N/A"
                ret_reason = item.get("returnReason")
                serials    = item.get("SerialNumbers") or []
                line = f"- **{sku}** — {name}  \n  Qty: `{qty}`"
                if ret_reason:
                    line += f"  \n  ⚠️ Return: {ret_reason}"
                if serials:
                    line += f"  \n  S/N: {', '.join(serials)}"
                st.markdown(line)

        with col_events:
            st.markdown("**Event Timeline**")
            for ev in events:
                ev_date = str(ev.get("date") or ev.get("createDate") or "")[:16]
                ev_desc = ev.get("description") or ev.get("statusDescription") or str(ev)
                st.markdown(f"- `{ev_date}` — {ev_desc}")

        if st.checkbox("Show raw JSON", key=f"raw_ob_{pnj_id}"):
            st.json(ob)

    # Linked returns — pre-fetched, no blocking call here
    if show_linked_returns:
        linked = ob.get("_linked_returns", [])
        if linked:
            st.markdown(
                f"<div class='linked-badge'>↩ {len(linked)} Linked Return(s)</div>",
                unsafe_allow_html=True,
            )
            for ret in linked:
                render_inbound_card(ret)
        else:
            st.caption("↩ No linked returns found for this shipment.")


def render_inbound_card(ib: dict) -> None:
    store_name    = ib.get("_store", "Unknown")
    channel_id    = ib.get("channelId")         or "—"
    client_id     = ib.get("clientId")          or "—"
    pnj_id        = ib.get("id")                or "—"
    supplier_ref  = ib.get("supplierReference") or "—"
    inbound_type  = (ib.get("type") or {}).get("description") or "—"
    events        = ib.get("events", [])
    items         = ib.get("items", [])
    create_date   = (ib.get("createDate") or "")[:10] or "—"
    d_info        = ib.get("deliveryInfo", {})
    p_info        = ib.get("pickupInfo", {})
    customer      = d_info.get("customer") or p_info.get("recipient") or "—"

    latest_status = "Unknown"
    if events:
        latest_status = (
            events[0].get("description")
            or events[0].get("statusDescription")
            or "Unknown"
        )
    icon = _status_icon(latest_status)

    st.markdown(
        f"""
        <div class="card card-in">
            <div class="card-row card-header-row">
                <div>
                    <span class="card-title card-title-in">↩ RETURN / INBOUND</span>
                    <span class="card-tag card-tag-in">{store_name} · {inbound_type}</span>
                </div>
                <div class="card-status">
                    {icon} <strong>{latest_status}</strong>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="card-row card-meta">
                <span><b>Channel ID</b> {channel_id}</span>
                <span><b>PNJ ID</b> {pnj_id}</span>
                <span><b>Client Ref</b> {client_id}</span>
                <span><b>Supplier Ref</b> {supplier_ref}</span>
                <span><b>Created</b> {create_date}</span>
                <span><b>Sender</b> {customer}</span>
            </div>
        </div>
        """,
        unsafe_allow_html=True,
    )

    with st.expander(f"📋 Items ({len(items)}) · Events ({len(events)})"):
        col_items, col_events = st.columns(2)

        with col_items:
            st.markdown("**Items**")
            for item in items:
                sku      = item.get("itemNo") or "N/A"
                expected = item.get("qty") or 0
                received = item.get("receivedQty") or 0
                name     = item.get("name") or sku
                line     = f"- **{sku}** — {name}  \n  Qty: `{expected}`"
                if received and received != expected:
                    line += f"  \n  ⚠️ Variance: expected {expected}, received {received}"
                st.markdown(line)

        with col_events:
            st.markdown("**Event Timeline**")
            for ev in events:
                ev_date = str(ev.get("date") or ev.get("createDate") or "")[:16]
                ev_desc = ev.get("description") or ev.get("statusDescription") or str(ev)
                st.markdown(f"- `{ev_date}` — {ev_desc}")

        if st.checkbox("Show raw JSON", key=f"raw_ib_{pnj_id}"):
            st.json(ib)

def render_outbound_report_app(stores: dict[str, StoreConfig]) -> None:
    if "report_selected_stores" not in st.session_state:
        st.session_state.report_selected_stores = set(stores.keys())
    if "report_result" not in st.session_state:
        st.session_state.report_result = None

    ctrl_col, opts_col = st.columns([3, 1])

    with ctrl_col:
        st.markdown("##### Stores")
        store_cols = st.columns(len(stores))
        for i, sn in enumerate(stores.keys()):
            with store_cols[i]:
                active = sn in st.session_state.report_selected_stores
                label = f"Selected: {sn}" if active else sn
                css_cls = "store-active" if active else ""
                st.markdown(f'<div class="{css_cls}">', unsafe_allow_html=True)
                if st.button(label, key=f"report_btn_{sn}", use_container_width=True):
                    if active:
                        st.session_state.report_selected_stores.discard(sn)
                    else:
                        st.session_state.report_selected_stores.add(sn)
                    st.rerun()
                st.markdown("</div>", unsafe_allow_html=True)

        st.markdown("<br>", unsafe_allow_html=True)
        d1, d2 = st.columns(2)
        with d1:
            start_date = st.date_input(
                "From",
                value=datetime.now() - timedelta(days=7),
                key="report_start_date",
            )
        with d2:
            end_date = st.date_input(
                "To",
                value=datetime.now(),
                key="report_end_date",
            )

        if start_date > end_date:
            st.error("'From' date must be before 'To' date.")
            st.stop()

        force_fresh = st.checkbox(
            "Force fresh fetch",
            value=True,
            help="Recommended for daily live reports. Turn off only to reuse the same report during this session.",
        )

        report_clicked = st.button("Download Excel Report", use_container_width=True)

    with opts_col:
        st.markdown("##### Report")
        st.markdown(
            """
            <div style="border:1px solid #1e3a5f; border-radius:7px; padding:12px;
                        background:#0a1628; font-size:0.77rem; color:#3d6494; line-height:1.7;">
                <strong style="color:#5a8ad4; display:block; margin-bottom:4px;">Output</strong>
                Seller portal column order<br>
                One row per shipment item<br>
                Excel download only<br>
                Fresh API fetch by default<br>
                <br>
                <strong style="color:#5a8ad4;">Cap:</strong> 4,000 shipments / store<br>
                <strong style="color:#5a8ad4;">Detail calls:</strong> parallel batches
            </div>
            """,
            unsafe_allow_html=True,
        )

    st.markdown("<br>", unsafe_allow_html=True)

    if report_clicked:
        selected = list(st.session_state.report_selected_stores)
        if not selected:
            st.warning("Select at least one store.")
            st.stop()

        start_dt = datetime.combine(start_date, datetime.min.time())
        end_dt = datetime.combine(end_date, datetime.max.time())
        report_key = (
            tuple(sorted(selected)),
            start_date.isoformat(),
            end_date.isoformat(),
        )

        cached = st.session_state.report_result
        if (
            not force_fresh
            and cached
            and cached.get("report_key") == report_key
            and cached.get("xlsx_bytes")
        ):
            cached["auto_download_pending"] = True
            st.session_state.report_result = cached
        else:
            with st.spinner(f"Fetching outbound shipments for {len(selected)} store(s)..."):
                outbounds, shipment_count, errors, capped = run_outbound_report(
                    selected_stores=selected,
                    start_date=start_dt,
                    end_date=end_dt,
                )
                rows = flatten_outbounds_to_report_rows(outbounds)

                xlsx_bytes = None
                xlsx_error = None
                if rows:
                    try:
                        xlsx_bytes = report_rows_to_xlsx(rows)
                    except RuntimeError as e:
                        xlsx_error = str(e)

            start_label = start_date.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
            end_label = end_date.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
            st.session_state.report_result = {
                "report_key": report_key,
                "rows": rows,
                "row_count": len(rows),
                "shipment_count": shipment_count,
                "errors": errors,
                "capped": capped,
                "stores": selected,
                "start": start_date,
                "end": end_date,
                "filename": f"SHIPMENT_{start_label}_to_{end_label}.xlsx",
                "xlsx_bytes": xlsx_bytes,
                "xlsx_error": xlsx_error,
                "auto_download_pending": bool(xlsx_bytes),
            }

    result = st.session_state.report_result
    if not result:
        st.markdown("""
        <div style="text-align:center; padding:70px 0; color:#1a3a6a;">
            <div style="font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace; font-size:0.95rem;
                        margin-top:14px; color:#2d4a6a;">
                Select stores and a date range, then download the outbound shipment Excel report.
            </div>
        </div>
        """, unsafe_allow_html=True)
        return

    errors = result["errors"]

    if result["capped"]:
        st.markdown(
            "<div class='warn-pill'>One or more stores hit the 4,000-shipment cap. "
            "Narrow the date range to ensure every shipment is included.</div>",
            unsafe_allow_html=True,
        )

    if errors:
        with st.expander(f"{len(errors)} API error(s) encountered - click to inspect"):
            for err in errors:
                st.markdown(f"<div class='err-pill'>{err}</div>", unsafe_allow_html=True)

    m1, m2, m3, m4 = st.columns(4)
    m1.metric("Stores Searched", len(result["stores"]))
    m2.metric("Shipments", result["shipment_count"])
    m3.metric("Item Rows", result["row_count"])
    m4.metric("API Errors", len(errors))

    st.markdown("---")

    if result.get("xlsx_error"):
        st.error(result["xlsx_error"])
        return

    if not result.get("row_count"):
        st.info("No outbound shipment rows were found for this date range.")
        return

    xlsx_bytes = result.get("xlsx_bytes") or b""
    filename = result["filename"]

    if result.get("auto_download_pending"):
        encoded = base64.b64encode(xlsx_bytes).decode("ascii")
        components.html(
            f"""
            <script>
            const link = document.createElement("a");
            link.href = "data:application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet;base64,{encoded}";
            link.download = "{filename}";
            document.body.appendChild(link);
            link.click();
            document.body.removeChild(link);
            </script>
            """,
            height=0,
        )
        result["auto_download_pending"] = False
        st.session_state.report_result = result
        st.success(f"Excel report generated: {filename}")

    st.download_button(
        "Download Excel Again",
        data=xlsx_bytes,
        file_name=filename,
        mime="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet",
        use_container_width=True,
    )

if search_clicked:
    if not query.strip():
        st.warning("Enter a search term.")
        st.stop()

    selected = list(st.session_state.selected_stores)
    if not selected:
        st.warning("Select at least one store.")
        st.stop()

    if not do_outbounds and not do_inbounds:
        st.warning("Enable at least one search type (Outbounds / Inbounds).")
        st.stop()

    start_dt = datetime.combine(start_date, datetime.min.time())
    end_dt   = datetime.combine(end_date,   datetime.max.time())

    with st.spinner(f"Searching {len(selected)} store(s) for **{query}** …"):
        outbounds, inbounds, errors, capped = run_search(
            query               = query,
            selected_stores     = selected,
            search_outbounds_flag = do_outbounds,
            search_inbounds_flag  = do_inbounds,
            link_returns        = do_link_returns,
            start_date          = start_dt,
            end_date            = end_dt,
        )

    # ── Warnings & errors (operational visibility) ────────────────────────────
    if capped:
        st.markdown(
            "<div class='warn-pill'>⚠️ One or more stores hit the 4,000-record cap. "
            "Narrow the date range to ensure all matching records are returned.</div>",
            unsafe_allow_html=True,
        )

    if errors:
        with st.expander(f"⚠️ {len(errors)} API error(s) encountered — click to inspect"):
            for err in errors:
                st.markdown(f"<div class='err-pill'>{err}</div>", unsafe_allow_html=True)

    # ── Results ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    total = len(outbounds) + len(inbounds)

    if total == 0:
        st.info(
            f"No results for **{query}** across {len(selected)} store(s) "
            f"({start_date} → {end_date}). "
            "Try widening the date range or checking the reference format."
        )
    else:
        m1, m2, m3, m4 = st.columns(4)
        m1.metric("Total Results",       total)
        m2.metric("Shipments (Out)",     len(outbounds))
        m3.metric("Inbounds / Returns",  len(inbounds))
        m4.metric("Stores Searched",     len(selected))

        st.markdown("---")

        if outbounds and inbounds:
            tab_out, tab_in = st.tabs([
                f"📦  Outbounds ({len(outbounds)})",
                f"↩  Inbounds / Returns ({len(inbounds)})",
            ])
        elif outbounds:
            tab_out, tab_in = st.container(), None
        else:
            tab_out, tab_in = None, st.container()

        if outbounds and tab_out:
            with tab_out:
                st.markdown(
                    f"<div class='tab-label'>Shipments matching · {query}</div>",
                    unsafe_allow_html=True,
                )
                for ob in outbounds:
                    render_outbound_card(ob, show_linked_returns=do_link_returns)

        if inbounds and tab_in:
            with tab_in:
                st.markdown(
                    f"<div class='tab-label'>Inbounds / Returns matching · {query}</div>",
                    unsafe_allow_html=True,
                )
                for ib in inbounds:
                    render_inbound_card(ib)

else:
    # Landing state
    st.markdown("""
    <div style="text-align:center; padding:70px 0; color:#1a3a6a;">
        <div style="font-size:2.8rem;">📦</div>
        <div style="font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace; font-size:0.95rem;

            Channel ID (Shopify) · Client Ref · PNJ ID · Supplier Ref · Waybill · Customer Name
        </div>

    """, unsafe_allow_html=True)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Lazy imports — only pull heavy modules after page renders
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
@st.cache_resource(show_spinner=False)
def _load_core_modules():
    """Import project modules once and cache them."""
    from pnj_desktop_exporter_core import (
        STORE_KEYS,
        load_stores_from_toml,
        run_export,
        ExportResult,
    )
    from shipment_report import report_rows_to_xlsx, flatten_outbounds_to_report_rows
    return STORE_KEYS, load_stores_from_toml, run_export, ExportResult, report_rows_to_xlsx, flatten_outbounds_to_report_rows


try:
    STORE_KEYS, load_stores_from_toml, run_export, ExportResult, report_rows_to_xlsx, flatten_outbounds_to_report_rows = _load_core_modules()
except Exception as _import_err:
    st.error(f"❌ Failed to load exporter modules: {_import_err}")
    st.stop()

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Helper: build the XLSX bytes in-memory (no disk write)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def _run_in_memory_export(
    selected_stores: list[str],
    start_dt: datetime,
    end_dt: datetime,
    log_placeholder,
) -> tuple[bytes, dict[str, Any]]:
    """
    Run the export and return (xlsx_bytes, summary_dict).
    All output is streamed to *log_placeholder* via st.write.
    """
    from pnj_desktop_exporter_core import (
        load_stores_from_toml,
        get_with_retry,
        fetch_outbound_report,
        build_json_payload,
        MAX_STORE_WORKERS,
    )
    from shipment_report import flatten_outbounds_to_report_rows, report_rows_to_xlsx
    import concurrent.futures

    logs: list[str] = []

    def progress(msg: str):
        logs.append(msg)
        log_placeholder.markdown(
            "<br>".join(f"• {l}" for l in logs[-20:]),  # keep last 20 lines
            unsafe_allow_html=True,
        )

    stores = load_stores_from_toml()
    selected = {name: stores[name] for name in selected_stores if name in stores}
    stop_event = threading.Event()

    all_outbounds: list[dict] = []
    all_errors: list[str] = []
    shipment_count = 0
    capped = False

    progress(f"Connecting to {len(selected)} store(s)...")

    with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(
        max_workers=min(MAX_STORE_WORKERS, len(selected))
    ) as executor:
        futures = {
            executor.submit(
                fetch_outbound_report, name, store, start_dt, end_dt, get_with_retry, stop_event
            ): name
            for name, store in selected.items()
        }
        for future in concurrent.futures.as_completed(futures):
            store_name = futures[future]
            outcome = future.result()
            all_outbounds.extend(outcome.records)
            all_errors.extend(outcome.errors)
            shipment_count += outcome.shipment_count
            capped = capped or outcome.capped
            progress(f"✅ {store_name}: {outcome.shipment_count} shipment(s), {len(outcome.errors)} error(s)")

    progress(f"Flattening {shipment_count} shipment(s) to rows...")
    rows = flatten_outbounds_to_report_rows(all_outbounds)
    progress(f"Building XLSX ({len(rows)} item rows)...")
    xlsx_bytes = report_rows_to_xlsx(rows)
    progress("✅ Export complete — ready to download.")

    summary = {
        "shipment_count": shipment_count,
        "row_count": len(rows),
        "errors": all_errors,
        "capped": capped,
    }
    return xlsx_bytes, summary


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Session state defaults
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if "result_xlsx" not in st.session_state:
    st.session_state["result_xlsx"] = None
if "result_summary" not in st.session_state:
    st.session_state["result_summary"] = None
if "result_filename" not in st.session_state:
    st.session_state["result_filename"] = None

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

st.markdown('<div class="section-label">📅 Date Range</div>', unsafe_allow_html=True)

col1, col2 = st.columns(2)
with col1:

        value=datetime.now().date() - timedelta(days=1),
        key="from_date",

with col2:
    to_date: date = st.date_input(
        "To",
        value=datetime.now().date(),
        key="to_date",
        help="End date (inclusive)",
    )

st.markdown("---")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Form — Store Selection
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
st.markdown('<div class="section-label">🏪 Stores</div>', unsafe_allow_html=True)

all_store_names = list(STORE_KEYS.keys())

col_sel, col_clr = st.columns([1, 1])
with col_sel:
    if st.button("Select All", use_container_width=True):
        st.session_state["selected_stores"] = all_store_names
with col_clr:
    if st.button("Clear All", use_container_width=True):
        st.session_state["selected_stores"] = []

if "selected_stores" not in st.session_state:
    st.session_state["selected_stores"] = all_store_names

selected_stores: list[str] = st.multiselect(
    "Choose stores to include",
    options=all_store_names,
    default=st.session_state["selected_stores"],
    key="selected_stores",
    help="Hold Ctrl/Cmd to select multiple stores.",
)

st.markdown("---")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Run button + validation
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
run_col, _ = st.columns([1, 2])
with run_col:
    run_clicked = st.button("🚀 Run Export", type="primary", use_container_width=True)

if run_clicked:
    # --- Validate inputs ---
    errors: list[str] = []
    if not selected_stores:
        errors.append("Please select at least one store.")
    if from_date > to_date:
        errors.append("'From' date must be on or before 'To' date.")

    if errors:
        for e in errors:
            st.error(e)
    else:
        start_dt = datetime.combine(from_date, datetime.min.time())
        end_dt = datetime.combine(to_date, datetime.min.time())
        filename = (
            f"SHIPMENT_RECON_{from_date.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')}"
            f"_to_{to_date.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')}.xlsx"
        )

        # Clear previous result
        st.session_state["result_xlsx"] = None
        st.session_state["result_summary"] = None
        st.session_state["result_filename"] = None

        st.markdown("**Progress**")
        log_placeholder = st.empty()

        with st.spinner("Fetching shipment data from ParcelNinja API..."):
            try:
                xlsx_bytes, summary = _run_in_memory_export(
                    selected_stores=selected_stores,
                    start_dt=start_dt,
                    end_dt=end_dt,
                    log_placeholder=log_placeholder,
                )
                st.session_state["result_xlsx"] = xlsx_bytes
                st.session_state["result_summary"] = summary
                st.session_state["result_filename"] = filename
            except Exception as exc:
                st.error(f"❌ Export failed: {exc}")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Download section — shown when a result is ready
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if st.session_state.get("result_xlsx") is not None:
    summary = st.session_state["result_summary"]
    xlsx_bytes = st.session_state["result_xlsx"]
    filename = st.session_state["result_filename"]

    st.markdown("---")
    st.markdown("### ✅ Export Ready")

    # Metrics chips

    chips_html += f'<div class="metric-chip">Item Rows: <span>{summary["row_count"]}</span></div>'
    chips_html += f'<div class="metric-chip">API Errors: <span>{len(summary["errors"])}</span></div>'
    if summary["capped"]:
        chips_html += '<div class="metric-chip chip-warn">⚠️ Page cap hit — narrow date range</div>'
    chips_html += "</div>"
    st.markdown(chips_html, unsafe_allow_html=True)

    st.markdown("<br>", unsafe_allow_html=True)

    # Download button
    st.download_button(
        label=f"⬇️  Download  {filename}",
        data=xlsx_bytes,
        file_name=filename,
        mime="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet",
        use_container_width=True,
    )

    # Show errors (collapsible)
    if summary["errors"]:
        with st.expander(f"⚠️ {len(summary['errors'])} API error(s) — click to expand"):
            for err in summary["errors"]:
                st.markdown(f"- `{err}`")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Footer

st.markdown(

)
