--- ParcelNinja/return_report.py ---

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from io import BytesIO
from typing import Any

try:
    from openpyxl import Workbook
except ImportError:  # pragma: no cover
    Workbook = None

from shipment_report import format_pnj_timestamp, status_label


RETURN_COLUMNS = [
    "Return ID",
    "Client ID",
    "Source Shipment ID",
    "Reference",
    "Source Store Order ID",
    "Store Name/Brand",
    "Return Date",
    "Shipping Type",
    "Tracking No",
    "Courier",
    "Status",
    "Status Date",
    "Fulfilment Center",
    "Customer Name",
    "Address Line 1",
    "Pin Code",
    "Item Name",
    "Quantity",
    "Return Action",
    "Source Store order Id",
]


def derive_source_shipment_id(inbound: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    for value in [
        inbound.get("sourceShipmentId"),
        inbound.get("sourceShipmentID"),
        inbound.get("sourceOutboundId"),
        inbound.get("supplierReference"),
        inbound.get("clientId"),
    ]:
        text = str(value or "")
        if text.upper().startswith("SHP-"):
            return text
        if text.upper().startswith("RET-"):
            parts = text.split("-")
            if len(parts) >= 2:
                return f"SHP-{parts[1]}"
    return ""


def return_id(inbound: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    supplier_ref = str(inbound.get("supplierReference") or "")
    if supplier_ref.upper().startswith("RET-"):
        return supplier_ref

    client_id = inbound.get("clientId")
    if client_id:
        return str(client_id)
    inbound_id = inbound.get("id")
    return f"RET-{inbound_id}" if inbound_id not in (None, "") else ""


def shipping_type(delivery_info: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    billing = delivery_info.get("courierBillingInfo") or {}
    service = billing.get("service") or {}
    return str(
        delivery_info.get("shippingType")
        or delivery_info.get("deliveryType")
        or service.get("code")
        or service.get("description")
        or ""
    )


def address_line(delivery_info: dict[str, Any], pickup_info: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    source = delivery_info or pickup_info or {}
    parts = [
        source.get("addressLine1"),
        source.get("addressLine2"),
        source.get("suburb"),
        source.get("state") or source.get("province"),
        source.get("country"),
    ]
    return ", ".join(str(part) for part in parts if part not in (None, ""))


def source_store_order_id(inbound: dict[str, Any], item: dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> str:
    item = item or {}
    return str(
        inbound.get("sourceStoreOrderId")
        or inbound.get("sourceStoreOrderID")
        or inbound.get("channelId")
        or item.get("returnAction")
        or item.get("sourceStoreOrderId")
        or item.get("sourceStoreOrderID")
        or ""
    )


def return_action(item: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    return str(item.get("returnReason") or item.get("returnDetail") or "")


def flatten_inbound_to_return_rows(
    inbound: dict[str, Any],
    store_name: str | None = None,
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    delivery_info = inbound.get("deliveryInfo") or {}
    pickup_info = inbound.get("pickupInfo") or {}
    status = inbound.get("status") or {}
    items = inbound.get("items") or [{}]

    rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for item in items:
        item = item or {}
        row = {
            "Return ID": return_id(inbound),
            "Client ID": inbound.get("clientId") or "",
            "Source Shipment ID": derive_source_shipment_id(inbound),
            "Reference": inbound.get("id") or "",
            "Source Store Order ID": source_store_order_id(inbound, item),
            "Store Name/Brand": inbound.get("sourceStore") or inbound.get("sourceStoreCode") or inbound.get("_store") or store_name or "",
            "Return Date": format_pnj_timestamp(inbound.get("createDate")),
            "Shipping Type": shipping_type(delivery_info),
            "Tracking No": (
                delivery_info.get("trackingNo")
                or delivery_info.get("waybillNo")
                or pickup_info.get("waybillNo")
                or pickup_info.get("courierReference")
                or ""
            ),
            "Courier": delivery_info.get("courierName") or "",
            "Status": status_label(status),
            "Status Date": format_pnj_timestamp(status.get("timeStamp")),
            "Fulfilment Center": (
                inbound.get("fulfilmentCenter")
                or delivery_info.get("fulfilmentCenter")
                or delivery_info.get("fulfillmentCenter")
                or ""
            ),
            "Customer Name": delivery_info.get("customer") or pickup_info.get("recipient") or "",
            "Address Line 1": address_line(delivery_info, pickup_info),
            "Pin Code": delivery_info.get("postalCode") or pickup_info.get("postalCode") or "",
            "Item Name": item.get("itemNo") or item.get("name") or "",
            "Quantity": item.get("receivedQty") or item.get("qty") or "",
            "Return Action": return_action(item),
            "Source Store order Id": source_store_order_id(inbound, item),
        }
        rows.append({column: row.get(column, "") for column in RETURN_COLUMNS})
    return rows


def flatten_inbounds_to_return_rows(inbounds: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for inbound in inbounds:
        rows.extend(flatten_inbound_to_return_rows(inbound))
    return rows


def return_rows_to_xlsx(rows: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> bytes:
    if Workbook is None:
        raise RuntimeError("openpyxl is required to export Excel files.")

    workbook = Workbook()
    sheet = workbook.active
    sheet.title = "Inbound Returns"
    sheet.append(RETURN_COLUMNS)
    for row in rows:
        sheet.append([row.get(column, "") for column in RETURN_COLUMNS])

    sheet.freeze_panes = "A2"
    sheet.auto_filter.ref = sheet.dimensions
    for column_cells in sheet.columns:
        max_length = max(len(str(cell.value or "")) for cell in column_cells)
        sheet.column_dimensions[column_cells[0].column_letter].width = min(max(max_length + 2, 12), 42)

    output = BytesIO()
    workbook.save(output)
    return output.getvalue()


def build_return_json_payload(
    start_date,
    end_date,
    selected_stores: list[str],
    return_count: int,
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]],
    errors: list[str],
    capped: bool,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "metadata": {
            "dateRange": {
                "from": start_date.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"),
                "to": end_date.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"),
            },
            "selectedStores": selected_stores,
            "returnCount": return_count,
            "itemRowCount": len(rows),
            "apiErrorCount": len(errors),
            "capped": capped,
        },
        "rows": rows,
        "errors": errors,
    }

      RefreshCcw: () => <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round"><path d="M3 2v6h6"></path><path d="M21 12A9 9 0 0 0 6 5.3L3 8"></path><path d="M21 22v-6h-6"></path><path d="M3 12a9 9 0 0 0 15 6.7l3-2.7"></path></svg>,
      ChevronDown: () => <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round"><polyline points="6 9 12 15 18 9"></polyline></svg>,
      ChevronUp: () => <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round"><polyline points="18 15 12 9 6 15"></polyline></svg>,
      Loader: () => <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" className="animate-spin"><line x1="12" y1="2" x2="12" y2="6"></line><line x1="12" y1="18" x2="12" y2="22"></line><line x1="4.93" y1="4.93" x2="7.76" y2="7.76"></line><line x1="16.24" y1="16.24" x2="19.07" y2="19.07"></line><line x1="2" y1="12" x2="6" y2="12"></line><line x1="18" y1="12" x2="22" y2="12"></line><line x1="4.93" y1="19.07" x2="7.76" y2="16.24"></line><line x1="16.24" y1="7.76" x2="19.07" y2="4.93"></line></svg>
    };

    // Transform external row-format JSON (e.g. { rows: [...] }) into the
    // shipment objects shape expected by the dashboard. This normalises keys
    // by removing spaces and special characters (e.g. "Tracking Number" -> "TrackingNumber").
    // Additionally, when rows represent item-level rows (many rows per ShipmentID),
    // group rows by `ShipmentID` and collect `ItemName`/`Quantity` into `items`.
    const transformRows = (rows) => {
      if (!Array.isArray(rows)) return [];

      const normalised = rows.map(row => {
        const out = {};
        Object.keys(row).forEach(key => {
          const nk = key.replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9]/g, '');
          let val = row[key];
          if (typeof val === 'string') {
            const t = val.trim();
            if ((t.startsWith('{') || t.startsWith('['))) {
              try { val = JSON.parse(t); } catch (e) { /* leave as string */ }
            }
          }
          out[nk] = val;
        });
        return out;
      });

      // If rows contain ShipmentID, group by it and collect items
      const hasShipmentId = normalised.some(r => r.ShipmentID || r.ShipmentId || r.Shipment);
      if (hasShipmentId) {
        const groups = {};
        normalised.forEach(r => {
          const id = r.ShipmentID || r.ShipmentId || r.Shipment || ('_noid_' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,8));
          if (!groups[id]) {
            // Copy base fields
            const base = { ...r };
            // Map common tracking/courier fields
            if (base.TrackingNo && !base.TrackingNumber) base.TrackingNumber = base.TrackingNo;
            if (base.Courier && !base.TrackingCompany) base.TrackingCompany = base.Courier;
            // Initialise items
            base.items = [];
            groups[id] = base;
          }

          // Add item from row if present
          const itemName = r.ItemName || r.Item || r.SKU || r.ItemName;
          let qty = r.Quantity !== undefined ? r.Quantity : (r.Qty !== undefined ? r.Qty : null);
          if (typeof qty === 'string' && qty.trim() !== '') {
            const n = parseFloat(qty.replace(/[^0-9.\-]/g, ''));
            qty = Number.isFinite(n) ? n : qty;
          }
          if (itemName || qty !== null) {
            groups[id].items.push({ name: itemName || 'Unknown Item', quantity: qty || 1 });
          }
        });

        return Object.values(groups);
      }

      // Fallback: convert item fields into items array per row
      return normalised.map(r => {
        const mapped = { ...r };
        if (mapped.TrackingNo && !mapped.TrackingNumber) mapped.TrackingNumber = mapped.TrackingNo;
        if (mapped.Courier && !mapped.TrackingCompany) mapped.TrackingCompany = mapped.Courier;
        const itemName = mapped.ItemName || mapped.Item || mapped.SKU;
        let qty = mapped.Quantity !== undefined ? mapped.Quantity : (mapped.Qty !== undefined ? mapped.Qty : null);
        if (typeof qty === 'string' && qty.trim() !== '') {
          const n = parseFloat(qty.replace(/[^0-9.\-]/g, ''));
          qty = Number.isFinite(n) ? n : qty;
        }
        mapped.items = [];
        if (itemName || qty !== null) mapped.items.push({ name: itemName || 'Unknown Item', quantity: qty || 1 });
        return mapped;
      });
    };

    const getStatusColor = (status) => {
      const s = (status || '').toUpperCase();
      if (s.includes('DELIVERED') || s.includes('FULFILLED') || s.includes('COMPLETED')) return 'bg-green-100 text-green-800 border-green-200';
      if (s.includes('FAILED') || s.includes('CANCELLED')) return 'bg-red-100 text-red-800 border-red-200';
      if (s.includes('PICKING') || s.includes('UNFULFILLED') || s.includes('AWAITING')) return 'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800 border-yellow-200';
      if (s.includes('SHIPPED') || s.includes('TRANSIT')) return 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-800 border-blue-200';
      return 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-800 border-gray-200';
    };

    // --- REUSABLE COMPONENT FOR DETAILS SECTION ---
    const ShipmentDetails = ({ shipment }) => (
      <React.Fragment>
        <div className="p-6 border-b border-slate-100 grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-8">
          <div>
            <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-2 mb-4">
              <div className="w-4 h-4"><Icons.Truck /></div> Logistics Details
            </h4>
            <div className="space-y-4">
              <div className="flex flex-col">
                <span className="text-sm text-slate-500">Tracking Number</span>
                <span className="font-semibold text-slate-900 text-lg">
                  {shipment.TrackingNumber && shipment.TrackingNumber !== '-' ? (
                    shipment.TrackingCompany?.toLowerCase().includes('ram') ? (
                      <a href={`https://www.ram.co.za/Track/${shipment.TrackingNumber}`} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" className="text-blue-600 hover:text-blue-800 underline">
                        {shipment.TrackingNumber}
                      </a>
                    ) : shipment.TrackingCompany?.toLowerCase().includes('courierguy') ? (
                      <a href={`https://portal.thecourierguy.co.za/track?ref=${shipment.TrackingNumber}`} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" className="text-blue-600 hover:text-blue-800 underline">
                        {shipment.TrackingNumber}
                      </a>
                    ) : (
                      shipment.TrackingNumber
                    )
                  ) : 'Not Available'}
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex flex-col">
                <span className="text-sm text-slate-500">Tracking Company</span>
                <span className="font-medium text-slate-900">
                  {shipment.TrackingCompany || 'N/A'}
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex flex-col">
                <span className="text-sm text-slate-500">Store / Source</span>
                <span className="font-medium text-slate-900">
                  {shipment.Store || 'N/A'}
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex flex-col mt-2 pt-4 border-t border-slate-100">
                <span className="text-sm text-slate-500 mb-1">Customer Details</span>
                <span className="font-semibold text-slate-900">{shipment.CustomerName && shipment.CustomerName !== 'N/A' ? shipment.CustomerName : 'N/A'}</span>
                <span className="text-sm text-slate-600 mt-0.5 leading-tight">
                  {[shipment.AddressLine1, shipment.AddressLine2, shipment.City, shipment.Region, shipment.State].filter(Boolean).join(', ')}
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div>
            <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center gap-2 mb-4">
              <div className="w-4 h-4"><Icons.Calendar /></div> Timeline
            </h4>
            <div className="space-y-4">
              <div className="flex flex-col">
                <span className="text-sm text-slate-500">Order Created At</span>
                <span className="font-medium text-slate-900">
                  {shipment.OrderDate || shipment.ShopifyCreatedAt || 'N/A'}
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex flex-col">
                <span className="text-sm text-slate-500">Shipment Status Date (Portal)</span>
                <span className="font-medium text-slate-900">
                  {shipment.SellerPortalStatusDate || 'N/A'}
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="p-0 bg-slate-50/50">
          <div className="p-6 pb-4 flex items-center gap-2">
            <div className="w-5 h-5 text-slate-400"><Icons.Box /></div>
            <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-700 uppercase tracking-wider">
              Outbound Items ({shipment.items?.length || 0})
            </h4>
          </div>
          
          {shipment.items && shipment.items.length > 0 ? (
            <div className="overflow-x-auto px-6 pb-6">
              <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse bg-white rounded-xl overflow-hidden border border-slate-200">
                <thead className="bg-slate-100">
                  <tr>
                    <th className="p-3 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-600 border-b border-slate-200">Item Name / SKU</th>
                    <th className="p-3 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-600 border-b border-slate-200 w-32 text-right">Quantity</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                  {shipment.items.map((item, idx) => (
                    <tr key={idx} className="hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors">
                      <td className="p-3 text-sm font-medium text-slate-800 border-b border-slate-100 font-mono">
                        {item.name || 'Unknown Item'}
                      </td>
                      <td className="p-3 text-sm font-bold text-slate-700 border-b border-slate-100 text-right">
                        {parseFloat(item.quantity) || item.quantity || 1}
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="px-6 pb-6 text-sm text-slate-500 italic">
              No outbound item details found for this shipment.
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* --- RETURNS / INBOUND UI SECTION --- */}
        {shipment.returns && shipment.returns.length > 0 && (
          <div className="border-t border-slate-200 bg-rose-50/40">
            <div className="p-6 pb-4 flex items-center gap-2">
              <div className="w-5 h-5 text-rose-500"><Icons.RefreshCcw /></div>
              <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-rose-800 uppercase tracking-wider">
                Returns / Inbound Records ({shipment.returns.length})
              </h4>
            </div>
            
            <div className="px-6 pb-6 space-y-4">
              {shipment.returns.map((ret, rIdx) => (
                <div key={rIdx} className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-rose-100 shadow-sm overflow-hidden">
                  <div className="bg-rose-50 px-5 py-3 border-b border-rose-100 flex justify-between items-center flex-wrap gap-2">
                    <div className="font-semibold text-rose-900">{ret.ReturnID || 'Unknown Return'}</div>
                    <div className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md text-xs font-bold uppercase ${getStatusColor(ret.Status)}`}>
                      {ret.Status || 'UNKNOWN'}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="p-5 grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-5 text-sm">
                    <div className="flex flex-col">
                      <span className="text-slate-500 mb-0.5">Return Date</span>
                      <span className="font-medium text-slate-800">{ret.ReturnDate || 'N/A'}</span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex flex-col">
                      <span className="text-slate-500 mb-0.5">Status Date</span>
                      <span className="font-medium text-slate-800">{ret.StatusDate || 'N/A'}</span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex flex-col">
                      <span className="text-slate-500 mb-0.5">Return Courier</span>
                      <span className="font-medium text-slate-800">{ret.Courier || 'N/A'}</span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex flex-col">
                      <span className="text-slate-500 mb-0.5">Return Tracking</span>
                      <span className="font-semibold text-slate-900">
                        {ret.TrackingNo ? (
                          ret.Courier?.toLowerCase().includes('ram') ? (
                            <a href={`https://www.ram.co.za/Track/${ret.TrackingNo}`} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" className="text-blue-600 hover:text-blue-800 underline">
                              {ret.TrackingNo}
                            </a>
                          ) : ret.Courier?.toLowerCase().includes('courierguy') ? (
                            <a href={`https://portal.thecourierguy.co.za/track?ref=${ret.TrackingNo}`} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" className="text-blue-600 hover:text-blue-800 underline">
                              {ret.TrackingNo}
                            </a>
                          ) : (
                            ret.TrackingNo
                          )
                        ) : 'Not Available'}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  
                  {ret.items && ret.items.length > 0 && (
                    <div className="border-t border-rose-50 bg-slate-50/50 p-5">
                      <h5 className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 uppercase mb-3">Items Returned</h5>
                      <div className="space-y-2">
                        {ret.items.map((item, iIdx) => (
                          <div key={iIdx} className="flex justify-between items-center text-sm border-b border-slate-100 last:border-0 pb-2 last:pb-0">
                            <span className="font-mono text-slate-700">{item.name || 'Unknown Item'}</span>
                            <span className="font-bold text-rose-700 bg-rose-100 px-2 py-0.5 rounded">
                              {parseFloat(item.quantity) || item.quantity || 1}
                            </span>
                          </div>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </React.Fragment>
    );

    // --- MAIN APP COMPONENT ---
    const App = () => {
      // ParcelNinja API Credentials (Diesel Warehouse)
      const PNJ_API_BASE = 'https://storeapi.parcelninja.com/api/v1';
      const PNJ_WAREHOUSE_USERNAME = 'ENgsxyMbeqVGvGzTCpVdkZmsjz/VCDeF+NWHlRk3Hk0=';
      const PNJ_WAREHOUSE_PASSWORD = 'EuoTNvCvp5imhOR2TZDe/fnKDxfoPK+EORSqfGvafZk=';
      const PNJ_BASIC_AUTH = btoa(`${PNJ_WAREHOUSE_USERNAME}:${PNJ_WAREHOUSE_PASSWORD}`);

      const [data, setData] = useState(null);
      const [error, setError] = useState('');
      const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
      const [hasSearched, setHasSearched] = useState(false);
      const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
      const [sourceMode, setSourceMode] = useState('file');
      const [apiUrl, setApiUrl] = useState(`${PNJ_API_BASE}/outbounds`);
      const [apiToken, setApiToken] = useState('');
      const [apiResults, setApiResults] = useState([]);
      const [apiError, setApiError] = useState('');
      const [isApiSearching, setIsApiSearching] = useState(false);
      
      // New State for Bulk Search
      const [isBulkMode, setIsBulkMode] = useState(false);
      const [expandedRows, setExpandedRows] = useState({});
      
      const fileInputRef = useRef(null);

      useEffect(() => {
        setIsLoading(true);
        const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
        const defaultFile = 'https://storage.googleapis.com/ecomplete-analytics-data-745137237871/Bounty_Recon_Merged.json';
        const targetFile = urlParams.get('file') ? urlParams.get('file') : defaultFile;

        // Add a timestamp cache buster to force the browser to get the newest file from the bucket
        const cacheBusterUrl = targetFile.includes('?') ? `${targetFile}&t=${new Date().getTime()}` : `${targetFile}?t=${new Date().getTime()}`;

        fetch(cacheBusterUrl, { cache: 'no-store' })
          .then(response => {
            if (!response.ok) {
              throw new Error(`File ${targetFile} not found natively. Ready for manual upload.`);
            }
            return response.json();
          })
          .then(jsonData => {
            if (Array.isArray(jsonData)) setData(jsonData);
            else if (jsonData && Array.isArray(jsonData.rows)) setData(transformRows(jsonData.rows));
            else throw new Error('Invalid JSON format.');
          })
          .catch(err => {
            console.log("No default data found, proceeding to upload screen.", err.message);
          })
          .finally(() => {
            setIsLoading(false);
          });
      }, []);

      const handleFileUpload = (e) => {
        const file = e.target.files[0];
        if (!file) return;
        setError('');
        const reader = new FileReader();
        reader.onload = (event) => {
          try {
            const jsonData = JSON.parse(event.target.result);
            if (Array.isArray(jsonData)) setData(jsonData);
            else if (jsonData && Array.isArray(jsonData.rows)) setData(transformRows(jsonData.rows));
            else throw new Error("Invalid format: The JSON file must contain an array of shipments or an object with a 'rows' array.");
          } catch (err) {
            setError(`Failed to parse JSON file: ${err.message}`);
          }
        };
        reader.onerror = () => setError("An error occurred while reading the file.");
        reader.readAsText(file);
      };

      const handleUploadClick = () => fileInputRef.current.click();

      const handleReset = () => {
        setData(null);
        setSearchTerm('');
        setHasSearched(false);
        setError('');
        setApiError('');
        setApiResults([]);
        setExpandedRows({});
      };

      const buildLiveSearchUrl = (endpoint, term) => {
        const encoded = encodeURIComponent(term);
        if (!endpoint) return '';
        if (endpoint.includes('{query}')) return endpoint.replace(/\{query\}/g, encoded);
        if (endpoint.includes('{{query}}')) return endpoint.replace(/\{\{query\}\}/g, encoded);
        return endpoint.includes('?') ? `${endpoint}&q=${encoded}` : `${endpoint}?q=${encoded}`;
      };

      const fetchLiveResults = async (term) => {
        setApiError('');
        setApiResults([]);

        if (!apiUrl.trim()) {
          setApiError('Please enter a live API endpoint before searching.');
          return;
        }

        const url = buildLiveSearchUrl(apiUrl.trim(), term);
        if (!url) {
          setApiError('The live API endpoint must include a query placeholder or support ?q=.');
          return;
        }

        setIsApiSearching(true);
        try {
          const headers = {};
          // Use ParcelNinja Basic Auth if no custom token provided
          if (apiToken.trim()) {
            headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${apiToken.trim()}`;
          } else if (url.includes('storeapi.parcelninja.com')) {
            headers.Authorization = `Basic ${PNJ_BASIC_AUTH}`;
          }

          const response = await fetch(url, {
            method: 'GET',
            headers,
            cache: 'no-store',
          });

          if (!response.ok) {
            throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status} ${response.statusText}`);
          }

          const jsonData = await response.json();
          let results = null;

          if (Array.isArray(jsonData)) {
            results = jsonData;
          } else if (jsonData && Array.isArray(jsonData.rows)) {
            results = transformRows(jsonData.rows);
          } else if (jsonData && Array.isArray(jsonData.shipments)) {
            results = jsonData.shipments;
          } else if (jsonData && Array.isArray(jsonData.results)) {
            results = jsonData.results;
          }

          if (!results) {
            throw new Error('Live API response must be an array or provide rows/shipments/results.');
          }

          setApiResults(results);
        } catch (err) {
          setApiError(`Live search failed: ${err.message}`);
        } finally {
          setIsApiSearching(false);
        }
      };

      const toggleRow = (index) => {
        setExpandedRows(prev => ({
          ...prev,
          [index]: !prev[index]
        }));
      };

      const matchTerm = (shipment, term) => {
        if (!term) return false;
        const t = term.toLowerCase();
        
        const orderName = shipment.OrderName ? String(shipment.OrderName).toLowerCase() : '';
        const orderId = shipment.OrderID ? String(shipment.OrderID).toLowerCase() : '';
        const sourceStoreOrderId = shipment.SourceStoreOrderID ? String(shipment.SourceStoreOrderID).toLowerCase() : '';
        const shipmentId = shipment.ShipmentID ? String(shipment.ShipmentID).toLowerCase() : '';
        const tracking = shipment.TrackingNumber ? String(shipment.TrackingNumber).toLowerCase() : '';
        const trackingCompany = shipment.TrackingCompany ? String(shipment.TrackingCompany).toLowerCase() : '';
        const customerName = shipment.CustomerName ? String(shipment.CustomerName).toLowerCase() : '';
        const status = shipment.Status ? String(shipment.Status).toLowerCase() : '';
        const sourceStore = shipment.SourceStore ? String(shipment.SourceStore).toLowerCase() : '';
        const itemText = Array.isArray(shipment.items) ? shipment.items.map(i => String(i.name || '').toLowerCase()).join(' ') : '';
        
        if (
          orderName.includes(t) ||
          orderId.includes(t) ||
          sourceStoreOrderId.includes(t) ||
          shipmentId.includes(t) ||
          tracking.includes(t) ||
          trackingCompany.includes(t) ||
          customerName.includes(t) ||
          status.includes(t) ||
          sourceStore.includes(t) ||
          itemText.includes(t)
        ) {
          return true;
        }
        
        if (shipment.returns && Array.isArray(shipment.returns)) {
          return shipment.returns.some(ret => {
            const retId = ret.ReturnID ? String(ret.ReturnID).toLowerCase() : '';
            const retTrack = ret.TrackingNo ? String(ret.TrackingNo).toLowerCase() : '';
            return retId.includes(t) || retTrack.includes(t);
          });
        }
        return false;
      };

      const fileSearchResults = useMemo(() => {
        if (!searchTerm.trim() || !data) return [];
        
        if (isBulkMode) {
          // Split by comma or newline
          const terms = searchTerm.split(/[\n,]+/).map(t => t.trim()).filter(t => t);
          if (terms.length === 0) return [];
          
          return data.filter(shipment => {
             return terms.some(term => matchTerm(shipment, term));
          });
        } else {
          return data.filter(shipment => matchTerm(shipment, searchTerm.trim()));
        }
      }, [data, searchTerm, isBulkMode]);

      const searchResults = sourceMode === 'live' ? apiResults : fileSearchResults;

      const handleSearchSubmit = async (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (!searchTerm.trim()) return;

        setHasSearched(true);
        setExpandedRows({}); // Reset expansions on new search

        if (sourceMode === 'live') {
          await fetchLiveResults(searchTerm.trim());
        }
      };

      if (isLoading) {
        return (
          <div className="min-h-screen flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-slate-500">
            <div className="w-10 h-10 text-blue-500 mb-4"><Icons.Loader /></div>
            <p className="font-medium animate-pulse">Looking for data file in bucket...</p>
          </div>
        );
      }

      if (!data && sourceMode === 'file') {
        return (
          <div className="min-h-screen flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-6">
            <div className="mb-4 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-2">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setSourceMode('file')}
                className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-full font-semibold ${sourceMode === 'file' ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white' : 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-200'}`}
              >
                File Upload
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setSourceMode('live')}
                className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-full font-semibold ${sourceMode === 'live' ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white' : 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-200'}`}
              >
                Live API Search
              </button>
            </div>
            <div className="max-w-md w-full bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-xl overflow-hidden border border-slate-100">
              <div className="bg-blue-600 p-6 text-white text-center">
                <div className="w-12 h-12 mx-auto mb-3 opacity-90"><Icons.Package /></div>
                <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold">Shipment Lookup Tool</h1>
                <p className="text-blue-100 mt-1 text-sm">No data file detected. Upload your JSON file manually to begin.</p>
              </div>
              <div className="p-8">
                <div onClick={handleUploadClick} className="border-2 border-dashed border-blue-200 rounded-xl p-8 flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-blue-50/50 hover:bg-blue-50 cursor-pointer transition-colors duration-200 group">
                  <div className="w-10 h-10 text-blue-500 mb-3 group-hover:scale-110 transition-transform duration-200"><Icons.UploadCloud /></div>
                  <p className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 text-center">Click to browse or drag your file here</p>
                  <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-1">Accepts .json files</p>
                  <input type="file" accept=".json" onChange={handleFileUpload} ref={fileInputRef} className="hidden" />
                </div>
                {error && (
                  <div className="mt-4 p-4 bg-red-50 text-red-700 rounded-lg flex items-start gap-3 border border-red-100 text-sm">
                    <div className="w-5 h-5 flex-shrink-0"><Icons.XCircle /></div>
                    <p>{error}</p>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        );
      }

      return (
        <div className="min-h-screen">
          <header className="bg-white border-b border-slate-200 sticky top-0 z-10 shadow-sm">
            <div className="max-w-6xl mx-auto px-6 h-16 flex items-center justify-between">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-blue-600 font-semibold text-lg">
                <div className="w-6 h-6"><Icons.Package /></div>
                <span>Shipment & Returns Lookup</span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-slate-500 bg-slate-100 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full">
                  <div className="w-4 h-4"><Icons.FileJson /></div>
                  <span>{sourceMode === 'live' ? `${apiResults.length.toLocaleString()} live results` : `${data.length.toLocaleString()} records loaded`}</span>
                </div>
                <button onClick={handleReset} className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-600 hover:text-blue-600 flex items-center gap-1 transition-colors pl-2 border-l border-slate-200">
                  <div className="w-4 h-4"><Icons.ArrowLeft /></div>
                  <span className="hidden sm:inline">Load New</span>
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </header>

          <main className="max-w-6xl mx-auto px-6 py-8">
            <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-slate-200 p-6 mb-8">
              <div className="mb-6 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setSourceMode('file')}
                  className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-full font-semibold ${sourceMode === 'file' ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white' : 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-200'}`}
                >
                  File Search
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setSourceMode('live')}
                  className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-full font-semibold ${sourceMode === 'live' ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white' : 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-200'}`}
                >
                  Live API Search
                </button>
              </div>

              {/* --- TABS --- */}
              <div className="flex border-b border-slate-200 mb-6">
                <button 
                  className={`pb-3 px-4 font-semibold text-sm transition-colors relative ${!isBulkMode ? 'text-blue-600' : 'text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-700'}`}
                  onClick={() => { setIsBulkMode(false); setHasSearched(false); setSearchTerm(''); }}
                >
                  Single Lookup
                  {!isBulkMode && <div className="absolute bottom-0 left-0 right-0 h-0.5 bg-blue-600 rounded-t-full"></div>}
                </button>
                <button 
                  className={`pb-3 px-4 font-semibold text-sm transition-colors relative ${isBulkMode ? 'text-blue-600' : 'text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-700'}`}
                  onClick={() => { setIsBulkMode(true); setHasSearched(false); setSearchTerm(''); }}
                >
                  Bulk Lookup
                  {isBulkMode && <div className="absolute bottom-0 left-0 right-0 h-0.5 bg-blue-600 rounded-t-full"></div>}
                </button>
              </div>

              {sourceMode === 'live' && (
                <div className="mb-6 grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2">
                  <div>
                    <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 mb-2">Live API Endpoint</label>
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      value={apiUrl}
                      onChange={(e) => setApiUrl(e.target.value)}
                      placeholder="https://your-proxy.example.com/shipments"
                      className="block w-full px-4 py-3 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:border-blue-500 outline-none"
                    />
                    <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-slate-500">Use {`{query}`} anywhere in the endpoint or let the dashboard append <code>?q=</code>.</p>
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 mb-2">Bearer Token (optional)</label>
                    <input
                      type="password"
                      value={apiToken}
                      onChange={(e) => setApiToken(e.target.value)}
                      placeholder="Bearer token for live search"
                      className="block w-full px-4 py-3 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:border-blue-500 outline-none"
                    />
                    <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-slate-500">Optional authorization header for live API requests.</p>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* --- SEARCH FORM --- */}
              <form onSubmit={handleSearchSubmit} className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-4 items-start">
                <div className="relative flex-1 w-full">
                  <div className="absolute top-4 left-0 pl-4 flex items-center pointer-events-none">
                    <div className="w-5 h-5 text-slate-400"><Icons.Search /></div>
                  </div>
                  {isBulkMode ? (
                    <textarea
                      placeholder="Paste comma-separated or list of references (Order Name, Shipment ID, Tracking No, Return ID)...&#10;Example: D25433, SHP-10000687673, PNJ63509801"
                      value={searchTerm}
                      onChange={(e) => {
                        setSearchTerm(e.target.value);
                        if (hasSearched) setHasSearched(false);
                      }}
                      rows="3"
                      className="block w-full pl-11 pr-4 py-3 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-base focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:border-blue-500 transition-shadow outline-none placeholder-slate-400 font-medium resize-y"
                    ></textarea>
                  ) : (
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      placeholder="Search Order Name, Shipment ID, Tracking No, or Return ID..."
                      value={searchTerm}
                      onChange={(e) => {
                        setSearchTerm(e.target.value);
                        if (hasSearched) setHasSearched(false);
                      }}
                      className="block w-full pl-11 pr-4 py-4 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl text-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:border-blue-500 transition-shadow outline-none placeholder-slate-400 font-medium"
                    />
                  )}
                </div>
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  className={`bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white px-8 rounded-xl font-semibold text-lg transition-colors shadow-sm flex items-center justify-center gap-2 w-full sm:w-auto ${isBulkMode ? 'py-3 h-[76px]' : 'py-4 h-[60px]'}`}
                >
                  Lookup
                </button>
              </form>

              {sourceMode === 'live' && apiError && (
                <div className="mt-4 p-4 rounded-2xl bg-rose-50 border border-rose-100 text-rose-700 text-sm">
                  {apiError}
                </div>
              )}

              {sourceMode === 'live' && isApiSearching && (
                <div className="mt-4 p-4 rounded-2xl bg-blue-50 border border-blue-100 text-blue-700 text-sm flex items-center gap-2">
                  <div className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin border-2 border-blue-400 border-t-transparent rounded-full"></div>
                  Performing live API search...
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            {hasSearched && (
              <div className="space-y-6">
                <h2 className="text-xl font-semibold text-slate-800 flex items-center gap-2">
                  Search Results for "{isBulkMode ? 'Bulk Search' : searchTerm}"
                  <span className="text-sm font-normal text-slate-500 bg-slate-200 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full">
                    {searchResults.length} found
                  </span>
                </h2>

                {searchResults.length === 0 ? (
                  <div className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-2xl p-12 text-center text-slate-500 shadow-sm">
                    <div className="w-12 h-12 mx-auto text-slate-300 mb-4"><Icons.Info /></div>
                    <h3 className="text-lg font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1">No records found</h3>
                    <p>Could not find any records matching your search.</p>
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  searchResults.map((shipment, index) => {
                    // Decide if it should render expanded out-of-the-box or collapsible
                    // In single mode, always fully expanded. In bulk mode, collapsible.
                    if (!isBulkMode) {
                      return (
                        <div key={index} className="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-slate-200 overflow-hidden">
                          <div className="bg-slate-50/80 border-b border-slate-200 p-6 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4">
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
                              <div className="bg-blue-100 text-blue-700 p-3 rounded-xl">
                                <div className="w-6 h-6"><Icons.Package /></div>
                              </div>
                              <div>
                                <h3 className="text-2xl font-bold text-slate-900 tracking-tight">
                                  {shipment.OrderName || 'N/A'}
                                </h3>
                                <p className="text-sm text-slate-500 font-medium mt-0.5">
                                  Shipment ID: <span className="text-slate-700">{shipment.ShipmentID || 'N/A'}</span>
                                </p>
                              </div>
                            </div>
                            
                            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-3">
                              <div className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-lg border text-sm font-semibold flex flex-col items-center justify-center ${getStatusColor(shipment.ShopifyStatus)}`}>
                                <span className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider opacity-70 font-bold mb-0.5">Shopify</span>
                                {shipment.ShopifyStatus || 'N/A'}
                              </div>
                              <div className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-lg border text-sm font-semibold flex flex-col items-center justify-center ${getStatusColor(shipment.SellerPortalStatus)}`}>
                                <span className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider opacity-70 font-bold mb-0.5">Seller Portal</span>
                                {shipment.SellerPortalStatus || 'N/A'}
                              </div>
                              {shipment.returns && shipment.returns.length > 0 && (
                                <div className="px-3 py-1 rounded-lg border text-sm font-semibold flex flex-col items-center justify-center bg-rose-100 text-rose-800 border-rose-200">
                                  <span className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider opacity-70 font-bold mb-0.5">Inbound</span>
                                  Return Found
                                </div>
                              )}
                            </div>
                          </div>
                          <ShipmentDetails shipment={shipment} />
                        </div>
                      );
                    } else {
                      // BULK MODE - Render Collapsible Rows
                      const isExpanded = !!expandedRows[index];
                      return (
                        <div key={index} className="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm border border-slate-200 overflow-hidden mb-3">
                          <div 
                            className="p-4 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4 cursor-pointer hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors"
                            onClick={() => toggleRow(index)}
                          >
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
                              <div className="bg-blue-50 text-blue-600 p-2.5 rounded-lg">
                                <div className="w-5 h-5"><Icons.Package /></div>
                              </div>
                              <div>
                                <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900 tracking-tight">
                                  {shipment.OrderName || 'N/A'}
                                </h3>
                                <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 font-medium mt-0.5">
                                  ID: <span className="text-slate-700">{shipment.ShipmentID || 'N/A'}</span>
                                </p>
                              </div>
                            </div>
                            
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
                              <div className="hidden sm:flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                                <div className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md border text-xs font-semibold ${getStatusColor(shipment.ShopifyStatus)}`}>
                                  S: {shipment.ShopifyStatus || 'N/A'}
                                </div>
                                <div className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md border text-xs font-semibold ${getStatusColor(shipment.SellerPortalStatus)}`}>
                                  P: {shipment.SellerPortalStatus || 'N/A'}
                                </div>
                                {shipment.returns && shipment.returns.length > 0 && (
                                  <div className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md border text-xs font-semibold bg-rose-100 text-rose-800 border-rose-200">
                                    Return Found
                                  </div>
                                )}
                              </div>
                              <div className="text-slate-400 w-5 h-5">
                                {isExpanded ? <Icons.ChevronUp /> : <Icons.ChevronDown />}
                              </div>
                            </div>
                          </div>

                          {isExpanded && (
                            <div className="border-t border-slate-200">
                              <ShipmentDetails shipment={shipment} />
                            </div>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      );
                    }
                  })
                )}
              </div>
            )}
          </main>
        </div>
      );
    };

    const root = ReactDOM.createRoot(document.getElementById('root'));
    root.render(<App />);
  </script>
</body>
</html>

--- ParcelNinja/shipment_report-DESKTOP-TASWELL.py ---

"""
Shipment Report Module
Generates Excel XLSX and CSV recon exports from Parcelninja outbound shipment records.
"""

from __future__ import annotations
import csv
import ast
import json
from io import BytesIO, StringIO
from typing import Any
import openpyxl
from openpyxl.styles import Font, PatternFill, Alignment, Border, Side
from openpyxl.utils import get_column_letter

REPORT_COLUMNS = [
    "Shipment ID",
    "Order ID",
    "Source Store",
    "Source Store Order ID",
    "Order Date",
    "Shipping Type",
    "Tracking No",
    "Courier",
    "Status",
    "Status Date",
    "Customer Type",
    "Inventory Type",
    "Item Selection",
    "Customer Name",
    "Address Line 1",
    "Address Line 2",
    "City",
    "Region",
    "State",
    "Country",
    "Pin Code",
    "Item Name",
    "Quantity",
    "Serial Number",
    "Expiry Range",
    "Batch ID",
]


def format_pnj_timestamp(value: Any) -> str:
    if not value:
        return ""
    val_str = str(value).strip()
    return val_str


def status_label(status: Any) -> str:
    if not status:
        return ""
    if isinstance(status, dict):
        desc = status.get("description") or status.get("code") or status.get("name") or ""
        return str(desc).strip().upper()
    return str(status).strip().upper()


def shipment_id(outbound: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    client_id = outbound.get("clientId") or outbound.get("client_id") or ""
    if str(client_id).startswith("SHP-"):
        return str(client_id)
    return str(outbound.get("shipmentId") or outbound.get("shipmentID") or client_id or outbound.get("reference") or outbound.get("id") or "")


def shipping_type(delivery_info: dict[str, Any] | None) -> str:
    if not delivery_info or not isinstance(delivery_info, dict):
        return ""
    billing = delivery_info.get("courierBillingInfo")
    if isinstance(billing, dict):
        svc = billing.get("service") or billing.get("shippingType") or billing.get("deliveryType")
        if svc:
            return str(svc)
    return str(delivery_info.get("shippingType") or delivery_info.get("deliveryType") or delivery_info.get("service") or "")


def _serial_numbers(item: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    serials = item.get("serialNumbers") or item.get("SerialNumbers") or item.get("serials") or []
    if isinstance(serials, list):
        return ", ".join(str(s).strip() for s in serials if s)
    if serials:
        return str(serials).strip()
    return ""


def _expiry_and_batches(item: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[str, str]:
    entries = item.get("expiryDatesBatchNumbers") or item.get("expiryDateBatchNumbers") or []
    expiries: list[str] = []
    batches: list[str] = []
    if isinstance(entries, list):
        for entry in entries:
            if isinstance(entry, dict):
                exp = entry.get("expiryDate") or entry.get("ExpiryDate")
                bat = entry.get("batchNumber") or entry.get("BatchNumber")
                if exp:
                    expiries.append(str(exp).strip())
                if bat:
                    batches.append(str(bat).strip())
            elif isinstance(entry, str):
                expiries.append(entry.strip())
    
    # Fallback to direct properties
    if not expiries and item.get("expiryDate"):
        expiries.append(str(item.get("expiryDate")).strip())
    if not batches and (item.get("batchNumber") or item.get("batchId") or item.get("batch")):
        batches.append(str(item.get("batchNumber") or item.get("batchId") or item.get("batch")).strip())

    return ", ".join(expiries), ", ".join(batches)


def flatten_outbound_to_report_rows(outbound: dict[str, Any], store_name: str | None = None) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    """
    Converts a single outbound dictionary into a list of row dicts matching REPORT_COLUMNS.
    CRITICAL: Always returns at least ONE row even if items is empty (e.g. CANCELLED, ON_HOLD, EXCEPTION).
    """
    shp_id = shipment_id(outbound)
    order_id = str(outbound.get("orderId") or outbound.get("orderID") or outbound.get("id") or "")
    
    # Store extraction
    source_store = (
        store_name
        or outbound.get("sourceStore")
        or outbound.get("sourceStoreCode")
        or outbound.get("_store")
        or ""
    )
    source_store_order_id = str(
        outbound.get("sourceStoreOrderId")
        or outbound.get("sourceStoreOrderID")
        or outbound.get("channelId")
        or outbound.get("reference")
        or ""
    )
    order_date = format_pnj_timestamp(outbound.get("createDate") or outbound.get("orderDate"))
    
    # Delivery & Courier
    deliv = outbound.get("deliveryInfo") or outbound.get("delivery_info") or {}
    if not isinstance(deliv, dict):
        deliv = {}
    shp_type = shipping_type(deliv)
    tracking_no = str(deliv.get("trackingNo") or outbound.get("trackingNo") or "")
    courier = str(deliv.get("courierName") or deliv.get("courier") or outbound.get("courierName") or "")
    
    # Status
    st_val = outbound.get("status")
    st_label = status_label(st_val)
    st_date = format_pnj_timestamp(outbound.get("statusDate") or outbound.get("timeStamp") or (st_val.get("timeStamp") if isinstance(st_val, dict) else ""))
    
    # Customer / Address
    cust = deliv.get("customer") or outbound.get("customer") or {}
    if not isinstance(cust, dict):
        cust = {}
    cust_type = str(outbound.get("customerType") or cust.get("customerType") or "")
    inv_type = str(outbound.get("inventoryType") or "")
    item_sel = str(outbound.get("itemSelection") or "")
    cust_name = str(cust.get("name") or cust.get("customerName") or deliv.get("name") or "")
    
    addr1 = str(deliv.get("addressLine1") or deliv.get("address1") or "")
    addr2 = str(deliv.get("addressLine2") or deliv.get("address2") or "")
    city = str(deliv.get("city") or "")
    region = str(deliv.get("region") or "")
    state = str(deliv.get("state") or deliv.get("province") or "")
    country = str(deliv.get("country") or "")
    pin_code = str(deliv.get("postalCode") or deliv.get("pinCode") or deliv.get("zipCode") or "")

    base_header = {
        "Shipment ID": shp_id,
        "Order ID": order_id,
        "Source Store": source_store,
        "Source Store Order ID": source_store_order_id,
        "Order Date": order_date,
        "Shipping Type": shp_type,
        "Tracking No": tracking_no,
        "Courier": courier,
        "Status": st_label,
        "Status Date": st_date,
        "Customer Type": cust_type,
        "Inventory Type": inv_type,
        "Item Selection": item_sel,
        "Customer Name": cust_name,
        "Address Line 1": addr1,
        "Address Line 2": addr2,
        "City": city,
        "Region": region,
        "State": state,
        "Country": country,
        "Pin Code": pin_code,
    }

    items = outbound.get("items") or outbound.get("orderItems") or []
    
    # If no items are present (e.g. CANCELLED, ON_HOLD, EXCEPTION), produce 1 row with empty item fields
    if not items or not isinstance(items, list):
        row = dict(base_header)
        row.update({
            "Item Name": "",
            "Quantity": "",
            "Serial Number": "",
            "Expiry Range": "",
            "Batch ID": "",
        })
        return [row]

    rows = []
    for item in items:
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            continue
        item_name = str(item.get("name") or item.get("itemNo") or item.get("sku") or "")
        qty = item.get("qty") or item.get("quantity") or item.get("count") or 1
        serials = _serial_numbers(item)
        expiry_range, batch_id = _expiry_and_batches(item)

        row = dict(base_header)
        row.update({
            "Item Name": item_name,
            "Quantity": "1",
            "Serial Number": serials,
            "Expiry Range": expiry_range,
            "Batch ID": batch_id,
        })
        rows.append(dict(row))

    return rows if rows else [dict(base_header, **{"Item Name": "", "Quantity": "", "Serial Number": "", "Expiry Range": "", "Batch ID": ""})]


def flatten_outbounds_to_report_rows(outbounds: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for ob in outbounds:
        store = ob.get("_store")
        rows.extend(flatten_outbound_to_report_rows(ob, store_name=store))
    return rows


def report_rows_to_csv(rows: list[dict[str, Any]], delimiter: str = ";") -> bytes:
    buffer = StringIO()
    writer = csv.DictWriter(buffer, fieldnames=REPORT_COLUMNS, delimiter=delimiter, extrasaction="ignore")
    writer.writeheader()
    writer.writerows(rows)
    return buffer.getvalue().encode("utf-8-sig", errors="ignore")


def _json_number(value: Any) -> Any:
    if isinstance(value, int | float):
        return value
    text = str(value or "").strip()
    if text.isdigit():
        return int(text)
    return value


def _json_timestamp(value: Any) -> str:
    text = str(value or "").strip()
    if len(text) == 14 and text.isdigit():
        return f"{text[:4]}-{text[4:6]}-{text[6:8]} {text[8:10]}:{text[10:12]}:{text[12:14]}"
    return text


def _json_shipping_type(value: Any) -> Any:
    text = str(value or "").strip()
    if text.startswith("{"):
        try:
            parsed = ast.literal_eval(text)
            if isinstance(parsed, dict):
                return parsed.get("code") or parsed.get("description") or text
        except (SyntaxError, ValueError):
            pass
    return value


def report_rows_to_json(rows: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> bytes:
    json_rows = []
    for row in rows:
        normalized = dict(row)
        normalized["Order ID"] = _json_number(normalized.get("Order ID"))
        normalized["Quantity"] = _json_number(normalized.get("Quantity"))
        normalized["Order Date"] = _json_timestamp(normalized.get("Order Date"))
        normalized["Status Date"] = _json_timestamp(normalized.get("Status Date"))
        normalized["Shipping Type"] = _json_shipping_type(normalized.get("Shipping Type"))
        normalized["Status"] = str(normalized.get("Status") or "").strip().upper().replace(" ", "_")
        json_rows.append({column: normalized.get(column, "") for column in REPORT_COLUMNS})
    return json.dumps(json_rows, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False).encode("utf-8")


def report_rows_to_xlsx(rows: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> bytes:
    wb = openpyxl.Workbook()
    ws = wb.active
    ws.title = "Outbound Shipments"
    
    # Header styles
    header_fill = PatternFill(start_color="1F4E78", end_color="1F4E78", fill_type="solid")
    header_font = Font(name="Calibri", size=11, bold=True, color="FFFFFF")
    thin_border = Border(
        left=Side(style="thin", color="D3D3D3"),
        right=Side(style="thin", color="D3D3D3"),
        top=Side(style="thin", color="D3D3D3"),
        bottom=Side(style="thin", color="D3D3D3"),
    )

    # Write headers
    ws.append(REPORT_COLUMNS)
    for col_num in range(1, len(REPORT_COLUMNS) + 1):
        cell = ws.cell(row=1, column=col_num)
        cell.fill = header_fill
        cell.font = header_font
        cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal="center", vertical="center")

    # Write data rows
    for row_data in rows:
        row_values = [row_data.get(col, "") for col in REPORT_COLUMNS]
        ws.append(row_values)

    # Apply borders and auto-fit column widths
    ws.freeze_panes = "A2"
    ws.auto_filter.ref = ws.dimensions

    for col in ws.columns:
        max_len = 0
        col_letter = get_column_letter(col[0].column)
        for cell in col:
            cell.border = thin_border
            val_str = str(cell.value or "")
            if len(val_str) > max_len:
                max_len = len(val_str)
        ws.column_dimensions[col_letter].width = min(max(max_len + 3, 12), 50)

    output = BytesIO()
    wb.save(output)
    return output.getvalue()


--- ParcelNinja/shipment_report.py ---

from __future__ import annotations

import csv
from io import BytesIO, StringIO
from typing import Any

try:
    from openpyxl import Workbook
except ImportError:  # pragma: no cover - handled by the Streamlit UI at runtime
    Workbook = None


REPORT_COLUMNS = [
    "Shipment ID",
    "Client ID",
    "Order ID",
    "Source Store",
    "Source Store ID",
    "Source Store Order ID",
    "Store Name/Brand",
    "Order Date",
    "Shipping Type",
    "Tracking No",
    "Courier",
    "Status",
    "Status Date",
    "Customer Type",
    "Inventory Type",
    "Item Selection",
    "Customer Name",
    "Address Line 1",
    "Address Line 2",
    "City",
    "Region",
    "State",
    "Country",
    "Pin Code",
    "Item Name",
    "Quantity",
    "Serial Number",
    "Expiry Range",
    "Batch ID",
]


def format_pnj_timestamp(value: Any) -> str:
    text = str(value or "").strip()
    if len(text) >= 14 and text[:14].isdigit():
        return (
            f"{text[0:4]}-{text[4:6]}-{text[6:8]} "
            f"{text[8:10]}:{text[10:12]}:{text[12:14]}"
        )
    return text


def status_label(status: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    description = str(status.get("description") or "").strip()
    if description:
        return description.upper().replace(" ", "_")
    code = status.get("code")
    return str(code) if code is not None else ""


def get_latest_status(outbound: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Find the most recent status block by comparing timeStamps across
    top-level status, deliveryInfo status, and event history.
    """
    candidates: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    if s := outbound.get("status"):
        candidates.append(s)

    if d := outbound.get("deliveryInfo"):
        if ds := d.get("status"):
            candidates.append(ds)

    if events := outbound.get("events"):
        if isinstance(events, list):
            for e in events:
                if isinstance(e, dict):
                    candidates.append(e)

    if not candidates:
        return {}

    # Sort by timeStamp descending. Lexicographical sort works for YYYYMMDDHHMMSS.
    candidates.sort(key=lambda x: str(x.get("timeStamp") or ""), reverse=True)
    return candidates[0]


def shipment_id(outbound: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    client_id = outbound.get("clientId")
    if client_id and str(client_id).upper().startswith("SHP-"):
        return str(client_id)

    existing = (
        outbound.get("shipmentId")
        or outbound.get("shipmentID")
        or outbound.get("reference")
        or outbound.get("parcelninjaId")
    )
    if existing:
        return str(existing)

    return ""


def shipping_type(delivery_info: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    billing = delivery_info.get("courierBillingInfo") or {}
    service = billing.get("service") or {}
    return str(
        delivery_info.get("shippingType")
        or delivery_info.get("deliveryType")
        or service.get("code")
        or service.get("description")
        or ""
    )


def _join(values: list[Any]) -> str:
    return ", ".join(str(value) for value in values if value not in (None, ""))


def _serial_numbers(item: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    serials = (
        item.get("SerialNumbers")
        or item.get("serialNumbers")
        or item.get("serials")
        or []
    )
    if isinstance(serials, list):
        return _join(serials)
    return str(serials or "")


def _expiry_and_batches(item: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[str, str]:
    entries = (
        item.get("expiryDatesBatchNumbers")
        or item.get("expiryDateBatchNumbers")
        or []
    )
    if not isinstance(entries, list):
        return "", ""

    expiries: list[str] = []
    batches: list[str] = []
    for entry in entries:
        if not isinstance(entry, dict):
            continue
        expiry = entry.get("ExpiryDate") or entry.get("expiryDate")
        batch = entry.get("BatchNumber") or entry.get("batchNumber")
        if expiry:
            expiries.append(str(expiry)[:10])
        if batch:
            batches.append(batch)
    return _join(expiries), _join(batches)


def flatten_outbound_to_report_rows(
    outbound: dict[str, Any],
    store_name: str | None = None,
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    store = (
        outbound.get("sourceStore")
        or outbound.get("sourceStoreCode")
        or outbound.get("_store")
        or store_name
        or ""
    )
    delivery_info = outbound.get("deliveryInfo") or {}
    status = get_latest_status(outbound)
    items = outbound.get("items") or [{}]

    rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for item in items:
        item = item or {}
        expiry_range, batch_id = _expiry_and_batches(item)
        row = {
            "Shipment ID": shipment_id(outbound),
            "Client ID": outbound.get("clientId") or "",
            "Order ID": outbound.get("id") or "",
            "Source Store": store,
            "Source Store ID": outbound.get("sourceStoreId") or outbound.get("_store_id") or "",
            "Source Store Order ID": outbound.get("channelId") or outbound.get("clientId") or "",
            "Store Name/Brand": store,
            "Order Date": format_pnj_timestamp(outbound.get("createDate")),
            "Shipping Type": shipping_type(delivery_info),
            "Tracking No": delivery_info.get("trackingNo") or "",
            "Courier": delivery_info.get("courierName") or "",
            "Status": status_label(status),
            "Status Date": format_pnj_timestamp(status.get("timeStamp")),
            "Customer Type": outbound.get("customerType") or delivery_info.get("customerType") or "",
            "Inventory Type": item.get("inventoryType") or "",
            "Item Selection": item.get("itemSelection") or "",
            "Customer Name": delivery_info.get("customer") or "",
            "Address Line 1": delivery_info.get("addressLine1") or "",
            "Address Line 2": delivery_info.get("addressLine2") or "",
            "City": delivery_info.get("city") or "",
            "Region": delivery_info.get("region") or "",
            "State": delivery_info.get("state") or delivery_info.get("province") or "",
            "Country": delivery_info.get("country") or "",
            "Pin Code": delivery_info.get("postalCode") or "",
            "Item Name": item.get("itemNo") or item.get("name") or "",
            "Quantity": item.get("qty") or "",
            "Serial Number": _serial_numbers(item),
            "Expiry Range": expiry_range,
            "Batch ID": batch_id,
        }
        rows.append({column: row.get(column, "") for column in REPORT_COLUMNS})
    return rows


def flatten_outbounds_to_report_rows(outbounds: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for outbound in outbounds:
        rows.extend(flatten_outbound_to_report_rows(outbound))
    return rows


def report_rows_to_csv(rows: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> bytes:
    buffer = StringIO()
    writer = csv.DictWriter(buffer, fieldnames=REPORT_COLUMNS, extrasaction="ignore")
    writer.writeheader()
    writer.writerows(rows)
    return buffer.getvalue().encode("utf-8-sig")


def report_rows_to_xlsx(rows: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> bytes:
    if Workbook is None:
        raise RuntimeError("openpyxl is required to export Excel files.")

    workbook = Workbook()
    sheet = workbook.active
    sheet.title = "Outbound Shipments"
    sheet.append(REPORT_COLUMNS)
    for row in rows:
        sheet.append([row.get(column, "") for column in REPORT_COLUMNS])

    sheet.freeze_panes = "A2"
    sheet.auto_filter.ref = sheet.dimensions
    for column_cells in sheet.columns:
        max_length = max(len(str(cell.value or "")) for cell in column_cells)
        sheet.column_dimensions[column_cells[0].column_letter].width = min(max(max_length + 2, 12), 38)

    output = BytesIO()
    workbook.save(output)
    return output.getvalue()
